  34SCHEMA = "howlplane.orchestration/v1"
  35# v1: no capability evidence. v2: every agent carries `capabilities` and a
  36# role-keyed `capacity` record; load migrates v1 by replaying recorded failures.
  37# v3: an execution-budget stop is attempt evidence (`timed_out_assignments`),
  38# never role capacity; load converts v2's budget EXHAUSTED entries.
  39SCHEMA_VERSION = 3
  40AGENTS = ("claude_code", "codex", "cursor", "agy", "devin_cli")
  41# AUTO's first choice for mutating roles when the user named no orchestrator (DOG-023).
  42IMPLEMENTATION_PREFERENCE = "codex"
  43ROLES = ("planning", "implementation", "review", "acceptance")
  44AGENT_STATES = {"AVAILABLE", "DEGRADED", "UNAVAILABLE", "RESERVED"}
  45UNAVAILABLE_FAILURES = {"MISSING_EXECUTABLE", "AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED", "PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE"}
  46MODEL_LIMIT_FAILURES = {"QUOTA_EXHAUSTED", "SESSION_LIMIT", "RATE_LIMITED"}
  47# Hard failures bar the same agent from the same role for the rest of the
  48# session, whatever model it would try next. Capacity failures are EXHAUSTED;
  49# the others are deterministic role failures that another model rarely fixes.
  50CAPACITY_FAILURES = {"SESSION_LIMIT"}
  51# HowlPlane's own per-assignment deadline expired. That says nothing about the
  52# provider's allowance: only this exact assignment is barred from running again
  53# unchanged, and the agent stays eligible for other models, roles, and tasks.
  54ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_FAILURES = {"EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED"}
  55# The CLI refused this session's directory as untrusted. That bars the agent
  56# from this workspace only: no role capacity, no session-wide capability loss,
  57# and no readiness penalty for other directories.
  58WORKSPACE_TRUST_FAILURES = {"WORKSPACE_TRUST_REQUIRED"}
  59# Review reads the whole change and cannot be decomposed. Dogfooding measured
  60# reviews at 97-300+ s; at 300 s, half of Cursor's real reviews were cut off.
  61DEFAULT_EXECUTION_BUDGETS: dict[str, int] = {

  92def is_resumable(status_or_doc: str | dict[str, Any], reason: str | None = None) -> bool:
  93    """Return True if an orchestration session can be resumed safely."""
  94    if isinstance(status_or_doc, dict):
  95        doc = status_or_doc
  96        status = str(doc.get("status", "")).upper()
  97        if reason is None:
  98            reason = doc.get("audit") or doc.get("failure") or (doc.get("exclusions") or {}).get("stage")
  99    else:
 100        status = str(status_or_doc).upper()
 101
 102    if status in SUCCESSFULLY_TERMINAL_STATUSES:
 103        return False
 104    if status in TRULY_TERMINAL_STATUSES:
 105        return False
 106    if status in RESUMABLE_STATUSES:
 107        return True
 108    if status == "BLOCKED":
 109        reason_str = str(reason or "")
 110        if "read-only role changed the repository" in reason_str:
 111            return False
 112        if "needs_validation" in reason_str:
 113            return False
 114        if any(keyword in reason_str for keyword in (
 115            "independent reviewer",
 116            "reviewers exhausted",
 117            "workers remain",
 118            "budget",
 119            "workspace trust",
 120            "quota",
 121            "rate limit",
 122            "timeout",
 123        )):
 124            return True
 125        if reason_str.startswith("AUDIT BLOCKED"):
 126            return True
 127        return False
 128    return False

 131def is_final(status_or_doc: str | dict[str, Any], reason: str | None = None) -> bool:
 132    """Return True if an orchestration session has reached a final, non-resumable state."""
 133    return not is_resumable(status_or_doc, reason)

 136def is_existing_wip_context(goal: str, constraints: list[str] | None = None) -> bool:
 137    """Return True if goal or constraints indicate working with existing WIP or changes."""
 138    text = f"{goal} {' '.join(constraints or [])}".lower()
 139    indicators = (
 140        "work in progress", "work-in-progress", "wip",
 141        "existing change", "existing changes", "existing work",
 142        "current change", "current changes", "current repository change",
 143        "current repository changes", "uncommitted",
 144        "intentional work", "finalize", "validate existing",
 145        "audit existing", "inspect existing"
 146    )
 147    return any(term in text for term in indicators)

 149def redact(value: str) -> str:
 150    # The canonical primitive: a private, looser pattern here treated "token once" as a secret and
 151    # rewrote users' goals before workers read them (DOG-029).
 152    return redact_operator_text(value)

 167PHASE_NAMES = {"planning": "PLAN", "implementation": "IMPLEMENT", "review": "AUDIT", "acceptance": "INTEGRATE", "verification": "VERIFY"}

 171class SessionProgress:
 172    def __init__(
 173        self,
 174        document: dict[str, Any],
 175        stream: TextIO | None = None,
 176        heartbeat_interval: float = 30.0,
 177        enabled: bool = True,
 178        clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic,
 179    ) -> None:
 180        self.document = document
 181        self.stream = stream or sys.stderr
 182        self.heartbeat_interval = max(1.0, float(heartbeat_interval))
 183        self.enabled = enabled
 184        self.clock = clock
 185        self.started_at = clock()
 186        self.last_visible_at = self.started_at
 187        self.last_change_at = self.started_at
 188        self.phase_name = PHASE_NAMES.get(document.get("stage", "planning"), "SESSION CREATED")
 189        self._stop = threading.Event()
 190        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None
 191        self._stall_reported = False
 192
 193    @staticmethod
 194    def _safe(value: Any, limit: int = 160) -> str:
 195        text = PRIVATE_REASONING.sub("", redact(str(value))).replace("\n", " ").strip()
 196        return text if len(text) <= limit else text[: limit - 1].rstrip() + "…"
 197
 198    def _write(self, label: str, message: str, timestamp: bool = True) -> None:
 199        if not self.enabled:
 200            return
 201        prefix = f"[{datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] " if timestamp else ""
 202        self.stream.write(f"{prefix}{label:<11} {self._safe(message)}\n")
 203        self.stream.flush()
 204        self.last_visible_at = self.clock()
 205
 206    def session_started(self) -> None:
 207        if not self.enabled:
 208            return
 209        reserved = [AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent) for agent, state in self.document["agents"].items() if state["state"] == "RESERVED"]
 210        requested = self.document.get("requested_orchestrator", self.document["orchestrator"])
 211        selected = self.document.get("selected_orchestrator")
 212        if selected is None and requested != "AUTO":
 213            selected = requested
 214        lines = [
 215            "HOWL ORCHESTRATION",
 216            f"Session: {self.document['id'][:8]}...",
 217            f"Goal: {self._safe(self.document['goal'], 90)}",
 218            f"Requested orchestrator: {AGENT_NAMES.get(requested, requested)}",
 219            f"Selected orchestrator: {AGENT_NAMES.get(selected, selected) if selected else 'pending'}",
 220            f"Strategy: {self.document['strategy']}",
 221            f"Failover: {self.document['failover']}",
 222            f"Execution: {self.document['policy']}",
 223        ]
 224        if reserved:
 225            lines.append(f"Reserved agents: {', '.join(reserved)}")
 226        lines.extend(["", "Starting orchestration..."])
 227        self.stream.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
 228        self.stream.flush()
 229        self.last_visible_at = self.clock()
 230
 231    def phase(self, phase: str, message: str) -> None:
 232        self.phase_name = PHASE_NAMES.get(phase, phase.upper())
 233        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
 234        self._stall_reported = False
 235        self._write(self.phase_name, message)
 236
 237    def assignment(self, task_id: str, agent: str, task: str) -> None:
 238        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
 239        self._write("ASSIGN", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} assigned task {task_id}: {task}")
 240
 241    def worker_complete(self, task_id: str, agent: str, task: str) -> None:
 242        self.last_change_at = self.clock()

 244
 245    def capability_downgrade(self, agent: str) -> None:
 246        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
 247        self._write("CAPABILITY", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} marked interactive-only for this session")
 248
 249    def permission_gap(self, agent: str, role: str, commands: list[str]) -> None:
 250        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
 251        name = AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)
 252        # Commands first: a progress line is cut at 160 characters, and the explanation used to push them out (DOG-020).
 253        for command in commands:
 254            self._write("PERMISSION", f"{name} refused (not granted): {command}")
 255        self._write("PERMISSION", f"{name} changed files but needed commands HowlPlane did not grant; excluded from "
 256                                  f"{role} for this session only, still ready for later sessions (extra_allowed_bash)")
 257
 258    def role_excluded(self, agent: str, role: str, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
 259        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
 260        name = AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)
 261        if entry["state"] == "EXHAUSTED":
 262            self._write("CAPABILITY", f"{name} {role} capacity marked exhausted for this session ({entry['reason']})")
 263        else:
 264            self._write("CAPABILITY", f"{name} excluded from {role} for this session after {entry['reason']}")
 265
 266    def attempt_timed_out(self, agent: str, role: str, budget: int, partial: bool) -> None:

 269        self._write("TIMEOUT", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} {role} stopped at the {budget}s execution budget "
 270                               f"(attempt only; capacity unchanged){detail}")
 271
 272    def selection(self, agent: str, role: str, evidence: str) -> None:
 273        self._write("SELECT", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} for {role}: {evidence}")
 274
 275    def route_skip(self, agent: str, reason: str = "unattended execution unavailable") -> None:
 276        self._write("ROUTE", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} skipped: {reason}")
 277
 278    def excluded(self, agent: str, reason: str) -> None:

 280

 282        self._write("WARNING", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} previously required interactive permission; explicit selection overrides AUTO exclusion")
 283
 284    def selected_orchestrator(self, agent: str) -> None:

 288    def limit(self, agent: str, model: str, reason: str) -> None:
 289        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
 290        self._write("LIMIT", f"{agent}/{model} reached {reason.lower().replace('_', ' ')}")

 292    def checkpoint(self, task_id: str) -> None:
 293        self._write("CHECKPOINT", f"Preserved task {task_id} state")
 294
 295    def reroute(self, task_id: str, source: str, target: str, reason: str) -> None:
 296        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
 297        self._write("REROUTE", f"{task_id}: {AGENT_NAMES.get(source, source)} → {AGENT_NAMES.get(target, target)} ({reason})")
 298        reserved = [AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent) for agent, state in self.document["agents"].items() if state["state"] == "RESERVED"]
 299        if reserved:
 300            self._write("REROUTE", f"{', '.join(reserved)} skipped: RESERVED")
 301
 302    def validation(self, started: bool, message: str) -> None:
 303        self.phase_name = "VERIFY"
 304        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
 305        self._write("VERIFY", message)
 306
 307    def blocked(self, status: str, reason: str, next_step: str | None = None) -> None:
 308        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
 309        self._write(status, reason)
 310        if next_step and is_resumable(self.document):
 311            self._write("RESUME", next_step)
 312
 313    def complete(self, status: str) -> None:
 314        successes = sum(attempt.get("state") == "SUCCEEDED" for attempt in self.document.get("attempts", []))
 315        passed = sum(test.get("exit_code") == 0 for test in self.document.get("tests", []))
 316        self._write("COMPLETE", f"Session finished; {successes} tasks completed; {len(self.document.get('reroutes', []))} rerouted; {passed} validations passed; final status: {status}")
 317
 318    def heartbeat(self, force: bool = False) -> bool:
 319        current = self.clock()
 320        if not force and current - self.last_visible_at < self.heartbeat_interval:
 321            return False
 322        active = [attempt for attempt in self.document.get("attempts", []) if attempt.get("state") == "ASSIGNED"]
 323        if active:
 324            tasks = ", ".join(attempt.get("task_id", self.document["id"][:8]) for attempt in active)
 325            message = f"{self.phase_name} — {len(active)} active worker(s); tasks: {tasks}"
 326        else:
 327            message = f"Session active; current phase: {self.phase_name}"
 328        self._write("WORKING", message)
 329        if current - self.last_change_at >= 300 and not self._stall_reported:
 330            self._write("WARNING", "No worker state change for 5m; session remains active")
 331            self._stall_reported = True
 332        return True
 333
 334    @contextmanager
 335    def waiting(self):
 336        if self.enabled:
 337            self._stop.clear()
 338            self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._heartbeat_loop, name=f"howl-progress-{self.document['id'][:8]}", daemon=True)
 339            self._thread.start()
 340        try:
 341            yield
 342        finally:
 343            self._stop.set()
 344            if self._thread and self._thread is not threading.current_thread():
 345                self._thread.join(timeout=1)
 346            self._thread = None
 347
 348    def _heartbeat_loop(self) -> None:
 349        while not self._stop.wait(self.heartbeat_interval):
 350            self.heartbeat()

 353def state_root() -> Path:
 354    base = os.environ.get("XDG_STATE_HOME")
 355    if not base or not Path(base).is_absolute():
 356        base = str(Path.home() / ".local" / "state")
 357    return Path(base) / "howlplane" / "orchestrate"

 360def git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:
 361    result = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *guarded_git_args([*args])], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=20)
 362    if result.returncode:
 363        raise ValueError(f"Git inspection failed: {redact(result.stderr.strip())}")
 364    return result.stdout.strip()
 365
 366
 367def evidence(repo: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
 368    import hashlib
 369    root = Path(git(repo, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")).resolve()
 370    def digest(*args: str) -> str:
 371        return hashlib.sha256(git(root, *args).encode()).hexdigest()
 372    untracked = git(root, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z")
 373    untracked_hashes = {}
 374    for name in filter(None, untracked.split("\0")):
 375        candidate = root / name
 376        if candidate.is_file() and not candidate.is_symlink():
 377            untracked_hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 378    return {
 379        "root": str(root),
 380        "head": git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
 381        "status": git(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"),
 382        "diff_sha256": digest("diff", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff"),
 383        "cached_diff_sha256": digest("diff", "--cached", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff"),
 384        "worktrees": git(root, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain"),
 385        "untracked_sha256": untracked_hashes,
 386    }

 389def fingerprint(snapshot: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
 390    import hashlib
 391    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(snapshot, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()

 394def dirty_paths(root: Path) -> dict[str, str | None]:
 395    """Each path that differs from HEAD (or is untracked), with its content hash; None when deleted."""
 396    import hashlib
 397    # Not git(): its strip() would eat the leading space of a " M path" entry.
 398    status = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), *guarded_git_args(["status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all"])],
 399                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
 400    if status.returncode:
 401        raise ValueError(f"Git inspection failed: {redact(status.stderr.strip())}")
 402    entries = status.stdout.split("\0")
 403    paths: dict[str, str | None] = {}
 404    index = 0
 405    while index < len(entries):
 406        entry = entries[index]
 407        index += 1
 408        if len(entry) < 4:
 409            continue
 410        if entry[0] in "RC":
 411            index += 1  # -z puts a rename's source path in the next field
 412        name = entry[3:]
 413        candidate = root / name
 414        paths[name] = (hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 415                       if candidate.is_file() and not candidate.is_symlink() else None)
 416    return paths
 417
 418
 419REVIEW_DIFF_CHARS = 12000
 420
 421
 422def session_diff_evidence(doc: dict[str, Any], repo: Path) -> str:
 423    """Give read-only roles the diff of this session's work, which HowlPlane computes itself.
 424
 425    Review and acceptance hold no shell, so they could not see what changed or the
 426    original version of a file, and compatibility requirements went unverified (DOG-027).
 427    Git runs here with external diff and textconv drivers off, so no repository-configured
 428    program executes. Changes the user already had uncommitted when the session began are
 429    named separately, so they are never judged as the implementer's work.
 430    """
 431    try:
 432        root = Path(git(repo, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")).resolve()
 433        current = dirty_paths(root)
 434        has_head = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), *guarded_git_args(["rev-parse", "--verify", "-q", "HEAD"])],
 435                                  capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20).returncode == 0
 436    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
 437        return ""
 438    base = doc.get("base_dirty") or {}
 439    untouched = sorted(name for name in current if name in base and current[name] == base[name])
 440    session = sorted(name for name in current if name not in untouched)
 441    if not session and not untouched:
 442        return ""
 443    lines = [" HowlPlane computed this session's changes against the last commit (HEAD); you cannot run git yourself, "
 444             "so use this to see what changed and the original lines, and Read files for full context."]
 445    if untouched:
 446        lines.append("\nUncommitted changes the user already had before this session began, untouched by it (not the "
 447                     "implementer's work; do not judge them): " + ", ".join(untouched))
 448    mixed = sorted(name for name in session if name in base)
 449    if mixed:
 450        lines.append("\nThese files already had uncommitted user changes before this session; their diff below includes "
 451                     "those user changes as well: " + ", ".join(mixed))
 452    tracked = [name for name in session if has_head and subprocess.run(
 453        ["git", "-C", str(root), *guarded_git_args(["cat-file", "-e", f"HEAD:{name}"])], capture_output=True, timeout=20).returncode == 0]
 454    added = [name for name in session if name not in tracked]
 455    if added:
 456        lines.append("\nNew files (not in HEAD; Read them): " + ", ".join(added))
 457    if tracked:
 458        try:
 459            diff = git(root, "diff", "HEAD", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", "--no-color", "--", *tracked)
 460        except ValueError:
 461            diff = ""
 462        if len(diff) > REVIEW_DIFF_CHARS:
 463            diff = diff[:REVIEW_DIFF_CHARS] + "\n[... diff truncated by HowlPlane; Read the files for the rest ...]"
 464        # Not redacted: the diff is never persisted, and the reviewer can Read the same files. Redacting it
 465        # only showed the reviewer text that is not in the repository (DOG-030: a README placeholder
 466        # `API_TOKEN='paste-the-printed-token-here'` arrived as `API_TOKEN='[REDACTED]'`).
 467        lines.append("\n--- diff of changed tracked files against HEAD ---\n" + diff + "\n--- end of diff ---")
 468    return "".join(lines)
 469
 470
 471@contextmanager
 472def locked(root: Path):
 473    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
 474    os.chmod(root, 0o700)
 475    with (root / ".lock").open("a+") as handle:
 476        fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 477        try:
 478            yield
 479        finally:
 480            fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
 481
 482
 483def path_for(root: Path, session_id: str) -> Path:
 484    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", session_id):
 485        raise ValueError("Invalid session ID")
 486    return root / f"{session_id}.json"
 487
 488
 489def save(path: Path, document: dict[str, Any], token: str) -> None:
 490    current = safe_load_json(path) if path.exists() else None
 491    if current and current.get("lease", {}).get("token") != token:
 492        raise ValueError("Coordinator lease changed; stale assignment rejected")
 493    clean = json.loads(redact(json.dumps(document)))
 494    secure_write(path, clean)
 495
 496
 497def secure_write(path: Path, document: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
 498    descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
 499    try:
 500        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w") as handle:
 501            json.dump(json.loads(redact(json.dumps(document))), handle, indent=2)
 502            handle.flush()
 503            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
 504        os.replace(temporary, path)
 505    finally:
 506        if os.path.exists(temporary):
 507            os.unlink(temporary)
 508
 509
 510def active_sessions(root: Path, repo: Path, include_terminal: bool = False) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
 511    sessions = []
 512    for path in root.glob("[0-9a-f]*.json"):
 513        doc = safe_load_json(path)
 514        if isinstance(doc, dict) and doc.get("schema") == SCHEMA and doc.get("repository") == str(repo) and (include_terminal or is_resumable(doc)):
 515            sessions.append(doc)
 516    return sorted(sessions, key=lambda item: str(item.get("created_at", "")), reverse=True)
 517
 518
 519def now() -> str:
 520    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 521
 522
 523def live_lease(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
 524    """True while another process still holds this session's coordinator lease."""
 525    lease = doc.get("lease") or {}
 526    if time.time() - lease.get("renewed_at", 0) >= 330 or lease.get("pid", 0) == os.getpid():
 527        return False
 528    try:
 529        os.kill(lease["pid"], 0)
 530    except (ProcessLookupError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
 531        return False
 532    except PermissionError:
 533        return True
 534    return True
 535
 536
 537def supersede(root: Path, session_id: str, reason: str, replaced_by: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 538    """Retire one resumable session in favour of replacement work.
 539
 540    Unlike ``discard``, the manifest is kept: it becomes ``SUPERSEDED`` history
 541    that records why and by what it was replaced, and it no longer owns its
 542    worktree. A session that is not resumable, or whose coordinator is still
 543    alive, is refused rather than taken over.
 544    """
 545    with locked(root):
 546        path = path_for(root, session_id)
 547        if not path.exists():
 548            raise ValueError(f"Session {session_id} does not exist")
 549        doc = safe_load_json(path)
 550        if not isinstance(doc, dict) or doc.get("schema") != SCHEMA:
 551            raise ValueError(f"Session {session_id} is not an orchestration session")
 552        if not is_resumable(doc):
 553            raise ValueError(f"Session {session_id} is {doc.get('status')}, not resumable; nothing to supersede")
 554        if live_lease(doc):
 555            raise ValueError(f"Session {session_id} has a live coordinator lease")
 556        doc["superseded"] = {"at": now(), "reason": reason, "replaced_by": replaced_by,
 557                             "previous_status": doc.get("status"), "previous_stage": doc.get("stage")}
 558        doc["status"] = SUPERSEDED
 559        secure_write(path, doc)
 560    return doc
 561
