 563def discover_models(agent: str) -> list[str]:
 564    """Read only advertised lists. A silent CLI default remains UNKNOWN."""
 565    try:
 566        return agent_readiness.routing_models(agent)
 567    except (OSError, ValueError):
 568        return []
 569
 570
 571def inventory(availability: dict[str, str], repo: Path | None = None,
 572              policy: str | None = None) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
 573    """Session start inventory. Cached readiness evidence informs it; nothing here sends a prompt.
 574
 575    `local_only` forbids hosted egress, and every agent here is a hosted CLI, so
 576    none is dispatchable in that mode -- the same verdict the doctor and the
 577    provider pool give. With a repository, each agent also carries its vendor
 578    trust state for that workspace, read from local files only, next to its
 579    effective readiness under the session's workspace trust policy.
 580    """
 581    policy = policy or workspace_trust.resolve_policy()["policy"]
 582    readiness = agent_readiness.cached_summaries()
 583    hosted = agent_readiness.hosted_probes_allowed()
 584    found = {}
 585    for agent in AGENTS:
 586        installed = shutil.which(BINARIES[agent]) is not None
 587        requested = availability.get(agent, "AUTO").upper()
 588        state = "RESERVED" if requested == "RESERVED" else "AVAILABLE" if installed and requested != "UNAVAILABLE" else "UNAVAILABLE"
 589        if state == "AVAILABLE" and not hosted:
 590            state = "UNAVAILABLE"
 591        evidence = readiness.get(agent)
 592        capabilities = unknown_capabilities("CLI metadata does not confirm unattended execution")
 593        if evidence and evidence["unattended_execution"] is not None:
 594            capabilities.update({"unattended_execution": evidence["unattended_execution"],
 595                                 "reason": f"agent readiness: {evidence['unattended_source']}",
 596                                 "evidence_time": evidence["last_verified_at"], "scope": "readiness cache"})
 597        if state == "AVAILABLE" and evidence:
 598            # Only fresh, negative, agent-wide evidence removes an agent; UNKNOWN never does.
 599            if evidence["authenticated"] is False or evidence["capacity"]["state"] in {"QUOTA_EXHAUSTED", "SESSION_EXHAUSTED", "RATE_LIMITED"}:
 600                state = "UNAVAILABLE"
 601            elif capabilities["unattended_execution"] is False:
 602                state = "DEGRADED"
 603        found[agent] = {
 604            "backend": BINARIES[agent],
 605            "installed": installed,
 606            "callable": installed,
 607            "state": state,
 608            "models": discover_models(agent) if installed and hosted and requested != "RESERVED" else [],
 609            "capabilities": capabilities,
 610            "capacity": {},
 611            "readiness": readiness_digest(evidence),
 612        }
 613        if not hosted and installed:
 614            found[agent]["unavailable_reason"] = agent_readiness.LOCAL_ONLY_DETAIL
 615        if repo is not None and installed:
 616            trust = workspace_trust.check(agent, repo)
 617            verdict = workspace_trust.effective(agent, trust["state"], policy)
 618            found[agent]["workspace_trust"] = {
 619                **{key: trust.get(key) for key in (
 620                    "state", "workspace", "scope", "covering_path", "detail", "source", "checked_at")},
 621                "policy": policy, "effective_state": verdict["effective_state"],
 622                "mechanism": verdict["mechanism"]}
 623    return found
 624
 625
 626def readiness_digest(evidence: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
 627    """The routing-relevant slice of cached readiness, kept on the session record."""
 628    if not evidence:
 629        return {"live_smoke": "NOT_RUN", "verified_at": None, "capacity_state": "UNKNOWN", "model_limits": []}
 630    return {"live_smoke": evidence["live_smoke"]["status"], "verified_at": evidence["live_smoke"]["verified_at"],
 631            "capacity_state": evidence["capacity"]["state"],
 632            "model_limits": [f"{item['model']}:{item['state']}" for item in evidence["capacity"]["limits"] if item.get("model")]}
 633
 634
 635def selection_evidence(doc: dict[str, Any], agent: str) -> str:
 636    """Observable facts behind an AUTO choice; no subjective ranking."""
 637    state = agent_record(doc, agent)
 638    unattended = state["capabilities"]["unattended_execution"]
 639    readiness = state.get("readiness") or readiness_digest(None)
 640    smoke = readiness.get("live_smoke", "NOT_RUN")
 641    age = agent_readiness.age_seconds(readiness.get("verified_at"))
 642    smoke_text = {"NOT_RUN": "not run", "STALE": "stale"}.get(smoke, smoke.lower())
 643    if smoke == "PASS" and age is not None:
 644        smoke_text = f"passed {agent_readiness._duration(age)} ago"
 645    return (f"unattended {({True: 'verified', False: 'interactive-only (explicit override)', None: 'unverified'})[unattended]}"
 646            f" · live smoke {smoke_text} · capacity {readiness.get('capacity_state', 'UNKNOWN')}")
 647
 648
 649class SessionStateInvalid(ValueError):
 650    """A manifest that cannot be normalized without guessing at its evidence."""
 651
 652
 653def unknown_capabilities(reason: str = "No unattended execution evidence recorded") -> dict[str, Any]:
 654    return {"unattended_execution": None, "reason": reason, "evidence_time": None, "scope": "session"}
 655
 656
 657def normalize_agent(agent: str, record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
 658    """Bring one agent record to the v2 shape. Missing evidence is UNKNOWN, never AVAILABLE."""
 659    if not isinstance(record, dict) or record.get("state") not in AGENT_STATES:
 660        raise SessionStateInvalid(f"Agent record for {agent} is malformed")
 661    record.setdefault("backend", BINARIES.get(agent, agent))
 662    record.setdefault("installed", False)
 663    record.setdefault("callable", record["installed"])
 664    if not isinstance(record.get("models"), list):
 665        record["models"] = []
 666    capabilities = record.get("capabilities")
 667    if not isinstance(capabilities, dict) or capabilities.get("unattended_execution") not in (None, True, False):
 668        record["capabilities"] = unknown_capabilities()
 669    else:
 670        for key, value in unknown_capabilities().items():
 671            capabilities.setdefault(key, value)
 672    capacity = record.get("capacity")
 673    record["capacity"] = {
 674        role: entry for role, entry in (capacity.items() if isinstance(capacity, dict) else ())
 675        if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("state") in {"EXHAUSTED", "FAILED"} and entry.get("reason")
 676    }
 677    return record
 678
 679
 680def agent_record(doc: dict[str, Any], agent: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 681    """Normalized access to an agent. An agent the manifest never recorded is UNAVAILABLE."""
 682    agents = doc["agents"]
 683    if agent not in agents:
 684        agents[agent] = {"backend": BINARIES.get(agent, agent), "installed": False, "callable": False,
 685                         "state": "UNAVAILABLE", "models": [],
 686                         "capabilities": unknown_capabilities("Agent absent from session manifest"), "capacity": {}}
 687    return normalize_agent(agent, agents[agent])
 688
 689
 690def normalize_session(doc: Any) -> list[str]:
 691    """Validate and migrate a loaded manifest in place; return migration notes for progress."""
 692    if not isinstance(doc, dict) or doc.get("schema") != SCHEMA:
 693        raise SessionStateInvalid("Manifest is not an orchestration session")
 694    missing = [key for key in REQUIRED_KEYS if key not in doc]
 695    if missing:
 696        raise SessionStateInvalid(f"Manifest lacks required fields: {', '.join(missing)}")
 697    if not isinstance(doc["agents"], dict) or not isinstance(doc["attempts"], list) or not isinstance(doc["lease"], dict) or "token" not in doc["lease"]:
 698        raise SessionStateInvalid("Manifest agents, attempts, or lease are malformed")
 699    if any(not isinstance(item, dict) or not {"stage", "agent", "model"} <= item.keys() for item in doc["attempts"]):
 700        raise SessionStateInvalid("Manifest attempt history is malformed")
 701    version = doc.get("schema_version", 1)
 702    if not isinstance(version, int) or not 1 <= version <= SCHEMA_VERSION:
 703        raise SessionStateInvalid(f"Unsupported session schema version {version!r}")
 704    for key, default in (("constraints", []), ("role_models", {}), ("fallbacks", {}), ("model_states", {}),
 705                         ("known_models", {}), ("tests", []), ("reroutes", []), ("capability_notices", []),
 706                         ("timed_out_assignments", []), ("execution_budget", {})):
 707        if not isinstance(doc.get(key), type(default)):
 708            doc[key] = default
 709    if version < 3:
 710        doc["execution_budget"] = {role: LEGACY_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS for role in ROLES}
 711    else:
 712        try:
 713            doc["execution_budget"] = {**default_execution_budget(), **validate_execution_budget(doc["execution_budget"])}
 714        except ValueError as error:
 715            raise SessionStateInvalid(str(error)) from error
 716    doc["lease"].setdefault("pid", 0)
 717    doc["lease"].setdefault("renewed_at", 0)
 718    for agent in list(doc["agents"]):
 719        normalize_agent(agent, doc["agents"][agent])
 720    for agent in AGENTS:
 721        agent_record(doc, agent)
 722    if version == SCHEMA_VERSION:
 723        return []
 724    # v1 recorded failures only in the attempt log. Replaying that log restores
 725    # the session's hard-failure evidence; successes are not replayed as
 726    # positive capability claims, they only clear an earlier same-role failure.
 727    for attempt in doc["attempts"]:
 728        agent, role = attempt["agent"], attempt["stage"]
 729        if agent not in AGENTS:
 730            continue
 731        # v2 already holds the replayed outcome of every other attempt.
 732        if attempt.get("state") == "SUCCEEDED" and version == 1:
 733            agent_record(doc, agent)["capacity"].pop(role, None)
 734        elif attempt.get("failure") in ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_FAILURES:
 735            record_timeout(doc, role, agent, attempt["model"], LEGACY_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS,
 736                           attempt.get("timeout_source"), attempt.get("finished_at"))
 737        elif attempt.get("failure") and version == 1:
 738            record_failure(doc, agent, role, attempt["model"], attempt["failure"], attempt.get("finished_at"))
 739    # v2 recorded a budget stop as role capacity EXHAUSTED. It was attempt
 740    # evidence all along: keep it as such and undo the degradation it caused.
 741    for agent in AGENTS:
 742        state = agent_record(doc, agent)
 743        for role, entry in list(state["capacity"].items()):
 744            if entry["reason"] in ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_FAILURES:
 745                del state["capacity"][role]
 746                record_timeout(doc, role, agent, entry.get("model", "UNKNOWN"), LEGACY_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS,
 747                               None, entry.get("evidence_time"))
 748        if (state["state"] == "DEGRADED" and not state["capacity"]
 749                and state["capabilities"]["unattended_execution"] is not False):
 750            state["state"] = "AVAILABLE"
 751    doc["schema_version"] = SCHEMA_VERSION
 752    doc.setdefault("migrations", []).append({"from": version, "to": SCHEMA_VERSION, "at": now()})
 753    return [f"Session manifest normalized from schema v{version} → v{SCHEMA_VERSION}"]
 754
 755
 756def record_capability_failure(doc: dict[str, Any], agent: str, reason: str, at: str | None = None) -> None:
 757    state = agent_record(doc, agent)
 758    if state["state"] == "AVAILABLE":
 759        state["state"] = "DEGRADED"
 760    state["capabilities"].update({"unattended_execution": False, "reason": reason, "evidence_time": at or now(), "scope": "session"})
 761
 762
 763def record_capability_success(doc: dict[str, Any], agent: str) -> None:
 764    state = agent_record(doc, agent)
 765    state["state"] = "AVAILABLE"
 766    state["capabilities"].update({"unattended_execution": True, "reason": "Successful unattended session invocation",
 767                                  "evidence_time": now(), "scope": "session"})
 768
 769
 770def permission_grant_gap(result: Any, stage: str, changed: bool) -> list[str]:
 771    """Commands HowlPlane never granted, when they alone stopped a worker that was mutating the repository.
 772
 773    A worker that changed files unattended and was then refused only a Bash command
 774    outside its derived profile (typically a greenfield test run, before any project
 775    command exists to derive) has proven unattended mutation. The gap is HowlPlane's
 776    grant, not the agent's capability (DOG-018). Returns [] when that is not the case.
 777    """
 778    metadata = getattr(result, "metadata", None) or {}
 779    commands = [str(command) for command in metadata.get("denied_commands") or []]
 780    if not (changed and is_mutating_role(stage) and commands and metadata.get("denied_tools") == ["Bash"]):
 781        return []
 782    return commands
 783
 784
 785def record_failure(doc: dict[str, Any], agent: str, role: str, model: str, failure: str, at: str | None = None,
 786                   grant_gap: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
 787    """Apply one failed attempt to session evidence. Returns the role exclusion it created, if any."""
 788    state = agent_record(doc, agent)
 789    if failure in ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_FAILURES:
 790        # Attempt evidence only; `record_timeout` bars the identical retry.
 791        return None
 792    if failure in WORKSPACE_TRUST_FAILURES:
 793        policy = session_trust_policy(doc)
 794        state["workspace_trust"] = {"state": workspace_trust.TRUST_REQUIRED, "workspace": doc.get("repository"),
 795                                    "role": role, "source": "orchestrate session", "detected_at": at or now(),
 796                                    "policy": policy, "mechanism": workspace_trust.mechanism(agent, policy)}
 797        return None
 798    if failure == "EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED" and is_mutating_role(role) and not grant_gap:
 799        # A denial in a read-only role means the worker reached for a tool that
 800        # role never holds. It says nothing about unattended mutation, so it
 801        # must not take the agent out of every other role (DOG-004). Nor does a
 802        # denial of an ungranted command after real edits (DOG-018); that
 803        # attempt still excludes the agent from this role below.
 804        record_capability_failure(doc, agent, failure, at)
 805    if failure in UNAVAILABLE_FAILURES:
 806        state["state"] = "UNAVAILABLE"
 807    if failure in MODEL_LIMIT_FAILURES:
 808        doc["model_states"][f"{agent}:{model}"] = "EXHAUSTED"
 809        if model == "UNKNOWN":
 810            state["state"] = "UNAVAILABLE"
 811    if failure not in CAPACITY_FAILURES and failure not in ROLE_FAILURES:
 812        return None
 813    if state["state"] == "AVAILABLE":
 814        state["state"] = "DEGRADED"
 815    entry = {"state": "EXHAUSTED" if failure in CAPACITY_FAILURES else "FAILED", "reason": failure,
 816             "model": model, "evidence_time": at or now(), "scope": "session"}
 817    state["capacity"][role] = entry
 818    return entry
 819
 820
 821def capacity_reason(entry: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
 822    return {"SESSION_LIMIT": "session limit reached"}.get(entry["reason"], f"failed earlier this session ({entry['reason']})")
 823
 824
 825def default_execution_budget() -> dict[str, int]:
 826    return dict(DEFAULT_EXECUTION_BUDGETS)
 827
 828
 829def validate_execution_budget(budget: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, int]:
 830    """A finite per-role deadline. Anything outside 1..MAX is refused, never clamped."""
 831    checked = {}
 832    for role, seconds in budget.items():
 833        if role not in ROLES:
 834            raise ValueError(f"Unknown execution budget role {role!r}")
 835        if isinstance(seconds, bool) or not isinstance(seconds, int) or not 1 <= seconds <= MAX_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS:
 836            raise ValueError(f"Execution budget for {role} must be 1..{MAX_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS} seconds")
 837        checked[role] = seconds
 838    return checked
 839
 840
 841def parse_execution_budget(values: list[str] | None) -> dict[str, int]:
 842    """Parse repeatable `role=seconds` (or a bare `seconds` for every role)."""
 843    parsed: dict[str, int] = {}
 844    for value in values or []:
 845        role, _, seconds = value.rpartition("=")
 846        if not seconds.strip().isdigit():
 847            raise ValueError("Expected --execution-budget role=seconds or seconds")
 848        for target in ([role.strip()] if role else ROLES):
 849            parsed[target] = int(seconds)
 850    return validate_execution_budget(parsed)
 851
 852
 853def execution_budget(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str) -> int:
 854    return doc.get("execution_budget", {}).get(role, DEFAULT_EXECUTION_BUDGETS.get(role, DEFAULT_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS))
 855
 856
 857def parse_role_model_triples(value: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
 858    if not value or value == "AUTO":
 859        return []
 860    result = []
 861    for item in value.split(","):
 862        parts = item.strip().split(":", 2)
 863        if len(parts) != 3 or parts[0] not in ROLES or parts[1] not in AGENTS:
 864            raise ValueError("Expected role:agent:model")
 865        result.append((parts[0], parts[1], parts[2]))
 866    return result
 867
 868
 869def timeout_signature(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str, agent: str, model: str, budget: int | None = None) -> str:
 870    """Identity of an assignment. Changing its scope, worker, model, or deadline yields a new one."""
 871    import hashlib
 872    identity = {"goal": doc["goal"], "constraints": doc["constraints"], "role": role, "agent": agent, "model": model,
 873                "budget": execution_budget(doc, role) if budget is None else budget}
 874    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identity, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
 875
 876
 877def record_timeout(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str, agent: str, model: str, budget: int,
 878                   source: str | None = None, at: str | None = None) -> None:
 879    signature = timeout_signature(doc, role, agent, model, budget)
 880    ledger = doc.setdefault("timed_out_assignments", [])
 881    if any(item.get("signature") == signature for item in ledger):
 882        return
 883    ledger.append({"signature": signature, "stage": role, "agent": agent, "model": model,
 884                   "execution_budget_seconds": budget, "timeout_source": source, "at": at or now()})
 885
 886
 887def timed_out(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str, agent: str, model: str) -> bool:
 888    """True when this exact assignment already hit its deadline and would run again unchanged."""
 889    signature = timeout_signature(doc, role, agent, model)
 890    return any(item.get("signature") == signature for item in doc.get("timed_out_assignments", []))
 891
 892
 893def session_trust_policy(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
 894    """The workspace trust policy this session dispatches under (resolved at setup and on resume)."""
 895    return (doc.get("workspace_trust_policy") or {}).get("policy") or workspace_trust.resolve_policy()["policy"]
 896
 897
 898def workspace_trust_block(doc: dict[str, Any], agent: str) -> str | None:
 899    """Why this session's workspace refuses the agent, or None. Scoped to the workspace, never the agent."""
 900    record = agent_record(doc, agent)
 901    trust = record.get("workspace_trust") or {}
 902    if trust.get("state") != workspace_trust.TRUST_REQUIRED:
 903        return None
 904    policy = session_trust_policy(doc)
 905    if trust.get("source") == "vendor trust store" and trust.get("workspace"):
 906        # A pre-dispatch verdict from local files: an operator may have prepared
 907        # the workspace since (for example, before `resume`).
 908        current = workspace_trust.check(agent, trust["workspace"])
 909        if current["state"] == workspace_trust.READY:
 910            record["workspace_trust"] = {**trust, "state": current["state"], "covering_path": current["covering_path"],
 911                                         "checked_at": current["checked_at"]}
 912            return None
 913        if workspace_trust.effective(agent, current["state"], policy)["effective_state"] == workspace_trust.READY:
 914            # The vendor still does not trust it; this policy's audited flag makes it usable.
 915            return None
 916    elif agent_readiness.binding_refusal(agent, trust, policy) is None:
 917        # Refused without the flag this policy now supplies: that refusal says nothing about the new invocation.
 918        return None
 919    # A refusal the CLI returned under this same invocation stays binding: no retry in this folder.
 920    return (f"workspace trust required for {trust.get('workspace') or doc.get('repository')} "
 921            f"(policy {policy}; run howlplane factory prepare or choose --workspace-trust bypass)")
 922
 923
 924def capability_skip_reason(doc: dict[str, Any], agent: str, role: str) -> str | None:
 925    state = agent_record(doc, agent)
 926    if state["state"] == "RESERVED":
 927        return "reserved"
 928    trust_block = workspace_trust_block(doc, agent)
 929    if trust_block:
 930        # An explicit orchestrator choice cannot answer a vendor trust prompt.
 931        return trust_block
 932    # A role hard failure outranks an explicit orchestrator choice: selecting an
 933    # agent is not consent to burn another call on capacity it just exhausted.
 934    if role in state["capacity"]:
 935        return capacity_reason(state["capacity"][role])
 936    if state["capabilities"]["unattended_execution"] is not False:
 937        return None
 938    if doc.get("requested_orchestrator") == agent:
 939        return "explicit override"
 940    return "unattended execution unavailable"
 941
 942
 943def exclusions(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
 944    """Why each agent is not a candidate for this role, for the terminal explanation."""
 945    eligible = {agent for agent, _ in candidates(doc, role)}
 946    found = []
 947    for agent in AGENTS:
 948        state = agent_record(doc, agent)
 949        if agent in eligible and not (role == "review" and agent == doc.get("implementer")):
 950            continue
 951        reason = capability_skip_reason(doc, agent, role)
 952        if reason in (None, "explicit override"):
 953            if role == "review" and agent == doc.get("implementer"):
 954                reason = "implemented this change; audit must be independent"
 955            elif state["state"] == "UNAVAILABLE":
 956                reason = "unavailable"
 957            elif role == "acceptance":
 958                reason = "not the session orchestrator"
 959            elif any(item["stage"] == role and item["agent"] == agent and timed_out(doc, role, agent, item["model"])
 960                     for item in doc.get("timed_out_assignments", [])):
 961                reason = (f"timed out at the {execution_budget(doc, role)}s execution budget; a retry needs a changed "
 962                          "budget, model, or scope (capacity unaffected)")
 963            else:
 964                reason = "no usable model remains"
 965        found.append({"agent": agent, "reason": reason})
 966    return found
 967
 968
 969def candidates(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
 970    agents = {agent: agent_record(doc, agent) for agent in AGENTS}
 971    lead = doc["orchestrator"]
 972    order = list(AGENTS)
 973    if lead != "AUTO":
 974        order.remove(lead)
 975        order.insert(0, lead)
 976    if role == "review" and doc.get("implementer") in order:
 977        order.remove(doc["implementer"])
 978    if doc["strategy"] == "ECONOMY":
 979        order.sort(key=lambda value: (value not in ("agy", "cursor"), value != lead))
 980    elif doc["strategy"] == "QUALITY":
 981        order.sort(key=lambda value: (value not in ("claude_code", "codex"), value != lead))
 982    if role in {"planning", "acceptance"} and lead != "AUTO" and lead in order:
 983        order.remove(lead)
 984        order.insert(0, lead)
 985    if (is_mutating_role(role) and doc.get("requested_orchestrator", "AUTO") == "AUTO"
 986            and doc["strategy"] != "ECONOMY" and IMPLEMENTATION_PREFERENCE in order):
 987        # Only when the user chose no orchestrator: otherwise the AUTO-selected planner also
 988        # implements. Claude-implemented sessions converged 1 of 4 under falsifying review,
 989        # Codex-implemented ones 6 of 6 (DOG-023); the others stay in order as fallbacks.
 990        order.remove(IMPLEMENTATION_PREFERENCE)
 991        order.insert(0, IMPLEMENTATION_PREFERENCE)
 992    if role == "acceptance":
 993        # Only the orchestrator accepts, unless it has been disqualified for a reason unrelated to
 994        # the work (capability, availability, capacity). Then the next eligible agent takes over so
 995        # the session cannot deadlock (DOG-010).
 996        # A verdict from ANY agent is final until the repository changes: shopping a rejection around
 997        # until some agent accepts is a false success (run-007, where Codex rejected and Cursor accepted).
 998        judged = any(agent_record(doc, agent)["capacity"].get("acceptance", {}).get("reason") in VERDICT_FAILURES
 999                     for agent in AGENTS)
1000        if lead == "AUTO" or judged:
1001            order = order[:1]
1002    selected = []
1003    for agent in order:
1004        state = agents[agent]["state"]
1005        skip_reason = capability_skip_reason(doc, agent, role)
1006        explicit_override = skip_reason == "explicit override"
1007        if state == "RESERVED" or state not in {"AVAILABLE", "DEGRADED"}:
1008            continue
1009        if skip_reason and not explicit_override:
1010            continue
1011        configured = doc["role_models"].get(role, {}).get(agent, "AUTO")
1012        discovered = agents[agent]["models"]
1013        if configured != "AUTO":
1014            if configured not in discovered and configured not in doc.get("known_models", {}).get(agent, []):
1015                continue
1016            models = [configured]
1017        else:
1018            models = discovered or ["UNKNOWN"]
1019        for model in models[:2]:
1020            if doc["model_states"].get(f"{agent}:{model}") != "EXHAUSTED" and not timed_out(doc, role, agent, model):
1021                selected.append((agent, model))
1022    fallback = [] if role == "acceptance" else doc.get("fallbacks", {}).get(role, [])
1023    if fallback:
1024        for item in fallback:
1025            agent, model = item.split(":", 1)
1026            skip_reason = capability_skip_reason(doc, agent, role)
1027            if agents[agent]["state"] == "AVAILABLE" and skip_reason in (None, "explicit override") and (
1028                model == "UNKNOWN" or model in agents[agent]["models"]
1029                or model in doc.get("known_models", {}).get(agent, [])
1030            ) and doc["model_states"].get(item) != "EXHAUSTED" and not timed_out(doc, role, agent, model):
1031                selected.append((agent, model))
1032        rank = {item: index for index, item in enumerate(fallback)}
1033        selected.sort(key=lambda pair: rank.get(f"{pair[0]}:{pair[1]}", len(rank)))
1034    return list(dict.fromkeys(selected))[:8]
1035
1036
1037def question(label: str, default: str) -> str:
1038    answer = input(f"{label} [{default}]: ").strip()
1039    return answer or default
1040
1041
1042def setup(args: argparse.Namespace, repo: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
1043    interactive = sys.stdin.isatty() and not args.input
1044    goal = args.input or (question("1. Goal", "") if interactive else "")
1045    if not goal:
1046        raise ValueError("A goal is required")
1047    lead = args.orchestrator or (question("2. Orchestrator (AUTO/agent)", "AUTO") if interactive else "AUTO")
1048    availability_text = question("3. Agent availability (AUTO or agent=RESERVED,...)", "AUTO") if interactive else "AUTO"
1049    availability = {agent: "AUTO" for agent in AGENTS}
1050    if availability_text != "AUTO":
1051        for item in availability_text.split(","):
1052            pair = item.strip().split("=", 1)
1053            if len(pair) != 2 or pair[0] not in AGENTS:
1054                raise ValueError("Expected agent=RESERVED or agent=UNAVAILABLE")
1055            availability[pair[0]] = pair[1].upper()
1056    for agent in AGENTS:
1057        option = getattr(args, agent)
1058        if option:
1059            availability[agent] = option
1060    strategy = args.strategy or (question("4. Strategy (BALANCED/ECONOMY/QUALITY)", "BALANCED") if interactive else "BALANCED")
1061    model_text = args.models or (question("5. Role models (AUTO or role:agent:model)", "AUTO") if interactive else "AUTO")
1062    fallback_text = args.fallbacks or (question("6. Ordered fallback (AUTO or role:agent:model,...)", "AUTO") if interactive else "AUTO")
1063    failover = args.failover or (question("7. Failover (AUTO REROUTE/OFF)", "AUTO REROUTE") if interactive else "AUTO REROUTE")
1064    policy = args.policy or (question("8. Execution policy", "PLAN + EXECUTE + INDEPENDENT AUDIT") if interactive else "PLAN + EXECUTE + INDEPENDENT AUDIT")
1065    if lead != "AUTO" and lead not in AGENTS:
1066        raise ValueError("Unsupported orchestrator")
1067    if strategy not in {"BALANCED", "ECONOMY", "QUALITY"} or failover not in {"AUTO REROUTE", "OFF"}:
1068        raise ValueError("Unsupported strategy or failover policy")
1069    if policy not in {"PLAN + EXECUTE + INDEPENDENT AUDIT", "PLAN ONLY", "PLAN + EXECUTE"}:
1070        raise ValueError("Unsupported execution policy")
1071    if any(value.upper() not in {"AUTO", "RESERVED", "UNAVAILABLE"} for value in availability.values()):
1072        raise ValueError("Unsupported agent availability")
1073    role_models: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
1074    for role, agent, model in parse_role_model_triples(model_text):
1075        role_models.setdefault(role, {})[agent] = model
1076    fallbacks: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
1077    for role, agent, model in parse_role_model_triples(fallback_text):
1078        fallbacks.setdefault(role, []).append(f"{agent}:{model}")
1079    budget = {**default_execution_budget(), **parse_execution_budget(getattr(args, "execution_budget", None))}
1080    snapshot = evidence(repo)
1081    token = uuid.uuid4().hex
1082    resolved_policy = workspace_trust.resolve_policy()
1083    agents = inventory(availability, Path(snapshot["root"]), resolved_policy["policy"])
1084    model_states = {f"{agent}:{limit.rsplit(':', 1)[0]}": "EXHAUSTED"
1085                    for agent, record in agents.items() for limit in record["readiness"]["model_limits"]}
1086    if lead != "AUTO" and agents[lead]["state"] != "AVAILABLE":
1087        record = agents[lead]
1088        reason = record.get("unavailable_reason") or record["capabilities"].get("reason") or record["state"]
1089        raise OperatorFailure(OperatorError(
1090            "ORCHESTRATOR_UNAVAILABLE", f"The selected orchestrator {lead} is not available ({reason}).",
1091            "HowlPlane's readiness evidence for this agent says it cannot run unattended right now.",
1092            "Pick another agent, use AUTO, or refresh the evidence for this agent.",
1093            f"howlplane agents doctor --live --repo {repo}"))
1094    if lead != "AUTO" and (agents[lead].get("workspace_trust") or {}).get("effective_state") == workspace_trust.TRUST_REQUIRED:
1095        raise ValueError(f"Selected orchestrator {AGENT_NAMES.get(lead, lead)} does not trust {snapshot['root']} yet "
1096                         f"(workspace trust policy {resolved_policy['policy']}); prepare it with `howlplane factory prepare` "
1097                         "or choose `--workspace-trust bypass`")
1098    return {
1099        "schema": SCHEMA, "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION, "id": uuid.uuid4().hex, "created_at": now(), "repository": snapshot["root"],
1100        "goal": redact(goal), "constraints": [redact(item) for item in args.constraint],
1101        "requested_orchestrator": lead, "selected_orchestrator": None if lead == "AUTO" else lead,
1102        "orchestrator": lead, "agents": agents, "strategy": strategy,
1103        "role_models": role_models, "fallbacks": fallbacks,
1104        "failover": failover, "policy": policy, "status": "PLANNED", "stage": "planning",
1105        "model_states": model_states, "known_models": {}, "attempts": [], "tests": [], "reroutes": [],
1106        "execution_budget": budget, "timed_out_assignments": [], "workspace_trust_policy": resolved_policy,
1107        "verify_command": args.verify,
1108        "repository_evidence": snapshot, "base_dirty": dirty_paths(Path(snapshot["root"])),
1109        "lease": {"token": token, "pid": os.getpid(), "renewed_at": time.time()},
1110    }
1111
1112
1113def audit_evidence_for_acceptance(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
1114    """Hand the acceptance worker the independent audit it is told to weigh.
1115
1116    Review verdicts exist only in the session manifest; without them an
1117    orchestrator that is told to inspect the audit can only reject for missing
1118    evidence (DOG-002). Superseded findings are included so a later CLEAN
1119    verdict never silently hides them.
1120    """
1121    reviews = [item for item in doc["attempts"] if item.get("stage") == "review" and item.get("verdict_excerpt") is not None]
1122    if not reviews:
1123        return ""
1124    lines = [" Independent audit evidence recorded by HowlPlane (verdicts from reviewers other than you):"]
1125    for item in reviews:
1126        no_verdict = item.get("failure") == "AUDIT_NO_VERDICT"
1127        earlier_round = item.get("rework_round", 0) < doc.get("rework_rounds", 0)
1128        outcome = ("NO VERDICT (provider returned no text; not a finding, do not treat as unresolved)" if no_verdict else
1129                   f"FINDINGS FROM REWORK ROUND {item.get('rework_round', 0)}; the implementer was sent back to address them and "
1130                   "the work was re-reviewed. Judge by the latest review, and check whether these were actually fixed" if earlier_round and item.get("state") != "SUCCEEDED" else
1131                   "ACCEPTED AS CLEAN" if item.get("state") == "SUCCEEDED" else f"NOT CLEAN ({item.get('failure')})")
1132        excerpt = item["verdict_excerpt"].strip()[-AUDIT_EVIDENCE_CHARS:] or "(reviewer returned no text)"
1133        lines.append(f"\n--- {AGENT_NAMES.get(item['agent'], item['agent'])} review, {outcome} ---\n{excerpt}")
1134    return "".join(lines) + "\n--- end of audit evidence ---"
1135
1136
1137# Any finding at all used to block the audit, and a falsifying reviewer always
1138# finds something new, so bounded rework could never converge (DOG-013).
1139# Non-blocking notes still reach acceptance through the stored verdict text.
1140REVIEW_VERDICT_CONTRACT = (
1141    "Classify every finding as BLOCKING or NON-BLOCKING. BLOCKING means: incorrect behavior, a goal requirement "
1142    "not met, required behavior without working tests, a failing test, or documentation or evidence that is false. "
1143    "Hardening ideas, style, unlikely edge cases, and residual risks are NON-BLOCKING. End with exactly "
1144    "AUDIT_STATUS: FINDINGS if any BLOCKING finding remains; otherwise end with exactly AUDIT_STATUS: CLEAN.")
1145
1146
1147def verification_evidence_for_review(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
1148    """Give the reviewer the checks HowlPlane itself ran on the current tree.
1149
1150    Read-only reviewers often have no shell, so without this they report the
1151    test gate as unproven (DOG-014). `doc["tests"]` is cleared whenever the
1152    repository changes outside the session, and every review directly follows
1153    a verification, so the latest result per command describes this tree.
1154    """
1155    latest: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
1156    for item in doc.get("tests", []):
1157        command = item["command"] if isinstance(item["command"], str) else " ".join(item["command"])
1158        latest[command] = item
1159    if not latest:
1160        return ""
1161    lines = [" HowlPlane itself ran these checks on the current tree (harness evidence, not implementer claims):"]
1162    for command, item in latest.items():
1163        lines.append(f"\n--- `{command}` exit {item['exit_code']} ---\n{item.get('output', '').strip()[-600:]}")
1164    return "".join(lines) + "\n--- end of verification evidence ---"
1165
1166
1167PLAN_VERIFY_CONTRACT = (
1168    " End the plan with one line VERIFY_COMMAND: <the single command, run from the repository root, that will run "
1169    "the project's automated tests once implemented>, with no pipes, redirections, or chained commands; or "
1170    "VERIFY_COMMAND: NONE if the goal needs no tests.")
1171_VERIFY_LINE = re.compile(r"^\s*VERIFY_COMMAND:\s*(.+?)\s*$", re.MULTILINE)
1172
1173
1174def planned_verify_command(plan: str) -> list[str] | None:
1175    """The plan's test command, if it named one HowlPlane may grant (DOG-018).
1176
1177    The implementer of a new repository is granted this command, so it is held to
1178    the same deny floor as a discovered command: anything that floor refuses,
1179    or that carries shell operators, is ignored rather than granted.
1180    """
1181    matches = _VERIFY_LINE.findall(plan or "")
1182    if not matches:
1183        return None
1184    text = matches[-1].strip().strip("`").strip()
1185    if not text or text.upper() == "NONE":
1186        return None
1187    try:
1188        command = shlex.split(text)
1189    except ValueError:
1190        return None
1191    if not command or any(marker in text for marker in ("&", ";", "|", "$", "`", ">", "<")):
1192        return None
1193    return command if command_to_bash_specifier(command) else None
1194
1195
1196def implementation_verify_command(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str] | None:
1197    """The test command the implementer is told about and, for bounded shells, granted."""
1198    return doc.get("verify_command") or doc.get("planned_verify_command")
1199
1200
1201def execute_assignment(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str, agent: str, model: str, repo: Path) -> Any:
1202    instructions = (
1203        f"Goal: {doc['goal']}\nRole: {role}. Work only in {repo}. "
1204        # Told nothing, workers re-ran `howlplane route` and copied this session's manifest, lease token
1205        # included, into the user's repository to show "the normal Howl workflow" (DOG-025, run-027).
1206        f"You are working inside HowlPlane orchestration session {doc['id'][:8]}, which is the Howl workflow for "
1207        "this goal: HowlPlane itself runs planning, routing, independent review, and acceptance. Do not run howl or "
1208        "howlplane commands, and do not read HowlPlane's state files or copy them into the repository. "
1209        "Report files changed, tests run, remaining risks, and completion status. "
1210        "Respect repository rules. Do not commit, push, publish, or change other worktrees. "
1211        f"Constraints: {'; '.join(doc['constraints']) or 'none'}. "
1212    )
1213    plan = doc.get("plan_excerpt")
1214    if plan and role in {"review", "acceptance"}:
1215        instructions += ("HowlPlane's planning stage made this approach decision; it is the workflow evidence, so judge the "
1216                         "work against it and do not require workflow artifacts in the repository:\n" + plan + "\n")
1217    if role == "review":
1218        instructions += ("Independently inspect the current diff and falsify correctness. Do not edit files. "
1219                         + REVIEW_VERDICT_CONTRACT + verification_evidence_for_review(doc) + session_diff_evidence(doc, repo))
1220    elif role == "acceptance":
1221        instructions += "As session orchestrator, inspect implementation, tests, and independent audit. Do not edit files. End with exactly ACCEPTANCE_STATUS: ACCEPTED only if evidence supports the goal; otherwise end with ACCEPTANCE_STATUS: REJECTED."
1222        instructions += audit_evidence_for_acceptance(doc) + session_diff_evidence(doc, repo)
1223        if (doc.get("rework") or {}).get("source") == "acceptance":
1224            instructions += (f" An earlier acceptance check rejected the work and the implementer was sent back to address it "
1225                             f"(rework round {doc['rework']['round']}). Judge the current repository, and check whether "
1226                             "these reasons were actually resolved:\n" + doc["rework"]["findings"])
1227    elif role == "implementation":
1228        if plan:
1229            instructions += ("HowlPlane's planning stage produced this plan; follow it unless the repository shows it is "
1230                             "wrong, and say where you departed from it:\n" + plan + "\n")
1231        instructions += ("Implement the goal and run relevant local tests. Inspect existing partial changes first. Before "
1232                         "finishing, check that every behavior your documentation promises holds for all inputs it "
1233                         "covers, error cases included, and that its examples run in the order shown.")
1234        verify = implementation_verify_command(doc)
1235        if verify:
1236            # Backticks delimit it: a bare `-t .` followed by the sentence's full stop was run as `-t ..` (DOG-020).
1237            instructions += (f" The plan's test command is `{shlex.join(verify)}`. Make it pass and run it exactly as "
1238                             "written, without pipes or redirections.")
1239        if doc.get("rework"):
1240            source = {"acceptance": "The acceptance check", "verification": "HowlPlane's verification run"}.get(
1241                doc["rework"].get("source"), "Independent review")
1242            # A finding is one reproduced instance; patching only that instance left the same false claim for the
1243            # next review to find, until rework ran out (DOG-021, runs 019 and 021).
1244            instructions += (f" {source} (rework round {doc['rework']['round']}) found issues with the current work. Treat "
1245                             "each valid finding as an example of a defect class: fix its root cause, check the other inputs "
1246                             "and error paths the same code or documented claim covers, and add regression tests for them. "
1247                             "Run the tests again, and state which findings you rejected and why. If no change is warranted, "
1248                             "report IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS: NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED with your reasons. Findings:\n"
1249                             + doc["rework"]["findings"])
1250        if is_existing_wip_context(doc["goal"], doc.get("constraints", [])):
1251            instructions += (" Treat current repository changes as intentional work in progress. "
1252                             "If existing changes completely satisfy the goal and no further edits are required, "
1253                             "verify them against local tests and report IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS: NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED.")
1254    else:
1255        instructions += "Produce a bounded implementation plan and acceptance criteria. Do not edit files."
1256        if doc["policy"] != "PLAN ONLY":
1257            instructions += PLAN_VERIFY_CONTRACT
1258    if agent == "claude_code" and not is_mutating_role(role):
1259        # Claude's read-only roles hold Read, Grep and Glob but no shell; a
1260        # shell attempt is denied and fails the assignment, which then marks
1261        # the agent interactive-only for the whole session (DOG-004).
1262        instructions += " Shell commands are unavailable in this role: use only the Read, Grep and Glob tools to inspect files."
1263    elif agent == "claude_code":
1264        # Claude's shell is bounded to granted test commands and read-only Git; a
1265        # refused shell write fails the attempt even if Claude recovers (DOG-018).
1266        instructions += (" Create and change files only with the Edit and Write tools, and inspect them with Read, Glob "
1267                         "and Grep: the shell is limited to the project's test commands and read-only git commands, one "
1268                         "command per call (chained commands are refused), and anything else is refused.")
1269    if any(item.get("stage") == role and item.get("state") == "TIMED_OUT" and item.get("partial_changes") for item in doc["attempts"]):
1270        instructions += (" An earlier attempt at this role reached its execution budget and left partial changes: "
1271                         "inspect and continue them rather than starting over.")
1272    if model != "UNKNOWN":
1273        instructions += f" Use model {model} if the CLI supports selecting it; report actual model identity."
1274    task = TaskSpec(task_id=doc["id"], repository=str(repo), objective=doc["goal"], constraints=doc["constraints"])
1275    if is_mutating_role(role) and implementation_verify_command(doc):
1276        # A bounded shell (Claude) is granted this command alongside any it discovers (DOG-018).
1277        task.metadata["verification_commands"] = [implementation_verify_command(doc)]
1278    backend = AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(agent)
1279    extra: dict[str, Any] = {}
1280    parameters = inspect.signature(backend.execute).parameters
1281    if "workspace_trust_policy" in parameters or any(
1282            item.kind == inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD for item in parameters.values()):
1283        # Built-in CLI backends apply the session's trust policy; a custom
1284        # backend with a fixed signature keeps its bounded contract.
1285        extra["workspace_trust_policy"] = session_trust_policy(doc)
1286    return backend.execute(task, repo, role=role, prompt_override=instructions,
1287                           timeout_seconds=execution_budget(doc, role), model_id=model, **extra)
1288
1289
1290def checkpoint(doc: dict[str, Any], path: Path, token: str, repo: Path) -> None:
1291    doc["repository_evidence"] = evidence(repo)
1292    doc["lease"]["renewed_at"] = time.time()
1293    with locked(path.parent):
1294        save(path, doc, token)
1295
1296
1297def derive_verify_command(repo: Path) -> list[str] | None:
1298    """The repository's own test command, as HowlPlane's project discovery finds it (DOG-009)."""
1299    try:
1300        from howlplane.control_plane.project_adapter import ProjectAdapter
1301        commands = ProjectAdapter.discover(repo).test_commands
1302    except Exception:
1303        return None
1304    return list(commands[0]) if commands else None
1305
1306
1307def test_output_excerpt(text: str, limit: int = TEST_OUTPUT_CHARS) -> str:
1308    """Keep the lines that say what failed, plus the tail with the runner's summary."""
1309    text = redact(text)
1310    if len(text) <= limit:
1311        return text
1312    tail = text[-(limit // 2):]
1313    lines = text[:-(limit // 2)].splitlines()
1314    spans: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
1315    for number, line in enumerate(lines):
1316        if _FAILURE_LINE.search(line):
1317            start, end = max(number - 1, 0), min(number + 12, len(lines))
1318            if spans and start <= spans[-1][1]:
1319                spans[-1] = (spans[-1][0], end)
1320            else:
1321                spans.append((start, end))
1322    if not spans:
1323        return "[... earlier output trimmed by HowlPlane ...]\n" + text[-limit:]
1324    budget, parts = limit - len(tail), []
1325    for start, end in spans:
1326        block = "\n".join(lines[start:end])
1327        if len(block) > budget:
1328            if not parts:
1329                parts.append(block[:budget])
1330            break
1331        parts.append(block)
1332        budget -= len(block)
1333    return "\n[...]\n".join(parts) + "\n[... output trimmed by HowlPlane; tail follows ...]\n" + tail
1334
1335
1336def run_verification(doc: dict[str, Any], repo: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
1337    """Run the session's verification command and return its test record.
1338
1339    A command that cannot start or overruns its deadline is a verification
1340    result, not a crash: the record says so in place of the runner's output.
1341    """
1342    command = doc["verify_command"]
1343    record: dict[str, Any] = {"command": command, "rework_round": doc.get("rework_rounds", 0)}
1344    try:
1345        verified = subprocess.run(command, cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=VERIFY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
1346    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
1347        partial = "".join(part.decode(errors="replace") if isinstance(part, bytes) else part
1348                          for part in (exc.stdout, exc.stderr) if part)
1349        record.update(exit_code=124, timed_out=True, output=test_output_excerpt(
1350            f"{partial}\nHowlPlane stopped the command after {VERIFY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s."))
1351    except OSError as exc:
1352        record.update(exit_code=127, not_runnable=True, output=redact(f"HowlPlane could not run the command: {exc}"))
1353    else:
1354        record.update(exit_code=verified.returncode, output=test_output_excerpt(verified.stdout + verified.stderr))
1355    return record
1356
1357
1358def verification_findings(record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
1359    """Shape a failed verification like a verdict, so it can drive the bounded rework loop."""
1360    command = record["command"] if isinstance(record["command"], str) else shlex.join(record["command"])
1361    return {"agent": "howlplane", "stage": "verification",
1362            "verdict_excerpt": f"HowlPlane ran `{command}` on the implemented tree and it exited {record['exit_code']}. "
1363                               f"Make it pass. Its output (failures first):\n{record.get('output', '')}"}
1364
1365
1366def validation_failure_reason(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
1367    failure = doc["validation_failure"]
1368    command = failure["command"] if isinstance(failure["command"], str) else shlex.join(failure["command"])
1369    if failure.get("not_runnable"):
1370        return f"Configured validation could not run: `{command}` (check the command and its tools are installed)"
1371    return (f"Configured validation failed: `{command}` exited {failure['exit_code']} after "
1372            f"{failure['rework_rounds']} of {MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS} rework round(s)")
1373
1374
1375def begin_rework(doc: dict[str, Any], findings: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1376    """Send review findings, an acceptance rejection, or a failed verification back to implementation
1377    (bounded by MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS)."""
1378    doc["rework_rounds"] = doc.get("rework_rounds", 0) + 1
1379    doc["rework"] = {"round": doc["rework_rounds"], "reviewer": findings["agent"], "source": findings["stage"],
1380                     "findings": findings["verdict_excerpt"], "at": now()}
1381    doc["previous_implementer"] = doc.pop("implementer", None)
1382    doc.pop("audit", None)
1383
1384
1385VERDICT_FAILURES = frozenset({"AUDIT_FINDINGS_OR_UNCONFIRMED", "AUDIT_NO_VERDICT", "ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED"})
1386
1387
1388def expire_verdict_exclusions(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1389    """Drop review/acceptance exclusions that were verdicts on a repository state that no longer exists.
1390
1391    A rejection judges one state of the work. Once the repository has changed (for
1392    example the user fixed what the verdict named), the same agent must be able to
1393    judge the new state, or `resume` finds no acceptance worker (DOG-007).
1394    """
1395    for agent in AGENTS:
1396        state = agent_record(doc, agent)
1397        for role in ("review", "acceptance"):
1398            if state["capacity"].get(role, {}).get("reason") in VERDICT_FAILURES:
1399                del state["capacity"][role]
1400        if (state["state"] == "DEGRADED" and not state["capacity"]
1401                and state["capabilities"]["unattended_execution"] is not False):
1402            state["state"] = "AVAILABLE"
1403    doc.pop("audit", None)
1404    doc.pop("acceptance", None)
1405    doc.pop("exclusions", None)
1406
1407
1408def reconcile(doc: dict[str, Any], repo: Path) -> None:
1409    if doc["attempts"] and doc["attempts"][-1].get("state") == "ASSIGNED":
1410        doc["attempts"][-1].update({"state": "REVOKED", "failure": "INTERRUPTED_OR_STALE_LEASE", "finished_at": now()})
1411    actual = evidence(repo)
1412    previous = doc["repository_evidence"]
1413    if fingerprint(actual) != fingerprint(previous):
1414        doc["reconciliation"] = {"recorded": fingerprint(previous), "actual": fingerprint(actual), "at": now(), "needs_validation": True}
1415        doc["tests"] = []
1416        doc["stage"] = "implementation" if doc["policy"] != "PLAN ONLY" else "planning"
1417        expire_verdict_exclusions(doc)
1418    doc["repository_evidence"] = actual
1419
1420
1421def run(doc: dict[str, Any], path: Path, repo: Path, progress: SessionProgress | None = None) -> int:
1422    token = doc["lease"]["token"]
1423    stages = ["planning"] if doc["policy"] == "PLAN ONLY" else ["planning", "implementation"]
1424    if doc["policy"] == "PLAN + EXECUTE + INDEPENDENT AUDIT":
1425        stages.append("review")
1426    if doc["policy"] != "PLAN ONLY":
1427        stages.append("acceptance")
1428    index = stages.index(doc["stage"]) if doc["stage"] in stages else 0
1429    while index < len(stages):
1430        stage = stages[index]
1431        index += 1
1432        doc["stage"] = stage
1433        doc["status"] = stage.upper()
1434        checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1435        if progress:
1436            progress.phase(stage, {"planning": "Building implementation plan", "implementation": "Dispatching implementation worker", "review": "Independent audit started", "acceptance": "Orchestrator validating final result"}[stage])
1437            notices = doc.setdefault("capability_notices", [])
1438            for candidate in AGENTS:
1439                reason = capability_skip_reason(doc, candidate, stage)
1440                # Session-wide reasons are announced once; capacity is per role.
1441                notice = f"{candidate}:{reason}" if reason in ("explicit override", "unattended execution unavailable") else f"{candidate}:{stage}:{reason}"
1442                if reason in (None, "reserved") or notice in notices:
1443                    continue
1444                if reason == "explicit override":
1445                    progress.explicit_override_warning(candidate)
1446                else:
1447                    progress.route_skip(candidate, reason)
1448                notices.append(notice)
1449
1450        def eligible() -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
1451            options = candidates(doc, stage)
1452            return [pair for pair in options if not (stage == "review" and pair[0] == doc.get("implementer"))]
1453
1454        succeeded = False
1455        findings_attempt: dict[str, Any] | None = None
1456        transient_retries: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}
1457        attempted: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
1458        retry: tuple[str, str] | None = None
1459        prev_reroute: tuple[str, str] | None = None
1460
1461        if stage == "implementation":
1462            if doc.get("implementer"):
1463                # Implementation already completed or previously succeeded
1464                succeeded = True
1465            elif doc.get("reconciliation", {}).get("needs_validation") and doc.get("verify_command"):
1466                check = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *guarded_git_args(["diff", "--check"])], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
1467                if check.returncode == 0:
1468                    verified = run_verification(doc, repo)
1469                    if verified["exit_code"] == 0:
1470                        doc["implementer"] = "external"
1471                        doc["tests"].append({"command": "git diff --check", "exit_code": check.returncode, "output": redact(check.stderr[:500])})
1472                        doc["tests"].append(verified)
1473                        doc["reconciliation"]["needs_validation"] = False
1474                        doc.pop("validation_failure", None)
1475                        succeeded = True
1476
1477        while not succeeded:
1478            # Candidates are recomputed from session evidence after every
1479            # failure, so the next assignment (and the REROUTE naming it) never
1480            # reflects a list selected before the failure was recorded.
1481            if retry:
1482                agent, model = retry
1483                retry = None
1484            else:
1485                pending = [pair for pair in eligible() if pair not in attempted]
1486                if not pending:
1487                    break
1488                # After a deadline stop, prefer a different worker; the timed-out
1489                # agent's other models stay eligible, just behind the rest.
1490                slow = {item["agent"] for item in doc["timed_out_assignments"] if item["stage"] == stage}
1491                pending.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[0] in slow)
1492                agent, model = pending[0]
1493            attempted.append((agent, model))
1494            if prev_reroute and progress:
1495                source_agent, reason = prev_reroute
1496                progress.reroute(doc["id"][:8], source_agent, agent, reason)
1497                prev_reroute = None
1498            before = evidence(repo)
1499            invocation_policy = session_trust_policy(doc)
1500            assignment = {"task_id": doc["id"][:8], "stage": stage, "agent": agent, "model": model, "started_at": now(), "fence": token, "state": "ASSIGNED",
1501                          "rework_round": doc.get("rework_rounds", 0),
1502                          "workspace_trust": {"policy": invocation_policy,
1503                                              "mechanism": workspace_trust.mechanism(agent, invocation_policy)},
1504                          "execution_budget_seconds": execution_budget(doc, stage), "selection_evidence": selection_evidence(doc, agent)}
1505            doc["attempts"].append(assignment)
1506            checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1507            if progress:
1508                progress.selection(agent, stage, assignment["selection_evidence"])
1509                progress.assignment(doc["id"][:8], agent, stage)
1510                progress._write("START", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} started {stage}")
1511                with progress.waiting():
1512                    result = execute_assignment(doc, stage, agent, model, repo)
1513            else:
1514                result = execute_assignment(doc, stage, agent, model, repo)
1515            failure = ProviderPoolManager.classify_result(agent, result)
1516            after = evidence(repo)
1517            assignment.update({"state": "SUCCEEDED" if result.success else "REVOKED", "exit_code": result.exit_code,
1518                               "failure": None if result.success else failure.value, "finished_at": now(),
1519                               "repo_before": fingerprint(before), "repo_after": fingerprint(after),
1520                               "output_sha256": fingerprint({"stdout": result.stdout}),
1521                               "error": redact((result.error_message or result.stderr)[:200])})
1522            no_change_detail = ""
1523            if result.success and stage == "implementation" and before == after:
1524                is_wip = is_existing_wip_context(doc["goal"], doc.get("constraints", [])) or bool(doc.get("rework"))
1525                has_repo_wip = bool(before.get("status", "").strip())
1526                stdout_text = result.stdout or ""
1527                reports_no_change = bool(
1528                    re.search(r"\b(?:IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS:\s*)?NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED\b", stdout_text, re.IGNORECASE)
1529                    or re.search(r"\bno (?:further |additional )?changes? (?:are )?(?:needed|required)\b", stdout_text, re.IGNORECASE)
1530                    or re.search(r"\bexisting (?:changes|work) (?:already )?(?:satisfies?|satisfy|completes?|complete)\b", stdout_text, re.IGNORECASE)
1531                )
1532                accepted_no_change = False
1533                if has_repo_wip and (is_wip or reports_no_change):
1534                    check = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *guarded_git_args(["diff", "--check"])], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
1535                    verified_ok = True
1536                    if doc.get("verify_command"):
1537                        verified_ok = run_verification(doc, repo)["exit_code"] == 0
1538                    if check.returncode == 0 and verified_ok:
1539                        accepted_no_change = True
1540                        assignment["state"] = "SUCCEEDED"
1541                        assignment["failure"] = None
1542                        assignment["outcome"] = "NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED"
1543                        if progress:
1544                            progress._write("WIP", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} verified existing WIP: NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED")
1545
1546                if not accepted_no_change:
1547                    assignment["state"] = "REVOKED"
1548                    assignment["failure"] = "NO_REPOSITORY_CHANGE"
1549                    no_change_detail = " (no repository delta detected)"
1550            if stage in {"review", "acceptance"} and before != after:
1551                assignment["state"] = "REVOKED"
1552                assignment["failure"] = "READ_ONLY_ROLE_MUTATED_REPOSITORY"
1553            if result.success and stage == "review" and not result.stdout.strip().endswith("AUDIT_STATUS: CLEAN"):
1554                assignment["state"] = "REVOKED"
1555                # An empty reply is a provider fault, not a finding (DOG-003).
1556                assignment["failure"] = "AUDIT_FINDINGS_OR_UNCONFIRMED" if result.stdout.strip() else "AUDIT_NO_VERDICT"
1557            if result.success and stage == "acceptance" and not result.stdout.strip().endswith("ACCEPTANCE_STATUS: ACCEPTED"):
1558                assignment["state"] = "REVOKED"
1559                assignment["failure"] = "ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED"
1560            grant_gap = (permission_grant_gap(result, stage, before != after)
1561                         if assignment["failure"] == "EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED" else [])
1562            if grant_gap:
1563                assignment["denied_commands"] = [redact(command) for command in grant_gap]
1564            if result.success and stage in {"review", "acceptance"}:
1565                # The verdict is the only record of why a reviewer or the
1566                # orchestrator stopped the session; the hash alone cannot be read.
1567                assignment["verdict_excerpt"] = redact((result.stdout or "").strip()[-VERDICT_EXCERPT_CHARS:])
1568            if assignment["failure"] in ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_FAILURES:
1569                metadata = getattr(result, "metadata", None) or {}
1570                budget = execution_budget(doc, stage)
1571                assignment.update({"state": "TIMED_OUT", "execution_budget_seconds": budget,
1572                                   "timeout_source": metadata.get("timeout_source"),
1573                                   "budget_derived": metadata.get("budget_derived") is True,
1574                                   "partial_changes": before != after})
1575                record_timeout(doc, stage, agent, model, budget, assignment["timeout_source"], assignment["finished_at"])
1576                if progress:
1577                    progress.attempt_timed_out(agent, stage, budget, before != after)
1578            if assignment["failure"] in WORKSPACE_TRUST_FAILURES:
1579                assignment["workspace"] = str(repo)
1580                agent_readiness.record_workspace_trust(agent, str(repo), stage, "orchestrate session",
1581                                                       policy=invocation_policy)
1582            elif assignment["failure"] is None or assignment["failure"] in UNAVAILABLE_FAILURES | MODEL_LIMIT_FAILURES | (
1583                    {"EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED"} if is_mutating_role(stage) and not grant_gap else set()):
1584                agent_readiness.record_session_outcome(agent, model, assignment["failure"],
1585                                                       detail=f"{result.error_message or ''}\n{result.stderr}")
1586            if assignment["state"] == "SUCCEEDED":
1587                record_capability_success(doc, agent)
1588                if stage == "planning":
1589                    doc["planned_verify_command"] = planned_verify_command(result.stdout)
1590                    doc["plan_excerpt"] = redact((result.stdout or "").strip()[-PLAN_EXCERPT_CHARS:])
1591                    doc["orchestrator"] = agent
1592                    doc["selected_orchestrator"] = agent
1593                    if progress and doc.get("requested_orchestrator") == "AUTO":
1594                        progress.selected_orchestrator(agent)
1595                if stage == "implementation":
1596                    doc["implementer"] = agent
1597                if stage == "review":
1598                    doc["audit"] = "CLEAN"
1599                if stage == "acceptance":
1600                    doc["acceptance"] = "ACCEPTED"
1601                    if agent != doc["orchestrator"]:
1602                        if progress:
1603                            progress._write("TAKEOVER", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(doc['orchestrator'], doc['orchestrator'])} could not accept; "
1604                                                        f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} is now orchestrator")
1605                        doc["orchestrator"] = doc["selected_orchestrator"] = agent
1606                if model != "UNKNOWN":
1607                    doc["known_models"].setdefault(agent, []).append(model)
1608                succeeded = True
1609                checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1610                if progress:
1611                    progress.worker_complete(doc["id"][:8], agent, stage)
1612                break
1613            if stage == "review" and assignment["failure"] == "AUDIT_FINDINGS_OR_UNCONFIRMED" and assignment.get("verdict_excerpt"):
1614                # Real findings are not a worker fault: asking another reviewer until one says CLEAN would hide
1615                # them. The reviewer stays eligible; the findings go back to the implementer or end the session.
1616                findings_attempt = assignment
1617                if progress:
1618                    progress._write("FINDINGS", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} review reported findings")
1619                checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1620                break
1621            if (stage == "acceptance" and assignment["failure"] == "ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED"
1622                    and assignment.get("verdict_excerpt") and "implementation" in stages
1623                    and doc.get("rework_rounds", 0) < MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS):
1624                # A reasoned rejection is actionable (DOG-016): rework it, then the same orchestrator judges
1625                # the changed repository. It is never shopped to another acceptor (DOG-010); once rework is
1626                # spent, the failure path below records it and hands off.
1627                findings_attempt = assignment
1628                if progress:
1629                    progress._write("FINDINGS", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} acceptance rejected; reasons go back to implementation")
1630                checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1631                break
1632            doc["reroutes"].append({"from": f"{agent}:{model}", "stage": stage, "reason": assignment["failure"]})
1633            if progress:
1634                progress._write("FAIL", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} {stage} failed: {assignment['failure']}{no_change_detail}")
1635            # Record the failure before choosing a replacement: the next
1636            # candidate list must already exclude what this attempt proved.
1637            exclusion = record_failure(doc, agent, stage, model, assignment["failure"], grant_gap=bool(grant_gap))
1638            if progress:
1639                if assignment["failure"] in WORKSPACE_TRUST_FAILURES:
1640                    progress._write("TRUST", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} requires workspace trust for {repo}; "
1641                                             "rerouting (the agent stays eligible elsewhere)")
1642                elif grant_gap:
1643                    progress.permission_gap(agent, stage, assignment["denied_commands"])
1644                elif assignment["failure"] == "EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED" and is_mutating_role(stage):
1645                    progress.capability_downgrade(agent)
1646                elif exclusion:
1647                    progress.role_excluded(agent, stage, exclusion)
1648                if assignment["failure"] in MODEL_LIMIT_FAILURES:
1649                    progress.limit(agent, model, assignment["failure"])
1650                progress.checkpoint(doc["id"][:8])
1651            if before != after:
1652                doc["reconciliation"] = {"at": now(), "needs_validation": True, "from": agent, "stage": stage}
1653            if failure.value == "TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE" and transient_retries.get((agent, model), 0) < 1:
1654                transient_retries[(agent, model)] = transient_retries.get((agent, model), 0) + 1
1655                retry = (agent, model)
1656            elif doc["failover"] != "OFF":
1657                # Defer the progress REROUTE event until the next iteration so
1658                # the reported target is the actual replacement selected from
1659                # the updated eligible candidate list, not a stale intermediate.
1660                prev_reroute = (agent, assignment["failure"])
1661            checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1662            if stage in {"review", "acceptance"} and before != after:
1663                doc["status"] = "BLOCKED"
1664                doc["audit"] = "AUDIT BLOCKED: read-only role changed the repository"
1665                checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1666                return report(doc)
1667            if doc["failover"] == "OFF":
1668                break
1669        if not succeeded and findings_attempt is not None and "implementation" in stages:
1670            if doc.get("rework_rounds", 0) < MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS:
1671                begin_rework(doc, findings_attempt)
1672                if progress:
1673                    progress._write("REWORK", f"Round {doc['rework_rounds']} of {MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS}: sending "
1674                                              f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(findings_attempt['agent'], findings_attempt['agent'])}'s findings back to implementation")
1675                checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1676                index = stages.index("implementation")
1677                continue
1678        if not succeeded:
1679            doc["status"] = "BLOCKED" if stage == "review" else "HANDOFF REQUIRED"
1680            if stage == "review":
1681                if findings_attempt is not None:
1682                    doc["audit"] = (f"AUDIT BLOCKED: review findings remain after {doc.get('rework_rounds', 0)} rework round(s)")
1683                else:
1684                    doc["audit"] = "AUDIT BLOCKED: independent reviewers exhausted" if attempted else "AUDIT BLOCKED: no independent reviewer"
1685            doc["exclusions"] = {"stage": stage, "agents": exclusions(doc, stage)}
1686            stage_timeouts = [item for item in doc["timed_out_assignments"] if item["stage"] == stage]
1687            if stage_timeouts and is_resumable(doc):
1688                doc["timeout_hint"] = (f"{len(stage_timeouts)} {stage} attempt(s) reached the {execution_budget(doc, stage)}s "
1689                                       "execution budget. Decompose the goal, or resume with "
1690                                       f"--execution-budget {stage}=<seconds> (max {MAX_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS}) "
1691                                       "or --retry-timeouts.")
1692            checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1693            if progress:
1694                for item in doc["exclusions"]["agents"]:
1695                    progress.excluded(item["agent"], item["reason"])
1696                reason = doc.get("audit") or f"No eligible {stage} workers remain"
1697                if doc.get("timeout_hint"):
1698                    progress._write("TIMEOUT", doc["timeout_hint"])
1699                resume_cmd = f"howlplane orchestrate resume --repo {repo}" if is_resumable(doc) else None
1700                progress.blocked("AUDIT BLOCKED" if stage == "review" else "HANDOFF REQUIRED", reason, resume_cmd)
1701            return report(doc)
1702        if stage == "implementation":
1703            if progress:
1704                progress.validation(True, "Running repository diff validation")
1705            check = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *guarded_git_args(["diff", "--check"])], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
1706            doc["tests"].append({"command": "git diff --check", "exit_code": check.returncode, "output": redact(check.stderr[:500])})
1707            if progress:
1708                progress.validation(False, "Repository diff validation passed" if check.returncode == 0 else "Repository diff validation failed")
1709            if check.returncode:
1710                doc["status"] = "HANDOFF REQUIRED"
1711                checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1712                if progress:
1713                    progress.blocked("HANDOFF REQUIRED", "Repository diff validation failed", f"howlplane orchestrate resume --repo {repo}" if is_resumable(doc) else None)
1714                return report(doc)
1715            if not doc.get("verify_command"):
1716                derived = derive_verify_command(repo)
1717                if derived:
1718                    # Not user-supplied: record that, so the report and the user can see where it came from.
1719                    doc["verify_command"], doc["verify_source"] = derived, "derived from the project's discovered test command"
1720                    if progress:
1721                        progress._write("VERIFY", f"No --verify given; using the project's test command: {' '.join(derived)}")
1722                elif doc.get("planned_verify_command"):
1723                    # Nothing discoverable (e.g. a plain unittest layout), but the plan named its
1724                    # test command; without it reviewers get no test evidence at all (DOG-019).
1725                    planned = doc["planned_verify_command"]
1726                    doc["verify_command"], doc["verify_source"] = planned, "named by the plan (VERIFY_COMMAND)"
1727                    if progress:
1728                        progress._write("VERIFY", f"No --verify given; using the plan's test command: {' '.join(planned)}")
1729            if doc.get("verify_command"):
1730                command = doc["verify_command"]
1731                if progress:
1732                    progress.validation(True, f"Running configured validation: {' '.join(command)}")
1733                    with progress.waiting():
1734                        verified = run_verification(doc, repo)
1735                else:
1736                    verified = run_verification(doc, repo)
1737                doc["tests"].append(verified)
1738                if progress:
1739                    progress.validation(False, "Configured validation passed" if verified["exit_code"] == 0 else
1740                                        f"Configured validation failed: `{' '.join(command)}` exited {verified['exit_code']}")
1741                if verified["exit_code"]:
1742                    # A failing test is a finding about the implementation, as actionable as a reviewer's;
1743                    # handing off at once left the user to rediscover what HowlPlane had just seen (DOG-026).
1744                    # A command that cannot start is not the implementer's to fix.
1745                    if not verified.get("not_runnable") and doc.get("rework_rounds", 0) < MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS:
1746                        begin_rework(doc, verification_findings(verified))
1747                        if progress:
1748                            progress._write("REWORK", f"Round {doc['rework_rounds']} of {MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS}: sending the "
1749                                                      "failed verification back to implementation")
1750                        checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1751                        index = stages.index("implementation")
1752                        continue
1753                    doc["status"] = "HANDOFF REQUIRED"
1754                    doc["validation_failure"] = {"command": command, "exit_code": verified["exit_code"],
1755                                                 "rework_rounds": doc.get("rework_rounds", 0),
1756                                                 "not_runnable": bool(verified.get("not_runnable"))}
1757                    checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1758                    if progress:
1759                        progress.blocked("HANDOFF REQUIRED", validation_failure_reason(doc),
1760                                         f"howlplane orchestrate resume --repo {repo}" if is_resumable(doc) else None)
1761                    return report(doc)
1762                doc.pop("validation_failure", None)
1763                if doc.get("reconciliation"):
1764                    doc["reconciliation"]["needs_validation"] = False
1765            elif doc.get("reconciliation", {}).get("needs_validation"):
1766                doc["status"] = "HANDOFF REQUIRED"
1767                doc["validation_gap"] = "Partial or recovered changes require an explicit --verify command"
1768                checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1769                if progress:
1770                    progress.blocked("HANDOFF REQUIRED", doc["validation_gap"], f"howlplane orchestrate resume --repo {repo} --verify <command>" if is_resumable(doc) else None)
1771                return report(doc)
1772            checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1773    doc["status"] = "COMPLETE WITH WARNINGS" if doc.get("reconciliation") else "COMPLETE"
1774    checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1775    if progress:
1776        progress.complete(doc["status"])
1777    result = report(doc)
1778    if doc["status"] in {"COMPLETE", "COMPLETE WITH WARNINGS"} and not doc.get("retain_report"):
1779        with locked(path.parent):
1780            path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
1781    return result
1782
