1784def report(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
1785    print("HOWL ORCHESTRATION REPORT")
1786    print(f"Session: {doc['id']}\nGoal: {doc['goal']}\nStatus: {doc['status']}")
1787    print(f"Resumable: {'yes' if is_resumable(doc) else 'no'}")
1788    print(f"Orchestrator: {doc['orchestrator']}\nImplementer: {doc.get('implementer', 'none')}")
1789    print(f"Policy: {doc['policy']}\nConstraints: {', '.join(doc['constraints']) or 'none'}")
1790    print(f"Assignments: {len(doc['attempts'])}\nReroutes: {len(doc['reroutes'])}")
1791    print(f"Repository head: {doc['repository_evidence']['head']}")
1792    print(f"Repository status: {doc['repository_evidence']['status'] or 'clean'}")
1793    print(f"Tests: {json.dumps(doc['tests'])}")
1794    print(f"Independent audit: {doc.get('audit', 'completed' if doc['stage'] == 'review' and (is_final(doc) or doc['status'] == 'HANDOFF REQUIRED') else 'not requested or incomplete')}")
1795    print(f"Recovery: {json.dumps(doc.get('reconciliation', {}))}")
1796    if doc.get("verify_source"):
1797        print(f"Verification command: {' '.join(doc['verify_command'])} ({doc['verify_source']})")
1798    if doc.get("rework_rounds"):
1799        print(f"Rework rounds: {doc['rework_rounds']} of {MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS}")
1800    if doc.get("validation_gap"):
1801        print(f"Validation gap: {doc['validation_gap']}")
1802    if doc.get("validation_failure") and doc["status"] == "HANDOFF REQUIRED":
1803        print(f"Blocked by: {validation_failure_reason(doc)}")
1804        failed = [item for item in doc["tests"] if item.get("exit_code")]
1805        if failed:
1806            print("Failing output (failures first):")
1807            print("\n".join(f"  {line}" for line in failed[-1].get("output", "").splitlines()))
1808        print(f"Next: fix what the output shows (or have an agent do it), then run\n"
1809              f"  howlplane orchestrate resume --repo {doc['repository']}\n"
1810              "Resume re-runs the check on the changed repository and continues to review once it passes; the "
1811              "rework budget is spent, so resuming without a fix fails the same way.")
1812    if doc.get("timed_out_assignments"):
1813        print(f"Timed-out assignments: {json.dumps([{key: item.get(key) for key in ('stage', 'agent', 'model', 'execution_budget_seconds')} for item in doc['timed_out_assignments']])}")
1814    if doc.get("timeout_hint") and is_resumable(doc):
1815        print(f"Timeout guidance: {doc['timeout_hint']}")
1816    if doc.get("exclusions") and (is_final(doc) or doc["status"] == "HANDOFF REQUIRED"):
1817        print(f"Excluded {doc['exclusions']['stage']} workers: {json.dumps(doc['exclusions']['agents'])}")
1818    print(f"Failures: {json.dumps([{'stage': a['stage'], 'agent': a['agent'], 'model': a['model'], 'failure': a.get('failure')} for a in doc['attempts'] if a.get('failure')])}")
1819    if doc["status"] == "HANDOFF REQUIRED" and doc.get("stage") == "acceptance" and any(
1820            a.get("failure") == "ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED" for a in doc["attempts"]):
1821        print("Next: the orchestrator rejected acceptance (verdict below). Address what it names in the repository, then run\n"
1822              f"  howlplane orchestrate resume --repo {doc['repository']} --verify <your test command>\n"
1823              "Changing the repository lets the same session be judged again. If the verdict is not actionable, run\n"
1824              f"  howlplane orchestrate discard --repo {doc['repository']}\nand start a new session.")
1825    for attempt in doc["attempts"]:
1826        if attempt.get("failure") in {"AUDIT_FINDINGS_OR_UNCONFIRMED", "ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED"} and attempt.get("verdict_excerpt"):
1827            # A verdict from an earlier round was sent back for rework and the result judged again; unlabelled,
1828            # a COMPLETE report read as if its "blocking finding remains" were still open (DOG-022).
1829            round_number = attempt.get("rework_round", 0)
1830            superseded = (f", rework round {round_number}: sent back to implementation and re-judged"
1831                          if round_number < doc.get("rework_rounds", 0) else "")
1832            print(f"Verdict from {AGENT_NAMES.get(attempt['agent'], attempt['agent'])} ({attempt['stage']}, {attempt['failure']}{superseded}):")
1833            print("\n".join(f"  {line}" for line in attempt["verdict_excerpt"].splitlines()))
1834        elif attempt.get("stage") == "review" and attempt.get("state") == "SUCCEEDED" and attempt.get("verdict_excerpt"):
1835            # Non-blocking notes exist only here, and a finished session's manifest is removed (DOG-015).
1836            print(f"Review notes from {AGENT_NAMES.get(attempt['agent'], attempt['agent'])} (review, CLEAN):")
1837            print("\n".join(f"  {line}" for line in attempt["verdict_excerpt"].splitlines()))
1838    return 0 if doc["status"] in {"COMPLETE", "COMPLETE WITH WARNINGS"} else 2

1841def invalid_session_report(doc: Any, reason: str, repo: Path) -> int:
1842    # The manifest is left untouched: rewriting state that cannot be trusted
1843    # would destroy the only evidence of what the session did.
1844    session = doc.get("id", "unknown") if isinstance(doc, dict) else "unknown"
1845    print("HOWL ORCHESTRATION REPORT")
1846    print(f"Session: {redact(str(session))}\nStatus: SESSION_STATE_INVALID\nReason: {redact(reason)}")
1847    print(f"Next: howlplane orchestrate inspect --json --repo {repo}, then discard or repair the session")
1848    return 2

1851def command(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
1852    repo = Path(args.repo or os.getcwd()).resolve()
1853    root = state_root()
1854    with locked(root):
1855        active = active_sessions(root, repo)
1856        operation = args.input if args.input in {"resume", "inspect", "discard"} else None
1857        if active and operation is None and not args.separate and sys.stdin.isatty():
1858            choice = question("Unfinished session: Resume, Inspect, Discard, or Start separate", "Resume").lower()
1859            if choice == "start separate":
1860                args.separate = True
1861            elif choice in {"resume", "inspect", "discard"}:
1862                operation = choice
1863            else:
1864                raise ValueError("Unknown session action")
1865        if operation == "inspect":
1866            sessions = active_sessions(root, repo, include_terminal=True)
1867            for s in sessions:
1868                s["resumable"] = is_resumable(s)
1869            if args.json:
1870                print(json.dumps(sessions, indent=2))
1871            else:
1872                target = sessions[:1] if sessions else []
1873                if not target:
1874                    print("No orchestration sessions found")
1875                else:
1876                    for s in target:
1877                        print("HOWL ORCHESTRATION SESSION")
1878                        print(f"Session: {s['id']}")
1879                        print(f"Goal: {s.get('goal', '')}")
1880                        print(f"Status: {s.get('status', '')}")
1881                        print(f"Resumable: {'yes' if s.get('resumable') else 'no'}")
1882                        print(f"Stage: {s.get('stage', '')}")
1883                        if s.get("validation_failure") and s.get("status") == "HANDOFF REQUIRED":
1884                            print(f"Blocked by: {validation_failure_reason(s)}")
1885                        if s.get("implementer"):
1886                            print(f"Implementer: {s['implementer']}")
1887            return 0
1888        if operation == "discard":
1889            for doc in active:
1890                path_for(root, doc["id"]).unlink()
1891            print(f"Discarded {len(active)} active session(s)")
1892            return 0
1893        if operation == "resume":
1894            if not active:
1895                raise ValueError("No unfinished session")
1896            doc = active[0]
1897            try:
1898                migrations = normalize_session(doc)
1899            except SessionStateInvalid as error:
1900                return invalid_session_report(doc, str(error), repo)
1901            previous_orchestrator = doc["orchestrator"]
1902            if live_lease(doc):
1903                raise ValueError("Session has a live coordinator lease")
1904            doc["lease"] = {"token": uuid.uuid4().hex, "pid": os.getpid(), "renewed_at": time.time()}
1905            reconcile(doc, repo)
1906            budget_change = parse_execution_budget(getattr(args, "execution_budget", None))
1907            if budget_change:
1908                doc["execution_budget"].update(budget_change)
1909                doc.setdefault("budget_changes", []).append({"budget": budget_change, "at": now()})
1910            if getattr(args, "retry_timeouts", False) and doc["timed_out_assignments"]:
1911                # An explicit operator retry: clear the ledger once, keep the record.
1912                doc.setdefault("timeout_retries", []).append({"cleared": doc["timed_out_assignments"], "at": now()})
1913                doc["timed_out_assignments"] = []
1914            doc.pop("timeout_hint", None)
1915            doc.pop("exclusions", None)
1916            # Trust policy is re-resolved on resume (CLI, environment, config), so
1917            # an operator can switch between strict and bypass for the rest of the session.
1918            resolved_policy = workspace_trust.resolve_policy()
1919            if (doc.get("workspace_trust_policy") or {}).get("policy") != resolved_policy["policy"]:
1920                doc.setdefault("workspace_trust_policy_changes", []).append(
1921                    {"from": (doc.get("workspace_trust_policy") or {}).get("policy"), "to": resolved_policy["policy"],
1922                     "at": now()})
1923            doc["workspace_trust_policy"] = resolved_policy
1924            requested_orchestrator = getattr(args, "orchestrator", None)
1925            if requested_orchestrator and requested_orchestrator != "AUTO" and doc["agents"].get(requested_orchestrator, {}).get("state") in {"AVAILABLE", "DEGRADED"}:
1926                doc["requested_orchestrator"] = requested_orchestrator
1927                doc["selected_orchestrator"] = requested_orchestrator
1928                doc["orchestrator"] = requested_orchestrator
1929            for agent in AGENTS:
1930                opt = getattr(args, agent, None)
1931                if opt:
1932                    current_state = doc["agents"].get(agent, {}).get("state")
1933                    if opt == "RESERVED":
1934                        doc["agents"][agent]["state"] = "RESERVED"
1935                    elif opt in {"AVAILABLE", "AUTO"} and current_state == "RESERVED":
1936                        installed = shutil.which(BINARIES[agent]) is not None
1937                        doc["agents"][agent]["state"] = "AVAILABLE" if installed else "UNAVAILABLE"
1938            if getattr(args, "models", None):
1939                for role, agent, model in parse_role_model_triples(args.models):
1940                    doc["role_models"].setdefault(role, {})[agent] = model
1941            if getattr(args, "strategy", None):
1942                doc["strategy"] = args.strategy
1943            if getattr(args, "verify", None):
1944                doc["verify_command"] = args.verify
1945            path = path_for(root, doc["id"])
1946            secure_write(path, doc)
1947            if doc["policy"] == "PLAN ONLY" and doc.get("reconciliation", {}).get("needs_validation"):
1948                doc["status"] = "BLOCKED"
1949                save(path, doc, doc["lease"]["token"])
1950                return report(doc)
1951        else:
1952            if active:
1953                if args.separate:
1954                    raise ValueError("Separate sessions need a distinct Git worktree passed with --repo; overlapping worktree ownership is refused")
1955                raise ValueError("Unfinished session exists. Use orchestrate resume, inspect, discard, or a separate Git worktree")
1956            doc = setup(args, repo)
1957            doc["retain_report"] = args.retain_report
1958            path = path_for(root, doc["id"])
1959            save(path, doc, doc["lease"]["token"])
1960    progress = SessionProgress(
1961        doc,
1962        stream=sys.stderr,
1963        heartbeat_interval=getattr(args, "heartbeat", 30.0),
1964        enabled=not (getattr(args, "quiet", False) or getattr(args, "no_progress", False) or getattr(args, "json", False)),
1965    )
1966    if operation == "resume":
1967        progress._write("RESUME", f"Loading orchestration session {doc['id'][:8]}")
1968        for note in migrations:
1969            progress._write("MIGRATE", note)
1970        progress._write("RECONCILE", "Checking repository and worker state")
1971        if doc["orchestrator"] != previous_orchestrator:
1972            progress._write("TAKEOVER", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(doc['orchestrator'], doc['orchestrator'])} is now orchestrator")
1973    else:
1974        progress.session_started()
1975    try:
1976        return run(doc, path, repo, progress)
1977    except KeyboardInterrupt:
1978        progress._write("INTERRUPT", "Stopping new dispatches and checkpointing session...")
1979        doc["status"] = "INTERRUPTED"
1980        checkpoint(doc, path, doc["lease"]["token"], repo)
1981        progress._write("CHECKPOINT", f"Session can be resumed with: howlplane orchestrate resume --repo {repo}")
1982        return 130

1985def add_parser(subparsers: Any, common_parser: Any) -> None:
1986    parser = subparsers.add_parser("orchestrate", parents=[common_parser], help="Run a session-scoped agent workflow")
1987    parser.add_argument("input", nargs="?", help="Goal, resume, inspect, or discard")
1988    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Machine-readable session inspection")
1989    parser.add_argument("--quiet", action="store_true", help="Only print the final report and errors")
1990    parser.add_argument("--no-progress", action="store_true", help="Disable task-level progress and local heartbeats")
1991    parser.add_argument("--heartbeat", type=float, default=30.0, metavar="SECONDS", help="Heartbeat interval during otherwise silent work (default: 30)")
1992    parser.add_argument("--separate", action="store_true", help="Start a separate session alongside an unfinished one")
1993    parser.add_argument("--retain-report", action="store_true")
1994    parser.add_argument("--orchestrator", choices=["AUTO", *AGENTS])
1995    for agent in AGENTS:
1996        parser.add_argument(f"--{agent.replace('_', '-')}", choices=["AUTO", "RESERVED", "UNAVAILABLE"])
1997    parser.add_argument("--strategy", choices=["BALANCED", "ECONOMY", "QUALITY"])
1998    parser.add_argument("--models", help="Comma separated role:agent:model selections")
1999    parser.add_argument("--fallbacks", help="Comma separated ordered role:agent:model alternatives")
2000    parser.add_argument("--failover", choices=["AUTO REROUTE", "OFF"])
2001    parser.add_argument("--policy", choices=["PLAN + EXECUTE + INDEPENDENT AUDIT", "PLAN + EXECUTE", "PLAN ONLY"])
2002    parser.add_argument("--constraint", action="append", default=[])
2003    parser.add_argument("--verify", nargs="+", help="Explicit verification command and arguments")
2004    parser.add_argument("--execution-budget", action="append", metavar="ROLE=SECONDS",
2005                        help=f"Per-assignment deadline for a role, or SECONDS for every role (default "
2006                             f"{DEFAULT_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS}, max {MAX_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS}; repeatable). "
2007                             "This is HowlPlane's own time limit, not provider quota")
2008    parser.add_argument("--retry-timeouts", action="store_true",
2009                        help="On resume, allow assignments that hit their execution budget to run once more unchanged")
2010    add_workspace_trust_argument(parser)

2013def add_workspace_trust_argument(parser: Any) -> None:
2014    """`--workspace-trust`: overrides `[workspace_trust] policy` for this command and what it launches."""
2015    parser.add_argument("--workspace-trust", choices=list(workspace_trust.POLICIES), default=None,
2016                        help="Workspace trust policy: strict (never bypass vendor trust), prepare (default; use "
2017                             "trust prepared by `factory prepare`), or bypass (audited vendor flags so trust never "
2018                             "blocks unattended work). Overrides [workspace_trust] policy")
SCHEMA = 'howlplane.orchestration/v1'

IMPLEMENTATION_PREFERENCE = 'codex'
ROLES = ('planning', 'implementation', 'review', 'acceptance')
AGENT_STATES = {'RESERVED', 'DEGRADED', 'UNAVAILABLE', 'AVAILABLE'}
UNAVAILABLE_FAILURES = {'AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED', 'PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE', 'MISSING_EXECUTABLE'}
MODEL_LIMIT_FAILURES = {'QUOTA_EXHAUSTED', 'RATE_LIMITED', 'SESSION_LIMIT'}
CAPACITY_FAILURES = {'SESSION_LIMIT'}
ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_FAILURES = {'EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED'}
WORKSPACE_TRUST_FAILURES = {'WORKSPACE_TRUST_REQUIRED'}
DEFAULT_EXECUTION_BUDGETS: dict[str, int] = {'planning': 300, 'implementation': 600, 'review': 600, 'acceptance': 300}
DEFAULT_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS = 300
MAX_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS = 1800
LEGACY_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS = 300
ROLE_FAILURES = {'AUDIT_NO_VERDICT', 'EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED', 'ENGINEERING_FAILURE', 'AUDIT_FINDINGS_OR_UNCONFIRMED', 'POLICY_FAILURE', 'CAPABILITY_FAILURE', 'MALFORMED_OUTPUT', 'ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED', 'READ_ONLY_ROLE_MUTATED_REPOSITORY', 'PROVIDER_STALLED', 'NO_REPOSITORY_CHANGE', 'VERIFICATION_FAILURE'}
REQUIRED_KEYS = ('id', 'created_at', 'goal', 'orchestrator', 'strategy', 'failover', 'policy', 'stage', 'status', 'agents', 'attempts', 'lease', 'repository_evidence')
BINARIES = {'claude_code': 'claude', 'codex': 'codex', 'cursor': 'agent', 'agy': 'agy', 'devin_cli': 'devin'}
SUCCESSFULLY_TERMINAL_STATUSES = frozenset({'COMPLETE WITH WARNINGS', 'COMPLETE'})
RESUMABLE_STATUSES = frozenset({'IMPLEMENTATION', 'HANDOFF REQUIRED', 'PLANNING', 'ACCEPTANCE', 'REVIEW', 'PLANNED', 'INTERRUPTED'})
SUPERSEDED = 'SUPERSEDED'
TRULY_TERMINAL_STATUSES = frozenset({'SESSION_STATE_INVALID', 'SUPERSEDED'})
TERMINAL = frozenset({'COMPLETE WITH WARNINGS', 'COMPLETE', 'SESSION_STATE_INVALID', 'SUPERSEDED'})
def is_resumable( status_or_doc: str | dict[str, typing.Any], reason: str | None = None) -> bool: 
 93def is_resumable(status_or_doc: str | dict[str, Any], reason: str | None = None) -> bool:
 94    """Return True if an orchestration session can be resumed safely."""
 95    if isinstance(status_or_doc, dict):
 96        doc = status_or_doc
 97        status = str(doc.get("status", "")).upper()
 98        if reason is None:
 99            reason = doc.get("audit") or doc.get("failure") or (doc.get("exclusions") or {}).get("stage")
100    else:
101        status = str(status_or_doc).upper()
102
103    if status in SUCCESSFULLY_TERMINAL_STATUSES:
104        return False
105    if status in TRULY_TERMINAL_STATUSES:
106        return False
107    if status in RESUMABLE_STATUSES:
108        return True
109    if status == "BLOCKED":
110        reason_str = str(reason or "")
111        if "read-only role changed the repository" in reason_str:
112            return False
113        if "needs_validation" in reason_str:
114            return False
115        if any(keyword in reason_str for keyword in (
116            "independent reviewer",
117            "reviewers exhausted",
118            "workers remain",
119            "budget",
120            "workspace trust",
121            "quota",
122            "rate limit",
123            "timeout",
124        )):
125            return True
126        if reason_str.startswith("AUDIT BLOCKED"):
127            return True
128        return False
129    return False

Return True if an orchestration session can be resumed safely.

def is_final( status_or_doc: str | dict[str, typing.Any], reason: str | None = None) -> bool: 
132def is_final(status_or_doc: str | dict[str, Any], reason: str | None = None) -> bool:
133    """Return True if an orchestration session has reached a final, non-resumable state."""

def is_existing_wip_context(goal: str, constraints: list[str] | None = None) -> bool: 
137def is_existing_wip_context(goal: str, constraints: list[str] | None = None) -> bool:
138    """Return True if goal or constraints indicate working with existing WIP or changes."""
139    text = f"{goal} {' '.join(constraints or [])}".lower()
140    indicators = (
141        "work in progress", "work-in-progress", "wip",
142        "existing change", "existing changes", "existing work",
143        "current change", "current changes", "current repository change",
144        "current repository changes", "uncommitted",
145        "intentional work", "finalize", "validate existing",
146        "audit existing", "inspect existing"
147    )
148    return any(term in text for term in indicators)

151    # The canonical primitive: a private, looser pattern here treated "token once" as a secret and

153    return redact_operator_text(value)

AGENT_NAMES = {'claude_code': 'Claude', 'codex': 'Codex', 'cursor': 'Cursor', 'agy': 'AGY', 'devin_cli': 'Devin'}
PHASE_NAMES = {'planning': 'PLAN', 'implementation': 'IMPLEMENT', 'review': 'AUDIT', 'acceptance': 'INTEGRATE', 'verification': 'VERIFY'}
PRIVATE_REASONING = re.compile('(?i)(?:private\\s+)?(?:chain[- ]of[- ]thought|internal reasoning).*?(?:[.;]|$)', re.IGNORECASE)

172class SessionProgress:
173    def __init__(
174        self,
175        document: dict[str, Any],
176        stream: TextIO | None = None,
177        heartbeat_interval: float = 30.0,
178        enabled: bool = True,
179        clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic,
180    ) -> None:
181        self.document = document
182        self.stream = stream or sys.stderr
183        self.heartbeat_interval = max(1.0, float(heartbeat_interval))
184        self.enabled = enabled
185        self.clock = clock
186        self.started_at = clock()
187        self.last_visible_at = self.started_at
188        self.last_change_at = self.started_at
189        self.phase_name = PHASE_NAMES.get(document.get("stage", "planning"), "SESSION CREATED")
190        self._stop = threading.Event()
191        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None
192        self._stall_reported = False
193
194    @staticmethod
195    def _safe(value: Any, limit: int = 160) -> str:
196        text = PRIVATE_REASONING.sub("", redact(str(value))).replace("\n", " ").strip()
197        return text if len(text) <= limit else text[: limit - 1].rstrip() + "…"
198
199    def _write(self, label: str, message: str, timestamp: bool = True) -> None:
200        if not self.enabled:
201            return
202        prefix = f"[{datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] " if timestamp else ""
203        self.stream.write(f"{prefix}{label:<11} {self._safe(message)}\n")
204        self.stream.flush()
205        self.last_visible_at = self.clock()
206
207    def session_started(self) -> None:
208        if not self.enabled:
209            return
210        reserved = [AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent) for agent, state in self.document["agents"].items() if state["state"] == "RESERVED"]
211        requested = self.document.get("requested_orchestrator", self.document["orchestrator"])
212        selected = self.document.get("selected_orchestrator")
213        if selected is None and requested != "AUTO":
214            selected = requested
215        lines = [
216            "HOWL ORCHESTRATION",
217            f"Session: {self.document['id'][:8]}...",
218            f"Goal: {self._safe(self.document['goal'], 90)}",
219            f"Requested orchestrator: {AGENT_NAMES.get(requested, requested)}",
220            f"Selected orchestrator: {AGENT_NAMES.get(selected, selected) if selected else 'pending'}",
221            f"Strategy: {self.document['strategy']}",
222            f"Failover: {self.document['failover']}",
223            f"Execution: {self.document['policy']}",
224        ]
225        if reserved:
226            lines.append(f"Reserved agents: {', '.join(reserved)}")
227        lines.extend(["", "Starting orchestration..."])
228        self.stream.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
229        self.stream.flush()
230        self.last_visible_at = self.clock()
231
232    def phase(self, phase: str, message: str) -> None:
233        self.phase_name = PHASE_NAMES.get(phase, phase.upper())
234        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
235        self._stall_reported = False
236        self._write(self.phase_name, message)
237
238    def assignment(self, task_id: str, agent: str, task: str) -> None:
239        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
240        self._write("ASSIGN", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} assigned task {task_id}: {task}")
241
242    def worker_complete(self, task_id: str, agent: str, task: str) -> None:
243        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
244        self._write("COMPLETE", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} completed {task_id}: {task}")
245
246    def capability_downgrade(self, agent: str) -> None:
247        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
248        self._write("CAPABILITY", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} marked interactive-only for this session")
249
250    def permission_gap(self, agent: str, role: str, commands: list[str]) -> None:
251        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
252        name = AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)
253        # Commands first: a progress line is cut at 160 characters, and the explanation used to push them out (DOG-020).
254        for command in commands:
255            self._write("PERMISSION", f"{name} refused (not granted): {command}")
256        self._write("PERMISSION", f"{name} changed files but needed commands HowlPlane did not grant; excluded from "
257                                  f"{role} for this session only, still ready for later sessions (extra_allowed_bash)")
258
259    def role_excluded(self, agent: str, role: str, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
260        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
261        name = AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)
262        if entry["state"] == "EXHAUSTED":
263            self._write("CAPABILITY", f"{name} {role} capacity marked exhausted for this session ({entry['reason']})")
264        else:
265            self._write("CAPABILITY", f"{name} excluded from {role} for this session after {entry['reason']}")
266
267    def attempt_timed_out(self, agent: str, role: str, budget: int, partial: bool) -> None:
268        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
269        detail = "; partial changes kept for the next worker" if partial else ""
270        self._write("TIMEOUT", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} {role} stopped at the {budget}s execution budget "
271                               f"(attempt only; capacity unchanged){detail}")
272
273    def selection(self, agent: str, role: str, evidence: str) -> None:
274        self._write("SELECT", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} for {role}: {evidence}")
275
276    def route_skip(self, agent: str, reason: str = "unattended execution unavailable") -> None:
277        self._write("ROUTE", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} skipped: {reason}")
278
279    def excluded(self, agent: str, reason: str) -> None:
280        self._write("EXCLUDED", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)}: {reason}")
281
282    def explicit_override_warning(self, agent: str) -> None:
283        self._write("WARNING", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} previously required interactive permission; explicit selection overrides AUTO exclusion")
284
285    def selected_orchestrator(self, agent: str) -> None:
286        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
287        self._write("SELECT", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} selected as orchestrator")
288
289    def limit(self, agent: str, model: str, reason: str) -> None:
290        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
291        self._write("LIMIT", f"{agent}/{model} reached {reason.lower().replace('_', ' ')}")
292
293    def checkpoint(self, task_id: str) -> None:
294        self._write("CHECKPOINT", f"Preserved task {task_id} state")
295
296    def reroute(self, task_id: str, source: str, target: str, reason: str) -> None:
297        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
298        self._write("REROUTE", f"{task_id}: {AGENT_NAMES.get(source, source)} → {AGENT_NAMES.get(target, target)} ({reason})")
299        reserved = [AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent) for agent, state in self.document["agents"].items() if state["state"] == "RESERVED"]
300        if reserved:
301            self._write("REROUTE", f"{', '.join(reserved)} skipped: RESERVED")
302
303    def validation(self, started: bool, message: str) -> None:
304        self.phase_name = "VERIFY"
305        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
306        self._write("VERIFY", message)
307
308    def blocked(self, status: str, reason: str, next_step: str | None = None) -> None:
309        self.last_change_at = self.clock()
310        self._write(status, reason)
311        if next_step and is_resumable(self.document):
312            self._write("RESUME", next_step)
313
314    def complete(self, status: str) -> None:
315        successes = sum(attempt.get("state") == "SUCCEEDED" for attempt in self.document.get("attempts", []))
316        passed = sum(test.get("exit_code") == 0 for test in self.document.get("tests", []))
317        self._write("COMPLETE", f"Session finished; {successes} tasks completed; {len(self.document.get('reroutes', []))} rerouted; {passed} validations passed; final status: {status}")
318
319    def heartbeat(self, force: bool = False) -> bool:
320        current = self.clock()
321        if not force and current - self.last_visible_at < self.heartbeat_interval:
322            return False
323        active = [attempt for attempt in self.document.get("attempts", []) if attempt.get("state") == "ASSIGNED"]
324        if active:
325            tasks = ", ".join(attempt.get("task_id", self.document["id"][:8]) for attempt in active)
326            message = f"{self.phase_name} — {len(active)} active worker(s); tasks: {tasks}"
327        else:
328            message = f"Session active; current phase: {self.phase_name}"
329        self._write("WORKING", message)
330        if current - self.last_change_at >= 300 and not self._stall_reported:
331            self._write("WARNING", "No worker state change for 5m; session remains active")
332            self._stall_reported = True
333        return True
334
335    @contextmanager
336    def waiting(self):
337        if self.enabled:
338            self._stop.clear()
339            self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._heartbeat_loop, name=f"howl-progress-{self.document['id'][:8]}", daemon=True)
340            self._thread.start()
341        try:
342            yield
343        finally:
344            self._stop.set()
345            if self._thread and self._thread is not threading.current_thread():
346                self._thread.join(timeout=1)
347            self._thread = None
348
349    def _heartbeat_loop(self) -> None:
350        while not self._stop.wait(self.heartbeat_interval):
351            self.heartbeat()

361def git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:
362    result = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *guarded_git_args([*args])], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=20)

def evidence(repo: pathlib.Path) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
368def evidence(repo: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
369    import hashlib
370    root = Path(git(repo, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")).resolve()
371    def digest(*args: str) -> str:
372        return hashlib.sha256(git(root, *args).encode()).hexdigest()
373    untracked = git(root, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z")
374    untracked_hashes = {}
375    for name in filter(None, untracked.split("\0")):
376        candidate = root / name
377        if candidate.is_file() and not candidate.is_symlink():
378            untracked_hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
379    return {
380        "root": str(root),
381        "head": git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
382        "status": git(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"),
383        "diff_sha256": digest("diff", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff"),
384        "cached_diff_sha256": digest("diff", "--cached", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff"),
385        "worktrees": git(root, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain"),
386        "untracked_sha256": untracked_hashes,
387    }

def dirty_paths(root: pathlib.Path) -> dict[str, str | None]: 
395def dirty_paths(root: Path) -> dict[str, str | None]:
396    """Each path that differs from HEAD (or is untracked), with its content hash; None when deleted."""
397    import hashlib
398    # Not git(): its strip() would eat the leading space of a " M path" entry.
399    status = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), *guarded_git_args(["status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all"])],
400                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
401    if status.returncode:
402        raise ValueError(f"Git inspection failed: {redact(status.stderr.strip())}")
403    entries = status.stdout.split("\0")
404    paths: dict[str, str | None] = {}
405    index = 0
406    while index < len(entries):
407        entry = entries[index]
408        index += 1
409        if len(entry) < 4:
410            continue
411        if entry[0] in "RC":
412            index += 1  # -z puts a rename's source path in the next field
413        name = entry[3:]
414        candidate = root / name
415        paths[name] = (hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
416                       if candidate.is_file() and not candidate.is_symlink() else None)
417    return paths

Each path that differs from HEAD (or is untracked), with its content hash; None when deleted.

REVIEW_DIFF_CHARS = 12000
def session_diff_evidence(doc: dict[str, typing.Any], repo: pathlib.Path) -> str: 
423def session_diff_evidence(doc: dict[str, Any], repo: Path) -> str:
424    """Give read-only roles the diff of this session's work, which HowlPlane computes itself.
425
426    Review and acceptance hold no shell, so they could not see what changed or the
427    original version of a file, and compatibility requirements went unverified (DOG-027).
428    Git runs here with external diff and textconv drivers off, so no repository-configured
429    program executes. Changes the user already had uncommitted when the session began are
430    named separately, so they are never judged as the implementer's work.
431    """
432    try:
433        root = Path(git(repo, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")).resolve()
434        current = dirty_paths(root)
435        has_head = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), *guarded_git_args(["rev-parse", "--verify", "-q", "HEAD"])],
436                                  capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20).returncode == 0
437    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
438        return ""
439    base = doc.get("base_dirty") or {}
440    untouched = sorted(name for name in current if name in base and current[name] == base[name])
441    session = sorted(name for name in current if name not in untouched)
442    if not session and not untouched:
443        return ""
444    lines = [" HowlPlane computed this session's changes against the last commit (HEAD); you cannot run git yourself, "
445             "so use this to see what changed and the original lines, and Read files for full context."]
446    if untouched:
447        lines.append("\nUncommitted changes the user already had before this session began, untouched by it (not the "
448                     "implementer's work; do not judge them): " + ", ".join(untouched))
449    mixed = sorted(name for name in session if name in base)
450    if mixed:
451        lines.append("\nThese files already had uncommitted user changes before this session; their diff below includes "
452                     "those user changes as well: " + ", ".join(mixed))
453    tracked = [name for name in session if has_head and subprocess.run(
454        ["git", "-C", str(root), *guarded_git_args(["cat-file", "-e", f"HEAD:{name}"])], capture_output=True, timeout=20).returncode == 0]
455    added = [name for name in session if name not in tracked]
456    if added:
457        lines.append("\nNew files (not in HEAD; Read them): " + ", ".join(added))
458    if tracked:
459        try:
460            diff = git(root, "diff", "HEAD", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", "--no-color", "--", *tracked)
461        except ValueError:
462            diff = ""
463        if len(diff) > REVIEW_DIFF_CHARS:
464            diff = diff[:REVIEW_DIFF_CHARS] + "\n[... diff truncated by HowlPlane; Read the files for the rest ...]"
465        # Not redacted: the diff is never persisted, and the reviewer can Read the same files. Redacting it
466        # only showed the reviewer text that is not in the repository (DOG-030: a README placeholder
467        # `API_TOKEN='paste-the-printed-token-here'` arrived as `API_TOKEN='[REDACTED]'`).
468        lines.append("\n--- diff of changed tracked files against HEAD ---\n" + diff + "\n--- end of diff ---")
469    return "".join(lines)

@contextmanager
def locked(root: pathlib.Path): 
472@contextmanager
473def locked(root: Path):
474    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
475    os.chmod(root, 0o700)
476    with (root / ".lock").open("a+") as handle:
477        fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
478        try:
479            yield
480        finally:
481            fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
def path_for(root: pathlib.Path, session_id: str) -> pathlib.Path: 
484def path_for(root: Path, session_id: str) -> Path:
485    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", session_id):
486        raise ValueError("Invalid session ID")
487    return root / f"{session_id}.json"
def save(path: pathlib.Path, document: dict[str, typing.Any], token: str) -> None: 
490def save(path: Path, document: dict[str, Any], token: str) -> None:
491    current = safe_load_json(path) if path.exists() else None
492    if current and current.get("lease", {}).get("token") != token:
493        raise ValueError("Coordinator lease changed; stale assignment rejected")
494    clean = json.loads(redact(json.dumps(document)))
495    secure_write(path, clean)
def secure_write(path: pathlib.Path, document: dict[str, typing.Any]) -> None: 
498def secure_write(path: Path, document: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
499    descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
500    try:
501        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w") as handle:
502            json.dump(json.loads(redact(json.dumps(document))), handle, indent=2)
503            handle.flush()
504            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
505        os.replace(temporary, path)
506    finally:
507        if os.path.exists(temporary):
508            os.unlink(temporary)
def active_sessions( root: pathlib.Path, repo: pathlib.Path, include_terminal: bool = False) -> list[dict[str, typing.Any]]: 
511def active_sessions(root: Path, repo: Path, include_terminal: bool = False) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
512    sessions = []
513    for path in root.glob("[0-9a-f]*.json"):
514        doc = safe_load_json(path)
515        if isinstance(doc, dict) and doc.get("schema") == SCHEMA and doc.get("repository") == str(repo) and (include_terminal or is_resumable(doc)):
516            sessions.append(doc)
517    return sorted(sessions, key=lambda item: str(item.get("created_at", "")), reverse=True)
def now() -> str: 
520def now() -> str:
521    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
def live_lease(doc: dict[str, typing.Any]) -> bool: 
524def live_lease(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
525    """True while another process still holds this session's coordinator lease."""
526    lease = doc.get("lease") or {}
527    if time.time() - lease.get("renewed_at", 0) >= 330 or lease.get("pid", 0) == os.getpid():
528        return False
529    try:
530        os.kill(lease["pid"], 0)
531    except (ProcessLookupError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
532        return False
533    except PermissionError:
534        return True
535    return True

True while another process still holds this session's coordinator lease.

def supersede( root: pathlib.Path, session_id: str, reason: str, replaced_by: str) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
538def supersede(root: Path, session_id: str, reason: str, replaced_by: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
539    """Retire one resumable session in favour of replacement work.
540
541    Unlike ``discard``, the manifest is kept: it becomes ``SUPERSEDED`` history
542    that records why and by what it was replaced, and it no longer owns its
543    worktree. A session that is not resumable, or whose coordinator is still
544    alive, is refused rather than taken over.
545    """
546    with locked(root):
547        path = path_for(root, session_id)
548        if not path.exists():
549            raise ValueError(f"Session {session_id} does not exist")
550        doc = safe_load_json(path)
551        if not isinstance(doc, dict) or doc.get("schema") != SCHEMA:
552            raise ValueError(f"Session {session_id} is not an orchestration session")
553        if not is_resumable(doc):
554            raise ValueError(f"Session {session_id} is {doc.get('status')}, not resumable; nothing to supersede")
555        if live_lease(doc):
556            raise ValueError(f"Session {session_id} has a live coordinator lease")
557        doc["superseded"] = {"at": now(), "reason": reason, "replaced_by": replaced_by,
558                             "previous_status": doc.get("status"), "previous_stage": doc.get("stage")}
559        doc["status"] = SUPERSEDED
560        secure_write(path, doc)
561    return doc

Retire one resumable session in favour of replacement work.

def inventory( availability: dict[str, str], repo: pathlib.Path | None = None, policy: str | None = None) -> dict[str, dict[str, typing.Any]]: 
572def inventory(availability: dict[str, str], repo: Path | None = None,
573              policy: str | None = None) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
574    """Session start inventory. Cached readiness evidence informs it; nothing here sends a prompt.
575
576    `local_only` forbids hosted egress, and every agent here is a hosted CLI, so
577    none is dispatchable in that mode -- the same verdict the doctor and the
578    provider pool give. With a repository, each agent also carries its vendor
579    trust state for that workspace, read from local files only, next to its
580    effective readiness under the session's workspace trust policy.
581    """
582    policy = policy or workspace_trust.resolve_policy()["policy"]
583    readiness = agent_readiness.cached_summaries()
584    hosted = agent_readiness.hosted_probes_allowed()
585    found = {}
586    for agent in AGENTS:
587        installed = shutil.which(BINARIES[agent]) is not None
588        requested = availability.get(agent, "AUTO").upper()
589        state = "RESERVED" if requested == "RESERVED" else "AVAILABLE" if installed and requested != "UNAVAILABLE" else "UNAVAILABLE"
590        if state == "AVAILABLE" and not hosted:
591            state = "UNAVAILABLE"
592        evidence = readiness.get(agent)
593        capabilities = unknown_capabilities("CLI metadata does not confirm unattended execution")
594        if evidence and evidence["unattended_execution"] is not None:
595            capabilities.update({"unattended_execution": evidence["unattended_execution"],
596                                 "reason": f"agent readiness: {evidence['unattended_source']}",
597                                 "evidence_time": evidence["last_verified_at"], "scope": "readiness cache"})
598        if state == "AVAILABLE" and evidence:
599            # Only fresh, negative, agent-wide evidence removes an agent; UNKNOWN never does.
600            if evidence["authenticated"] is False or evidence["capacity"]["state"] in {"QUOTA_EXHAUSTED", "SESSION_EXHAUSTED", "RATE_LIMITED"}:
601                state = "UNAVAILABLE"
602            elif capabilities["unattended_execution"] is False:
603                state = "DEGRADED"
604        found[agent] = {
605            "backend": BINARIES[agent],
606            "installed": installed,
607            "callable": installed,
608            "state": state,
609            "models": discover_models(agent) if installed and hosted and requested != "RESERVED" else [],
610            "capabilities": capabilities,
611            "capacity": {},
612            "readiness": readiness_digest(evidence),
613        }
614        if not hosted and installed:
615            found[agent]["unavailable_reason"] = agent_readiness.LOCAL_ONLY_DETAIL
616        if repo is not None and installed:
617            trust = workspace_trust.check(agent, repo)
618            verdict = workspace_trust.effective(agent, trust["state"], policy)
619            found[agent]["workspace_trust"] = {
620                **{key: trust.get(key) for key in (
621                    "state", "workspace", "scope", "covering_path", "detail", "source", "checked_at")},
622                "policy": policy, "effective_state": verdict["effective_state"],
623                "mechanism": verdict["mechanism"]}
624    return found

Session start inventory. Cached readiness evidence informs it; nothing here sends a prompt.

local_only forbids hosted egress, and every agent here is a hosted CLI, so none is dispatchable in that mode -- the same verdict the doctor and the provider pool give. With a repository, each agent also carries its vendor trust state for that workspace, read from local files only, next to its effective readiness under the session's workspace trust policy.

def readiness_digest(evidence: dict[str, typing.Any] | None) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
627def readiness_digest(evidence: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
628    """The routing-relevant slice of cached readiness, kept on the session record."""
629    if not evidence:
630        return {"live_smoke": "NOT_RUN", "verified_at": None, "capacity_state": "UNKNOWN", "model_limits": []}
631    return {"live_smoke": evidence["live_smoke"]["status"], "verified_at": evidence["live_smoke"]["verified_at"],
632            "capacity_state": evidence["capacity"]["state"],
633            "model_limits": [f"{item['model']}:{item['state']}" for item in evidence["capacity"]["limits"] if item.get("model")]}

The routing-relevant slice of cached readiness, kept on the session record.

def selection_evidence(doc: dict[str, typing.Any], agent: str) -> str: 
636def selection_evidence(doc: dict[str, Any], agent: str) -> str:
637    """Observable facts behind an AUTO choice; no subjective ranking."""
638    state = agent_record(doc, agent)
639    unattended = state["capabilities"]["unattended_execution"]
640    readiness = state.get("readiness") or readiness_digest(None)
641    smoke = readiness.get("live_smoke", "NOT_RUN")
642    age = agent_readiness.age_seconds(readiness.get("verified_at"))
643    smoke_text = {"NOT_RUN": "not run", "STALE": "stale"}.get(smoke, smoke.lower())
644    if smoke == "PASS" and age is not None:
645        smoke_text = f"passed {agent_readiness._duration(age)} ago"
646    return (f"unattended {({True: 'verified', False: 'interactive-only (explicit override)', None: 'unverified'})[unattended]}"
647            f" · live smoke {smoke_text} · capacity {readiness.get('capacity_state', 'UNKNOWN')}")

class SessionStateInvalid(builtins.ValueError): 
650class SessionStateInvalid(ValueError):
651    """A manifest that cannot be normalized without guessing at its evidence."""

A manifest that cannot be normalized without guessing at its evidence.

def unknown_capabilities( reason: str = 'No unattended execution evidence recorded') -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
654def unknown_capabilities(reason: str = "No unattended execution evidence recorded") -> dict[str, Any]:
655    return {"unattended_execution": None, "reason": reason, "evidence_time": None, "scope": "session"}
def normalize_agent(agent: str, record: Any) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
658def normalize_agent(agent: str, record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
659    """Bring one agent record to the v2 shape. Missing evidence is UNKNOWN, never AVAILABLE."""
660    if not isinstance(record, dict) or record.get("state") not in AGENT_STATES:
661        raise SessionStateInvalid(f"Agent record for {agent} is malformed")
662    record.setdefault("backend", BINARIES.get(agent, agent))
663    record.setdefault("installed", False)
664    record.setdefault("callable", record["installed"])
665    if not isinstance(record.get("models"), list):
666        record["models"] = []
667    capabilities = record.get("capabilities")
668    if not isinstance(capabilities, dict) or capabilities.get("unattended_execution") not in (None, True, False):
669        record["capabilities"] = unknown_capabilities()
670    else:
671        for key, value in unknown_capabilities().items():
672            capabilities.setdefault(key, value)
673    capacity = record.get("capacity")
674    record["capacity"] = {
675        role: entry for role, entry in (capacity.items() if isinstance(capacity, dict) else ())
676        if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("state") in {"EXHAUSTED", "FAILED"} and entry.get("reason")
677    }
678    return record

Bring one agent record to the v2 shape. Missing evidence is UNKNOWN, never AVAILABLE.

def agent_record(doc: dict[str, typing.Any], agent: str) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
681def agent_record(doc: dict[str, Any], agent: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
682    """Normalized access to an agent. An agent the manifest never recorded is UNAVAILABLE."""
683    agents = doc["agents"]
684    if agent not in agents:
685        agents[agent] = {"backend": BINARIES.get(agent, agent), "installed": False, "callable": False,
686                         "state": "UNAVAILABLE", "models": [],
687                         "capabilities": unknown_capabilities("Agent absent from session manifest"), "capacity": {}}
688    return normalize_agent(agent, agents[agent])

Normalized access to an agent. An agent the manifest never recorded is UNAVAILABLE.

def normalize_session(doc: Any) -> list[str]: 
691def normalize_session(doc: Any) -> list[str]:
692    """Validate and migrate a loaded manifest in place; return migration notes for progress."""
693    if not isinstance(doc, dict) or doc.get("schema") != SCHEMA:
694        raise SessionStateInvalid("Manifest is not an orchestration session")
695    missing = [key for key in REQUIRED_KEYS if key not in doc]
696    if missing:
697        raise SessionStateInvalid(f"Manifest lacks required fields: {', '.join(missing)}")
698    if not isinstance(doc["agents"], dict) or not isinstance(doc["attempts"], list) or not isinstance(doc["lease"], dict) or "token" not in doc["lease"]:
699        raise SessionStateInvalid("Manifest agents, attempts, or lease are malformed")
700    if any(not isinstance(item, dict) or not {"stage", "agent", "model"} <= item.keys() for item in doc["attempts"]):
701        raise SessionStateInvalid("Manifest attempt history is malformed")
702    version = doc.get("schema_version", 1)
703    if not isinstance(version, int) or not 1 <= version <= SCHEMA_VERSION:
704        raise SessionStateInvalid(f"Unsupported session schema version {version!r}")
705    for key, default in (("constraints", []), ("role_models", {}), ("fallbacks", {}), ("model_states", {}),
706                         ("known_models", {}), ("tests", []), ("reroutes", []), ("capability_notices", []),
707                         ("timed_out_assignments", []), ("execution_budget", {})):
708        if not isinstance(doc.get(key), type(default)):
709            doc[key] = default
710    if version < 3:
711        doc["execution_budget"] = {role: LEGACY_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS for role in ROLES}
712    else:
713        try:
714            doc["execution_budget"] = {**default_execution_budget(), **validate_execution_budget(doc["execution_budget"])}
715        except ValueError as error:
716            raise SessionStateInvalid(str(error)) from error
717    doc["lease"].setdefault("pid", 0)
718    doc["lease"].setdefault("renewed_at", 0)
719    for agent in list(doc["agents"]):
720        normalize_agent(agent, doc["agents"][agent])
721    for agent in AGENTS:
722        agent_record(doc, agent)
723    if version == SCHEMA_VERSION:
724        return []
725    # v1 recorded failures only in the attempt log. Replaying that log restores
726    # the session's hard-failure evidence; successes are not replayed as
727    # positive capability claims, they only clear an earlier same-role failure.
728    for attempt in doc["attempts"]:
729        agent, role = attempt["agent"], attempt["stage"]
730        if agent not in AGENTS:
731            continue
732        # v2 already holds the replayed outcome of every other attempt.
733        if attempt.get("state") == "SUCCEEDED" and version == 1:
734            agent_record(doc, agent)["capacity"].pop(role, None)
735        elif attempt.get("failure") in ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_FAILURES:
736            record_timeout(doc, role, agent, attempt["model"], LEGACY_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS,
737                           attempt.get("timeout_source"), attempt.get("finished_at"))
738        elif attempt.get("failure") and version == 1:
739            record_failure(doc, agent, role, attempt["model"], attempt["failure"], attempt.get("finished_at"))
740    # v2 recorded a budget stop as role capacity EXHAUSTED. It was attempt
741    # evidence all along: keep it as such and undo the degradation it caused.
742    for agent in AGENTS:
743        state = agent_record(doc, agent)
744        for role, entry in list(state["capacity"].items()):
745            if entry["reason"] in ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_FAILURES:
746                del state["capacity"][role]
747                record_timeout(doc, role, agent, entry.get("model", "UNKNOWN"), LEGACY_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS,
748                               None, entry.get("evidence_time"))
749        if (state["state"] == "DEGRADED" and not state["capacity"]
750                and state["capabilities"]["unattended_execution"] is not False):
751            state["state"] = "AVAILABLE"
752    doc["schema_version"] = SCHEMA_VERSION
753    doc.setdefault("migrations", []).append({"from": version, "to": SCHEMA_VERSION, "at": now()})
754    return [f"Session manifest normalized from schema v{version} → v{SCHEMA_VERSION}"]

Validate and migrate a loaded manifest in place; return migration notes for progress.

def permission_grant_gap(result: Any, stage: str, changed: bool) -> list[str]: 
771def permission_grant_gap(result: Any, stage: str, changed: bool) -> list[str]:
772    """Commands HowlPlane never granted, when they alone stopped a worker that was mutating the repository.
773
774    A worker that changed files unattended and was then refused only a Bash command
775    outside its derived profile (typically a greenfield test run, before any project
776    command exists to derive) has proven unattended mutation. The gap is HowlPlane's
777    grant, not the agent's capability (DOG-018). Returns [] when that is not the case.
778    """
779    metadata = getattr(result, "metadata", None) or {}
780    commands = [str(command) for command in metadata.get("denied_commands") or []]
781    if not (changed and is_mutating_role(stage) and commands and metadata.get("denied_tools") == ["Bash"]):
782        return []
783    return commands

Commands HowlPlane never granted, when they alone stopped a worker that was mutating the repository.

A worker that changed files unattended and was then refused only a Bash command outside its derived profile (typically a greenfield test run, before any project command exists to derive) has proven unattended mutation. The gap is HowlPlane's grant, not the agent's capability (DOG-018). Returns [] when that is not the case.

def record_failure( doc: dict[str, typing.Any], agent: str, role: str, model: str, failure: str, at: str | None = None, grant_gap: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any] | None: 
786def record_failure(doc: dict[str, Any], agent: str, role: str, model: str, failure: str, at: str | None = None,
787                   grant_gap: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
788    """Apply one failed attempt to session evidence. Returns the role exclusion it created, if any."""
789    state = agent_record(doc, agent)
790    if failure in ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_FAILURES:
791        # Attempt evidence only; `record_timeout` bars the identical retry.
792        return None
793    if failure in WORKSPACE_TRUST_FAILURES:
794        policy = session_trust_policy(doc)
795        state["workspace_trust"] = {"state": workspace_trust.TRUST_REQUIRED, "workspace": doc.get("repository"),
796                                    "role": role, "source": "orchestrate session", "detected_at": at or now(),
797                                    "policy": policy, "mechanism": workspace_trust.mechanism(agent, policy)}
798        return None
799    if failure == "EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED" and is_mutating_role(role) and not grant_gap:
800        # A denial in a read-only role means the worker reached for a tool that
801        # role never holds. It says nothing about unattended mutation, so it
802        # must not take the agent out of every other role (DOG-004). Nor does a
803        # denial of an ungranted command after real edits (DOG-018); that
804        # attempt still excludes the agent from this role below.
805        record_capability_failure(doc, agent, failure, at)
806    if failure in UNAVAILABLE_FAILURES:
807        state["state"] = "UNAVAILABLE"
808    if failure in MODEL_LIMIT_FAILURES:
809        doc["model_states"][f"{agent}:{model}"] = "EXHAUSTED"
810        if model == "UNKNOWN":
811            state["state"] = "UNAVAILABLE"
812    if failure not in CAPACITY_FAILURES and failure not in ROLE_FAILURES:
813        return None
814    if state["state"] == "AVAILABLE":
815        state["state"] = "DEGRADED"
816    entry = {"state": "EXHAUSTED" if failure in CAPACITY_FAILURES else "FAILED", "reason": failure,
817             "model": model, "evidence_time": at or now(), "scope": "session"}
818    state["capacity"][role] = entry
819    return entry

Apply one failed attempt to session evidence. Returns the role exclusion it created, if any.

def validate_execution_budget(budget: dict[str, typing.Any]) -> dict[str, int]: 
830def validate_execution_budget(budget: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, int]:
831    """A finite per-role deadline. Anything outside 1..MAX is refused, never clamped."""
832    checked = {}
833    for role, seconds in budget.items():
834        if role not in ROLES:
835            raise ValueError(f"Unknown execution budget role {role!r}")
836        if isinstance(seconds, bool) or not isinstance(seconds, int) or not 1 <= seconds <= MAX_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS:
837            raise ValueError(f"Execution budget for {role} must be 1..{MAX_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS} seconds")
838        checked[role] = seconds
839    return checked

A finite per-role deadline. Anything outside 1..MAX is refused, never clamped.

def parse_execution_budget(values: list[str] | None) -> dict[str, int]: 
842def parse_execution_budget(values: list[str] | None) -> dict[str, int]:
843    """Parse repeatable `role=seconds` (or a bare `seconds` for every role)."""
844    parsed: dict[str, int] = {}
845    for value in values or []:
846        role, _, seconds = value.rpartition("=")
847        if not seconds.strip().isdigit():
848            raise ValueError("Expected --execution-budget role=seconds or seconds")
849        for target in ([role.strip()] if role else ROLES):
850            parsed[target] = int(seconds)
851    return validate_execution_budget(parsed)

def parse_role_model_triples(value: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]: 
858def parse_role_model_triples(value: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
859    if not value or value == "AUTO":
860        return []
861    result = []
862    for item in value.split(","):
863        parts = item.strip().split(":", 2)
864        if len(parts) != 3 or parts[0] not in ROLES or parts[1] not in AGENTS:
865            raise ValueError("Expected role:agent:model")
866        result.append((parts[0], parts[1], parts[2]))
867    return result
def timeout_signature( doc: dict[str, typing.Any], role: str, agent: str, model: str, budget: int | None = None) -> str: 
870def timeout_signature(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str, agent: str, model: str, budget: int | None = None) -> str:
871    """Identity of an assignment. Changing its scope, worker, model, or deadline yields a new one."""
872    import hashlib
873    identity = {"goal": doc["goal"], "constraints": doc["constraints"], "role": role, "agent": agent, "model": model,
874                "budget": execution_budget(doc, role) if budget is None else budget}
875    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identity, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]

def record_timeout( doc: dict[str, typing.Any], role: str, agent: str, model: str, budget: int, source: str | None = None, at: str | None = None) -> None: 
878def record_timeout(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str, agent: str, model: str, budget: int,
879                   source: str | None = None, at: str | None = None) -> None:
880    signature = timeout_signature(doc, role, agent, model, budget)
881    ledger = doc.setdefault("timed_out_assignments", [])
882    if any(item.get("signature") == signature for item in ledger):
883        return
884    ledger.append({"signature": signature, "stage": role, "agent": agent, "model": model,
885                   "execution_budget_seconds": budget, "timeout_source": source, "at": at or now()})

888def timed_out(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str, agent: str, model: str) -> bool:
889    """True when this exact assignment already hit its deadline and would run again unchanged."""
890    signature = timeout_signature(doc, role, agent, model)
891    return any(item.get("signature") == signature for item in doc.get("timed_out_assignments", []))

def workspace_trust_block(doc: dict[str, typing.Any], agent: str) -> str | None: 
899def workspace_trust_block(doc: dict[str, Any], agent: str) -> str | None:
900    """Why this session's workspace refuses the agent, or None. Scoped to the workspace, never the agent."""
901    record = agent_record(doc, agent)
902    trust = record.get("workspace_trust") or {}
903    if trust.get("state") != workspace_trust.TRUST_REQUIRED:
904        return None
905    policy = session_trust_policy(doc)
906    if trust.get("source") == "vendor trust store" and trust.get("workspace"):
907        # A pre-dispatch verdict from local files: an operator may have prepared
908        # the workspace since (for example, before `resume`).
909        current = workspace_trust.check(agent, trust["workspace"])
910        if current["state"] == workspace_trust.READY:
911            record["workspace_trust"] = {**trust, "state": current["state"], "covering_path": current["covering_path"],
912                                         "checked_at": current["checked_at"]}
913            return None
914        if workspace_trust.effective(agent, current["state"], policy)["effective_state"] == workspace_trust.READY:
915            # The vendor still does not trust it; this policy's audited flag makes it usable.
916            return None
917    elif agent_readiness.binding_refusal(agent, trust, policy) is None:
918        # Refused without the flag this policy now supplies: that refusal says nothing about the new invocation.
919        return None
920    # A refusal the CLI returned under this same invocation stays binding: no retry in this folder.
921    return (f"workspace trust required for {trust.get('workspace') or doc.get('repository')} "
922            f"(policy {policy}; run howlplane factory prepare or choose --workspace-trust bypass)")

Why this session's workspace refuses the agent, or None. Scoped to the workspace, never the agent.

def capability_skip_reason(doc: dict[str, typing.Any], agent: str, role: str) -> str | None: 
925def capability_skip_reason(doc: dict[str, Any], agent: str, role: str) -> str | None:
926    state = agent_record(doc, agent)
927    if state["state"] == "RESERVED":
928        return "reserved"
929    trust_block = workspace_trust_block(doc, agent)
930    if trust_block:
931        # An explicit orchestrator choice cannot answer a vendor trust prompt.
932        return trust_block
933    # A role hard failure outranks an explicit orchestrator choice: selecting an
934    # agent is not consent to burn another call on capacity it just exhausted.
935    if role in state["capacity"]:
936        return capacity_reason(state["capacity"][role])
937    if state["capabilities"]["unattended_execution"] is not False:
938        return None
939    if doc.get("requested_orchestrator") == agent:
940        return "explicit override"
941    return "unattended execution unavailable"
def exclusions(doc: dict[str, typing.Any], role: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]: 
944def exclusions(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
945    """Why each agent is not a candidate for this role, for the terminal explanation."""
946    eligible = {agent for agent, _ in candidates(doc, role)}
947    found = []
948    for agent in AGENTS:
949        state = agent_record(doc, agent)
950        if agent in eligible and not (role == "review" and agent == doc.get("implementer")):
951            continue
952        reason = capability_skip_reason(doc, agent, role)
953        if reason in (None, "explicit override"):
954            if role == "review" and agent == doc.get("implementer"):
955                reason = "implemented this change; audit must be independent"
956            elif state["state"] == "UNAVAILABLE":
957                reason = "unavailable"
958            elif role == "acceptance":
959                reason = "not the session orchestrator"
960            elif any(item["stage"] == role and item["agent"] == agent and timed_out(doc, role, agent, item["model"])
961                     for item in doc.get("timed_out_assignments", [])):
962                reason = (f"timed out at the {execution_budget(doc, role)}s execution budget; a retry needs a changed "
963                          "budget, model, or scope (capacity unaffected)")
964            else:
965                reason = "no usable model remains"
966        found.append({"agent": agent, "reason": reason})
967    return found

Why each agent is not a candidate for this role, for the terminal explanation.

def candidates(doc: dict[str, typing.Any], role: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]: 
 970def candidates(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
 971    agents = {agent: agent_record(doc, agent) for agent in AGENTS}
 972    lead = doc["orchestrator"]
 973    order = list(AGENTS)
 974    if lead != "AUTO":
 975        order.remove(lead)
 976        order.insert(0, lead)
 977    if role == "review" and doc.get("implementer") in order:
 978        order.remove(doc["implementer"])
 979    if doc["strategy"] == "ECONOMY":
 980        order.sort(key=lambda value: (value not in ("agy", "cursor"), value != lead))
 981    elif doc["strategy"] == "QUALITY":
 982        order.sort(key=lambda value: (value not in ("claude_code", "codex"), value != lead))
 983    if role in {"planning", "acceptance"} and lead != "AUTO" and lead in order:
 984        order.remove(lead)
 985        order.insert(0, lead)
 986    if (is_mutating_role(role) and doc.get("requested_orchestrator", "AUTO") == "AUTO"
 987            and doc["strategy"] != "ECONOMY" and IMPLEMENTATION_PREFERENCE in order):
 988        # Only when the user chose no orchestrator: otherwise the AUTO-selected planner also
 989        # implements. Claude-implemented sessions converged 1 of 4 under falsifying review,
 990        # Codex-implemented ones 6 of 6 (DOG-023); the others stay in order as fallbacks.
 991        order.remove(IMPLEMENTATION_PREFERENCE)
 992        order.insert(0, IMPLEMENTATION_PREFERENCE)
 993    if role == "acceptance":
 994        # Only the orchestrator accepts, unless it has been disqualified for a reason unrelated to
 995        # the work (capability, availability, capacity). Then the next eligible agent takes over so
 996        # the session cannot deadlock (DOG-010).
 997        # A verdict from ANY agent is final until the repository changes: shopping a rejection around
 998        # until some agent accepts is a false success (run-007, where Codex rejected and Cursor accepted).
 999        judged = any(agent_record(doc, agent)["capacity"].get("acceptance", {}).get("reason") in VERDICT_FAILURES
1000                     for agent in AGENTS)
1001        if lead == "AUTO" or judged:
1002            order = order[:1]
1003    selected = []
1004    for agent in order:
1005        state = agents[agent]["state"]
1006        skip_reason = capability_skip_reason(doc, agent, role)
1007        explicit_override = skip_reason == "explicit override"
1008        if state == "RESERVED" or state not in {"AVAILABLE", "DEGRADED"}:
1009            continue
1010        if skip_reason and not explicit_override:
1011            continue
1012        configured = doc["role_models"].get(role, {}).get(agent, "AUTO")
1013        discovered = agents[agent]["models"]
1014        if configured != "AUTO":
1015            if configured not in discovered and configured not in doc.get("known_models", {}).get(agent, []):
1016                continue
1017            models = [configured]
1018        else:
1019            models = discovered or ["UNKNOWN"]
1020        for model in models[:2]:
1021            if doc["model_states"].get(f"{agent}:{model}") != "EXHAUSTED" and not timed_out(doc, role, agent, model):
1022                selected.append((agent, model))
1023    fallback = [] if role == "acceptance" else doc.get("fallbacks", {}).get(role, [])
1024    if fallback:
1025        for item in fallback:
1026            agent, model = item.split(":", 1)
1027            skip_reason = capability_skip_reason(doc, agent, role)
1028            if agents[agent]["state"] == "AVAILABLE" and skip_reason in (None, "explicit override") and (
1029                model == "UNKNOWN" or model in agents[agent]["models"]
1030                or model in doc.get("known_models", {}).get(agent, [])
1031            ) and doc["model_states"].get(item) != "EXHAUSTED" and not timed_out(doc, role, agent, model):
1032                selected.append((agent, model))
1033        rank = {item: index for index, item in enumerate(fallback)}
1034        selected.sort(key=lambda pair: rank.get(f"{pair[0]}:{pair[1]}", len(rank)))
1035    return list(dict.fromkeys(selected))[:8]
def question(label: str, default: str) -> str:
