def setup(args: argparse.Namespace, repo: pathlib.Path) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
1043def setup(args: argparse.Namespace, repo: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
1044    interactive = sys.stdin.isatty() and not args.input
1045    goal = args.input or (question("1. Goal", "") if interactive else "")
1046    if not goal:
1047        raise ValueError("A goal is required")
1048    lead = args.orchestrator or (question("2. Orchestrator (AUTO/agent)", "AUTO") if interactive else "AUTO")
1049    availability_text = question("3. Agent availability (AUTO or agent=RESERVED,...)", "AUTO") if interactive else "AUTO"
1050    availability = {agent: "AUTO" for agent in AGENTS}
1051    if availability_text != "AUTO":
1052        for item in availability_text.split(","):
1053            pair = item.strip().split("=", 1)
1054            if len(pair) != 2 or pair[0] not in AGENTS:
1055                raise ValueError("Expected agent=RESERVED or agent=UNAVAILABLE")
1056            availability[pair[0]] = pair[1].upper()
1057    for agent in AGENTS:
1058        option = getattr(args, agent)
1059        if option:
1060            availability[agent] = option
1061    strategy = args.strategy or (question("4. Strategy (BALANCED/ECONOMY/QUALITY)", "BALANCED") if interactive else "BALANCED")
1062    model_text = args.models or (question("5. Role models (AUTO or role:agent:model)", "AUTO") if interactive else "AUTO")
1063    fallback_text = args.fallbacks or (question("6. Ordered fallback (AUTO or role:agent:model,...)", "AUTO") if interactive else "AUTO")
1064    failover = args.failover or (question("7. Failover (AUTO REROUTE/OFF)", "AUTO REROUTE") if interactive else "AUTO REROUTE")
1065    policy = args.policy or (question("8. Execution policy", "PLAN + EXECUTE + INDEPENDENT AUDIT") if interactive else "PLAN + EXECUTE + INDEPENDENT AUDIT")
1066    if lead != "AUTO" and lead not in AGENTS:
1067        raise ValueError("Unsupported orchestrator")
1068    if strategy not in {"BALANCED", "ECONOMY", "QUALITY"} or failover not in {"AUTO REROUTE", "OFF"}:
1069        raise ValueError("Unsupported strategy or failover policy")
1070    if policy not in {"PLAN + EXECUTE + INDEPENDENT AUDIT", "PLAN ONLY", "PLAN + EXECUTE"}:
1071        raise ValueError("Unsupported execution policy")
1072    if any(value.upper() not in {"AUTO", "RESERVED", "UNAVAILABLE"} for value in availability.values()):
1073        raise ValueError("Unsupported agent availability")
1074    role_models: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
1075    for role, agent, model in parse_role_model_triples(model_text):
1076        role_models.setdefault(role, {})[agent] = model
1077    fallbacks: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
1078    for role, agent, model in parse_role_model_triples(fallback_text):
1079        fallbacks.setdefault(role, []).append(f"{agent}:{model}")
1080    budget = {**default_execution_budget(), **parse_execution_budget(getattr(args, "execution_budget", None))}
1081    snapshot = evidence(repo)
1082    token = uuid.uuid4().hex
1083    resolved_policy = workspace_trust.resolve_policy()
1084    agents = inventory(availability, Path(snapshot["root"]), resolved_policy["policy"])
1085    model_states = {f"{agent}:{limit.rsplit(':', 1)[0]}": "EXHAUSTED"
1086                    for agent, record in agents.items() for limit in record["readiness"]["model_limits"]}
1087    if lead != "AUTO" and agents[lead]["state"] != "AVAILABLE":
1088        record = agents[lead]
1089        reason = record.get("unavailable_reason") or record["capabilities"].get("reason") or record["state"]
1090        raise OperatorFailure(OperatorError(
1091            "ORCHESTRATOR_UNAVAILABLE", f"The selected orchestrator {lead} is not available ({reason}).",
1092            "HowlPlane's readiness evidence for this agent says it cannot run unattended right now.",
1093            "Pick another agent, use AUTO, or refresh the evidence for this agent.",
1094            f"howlplane agents doctor --live --repo {repo}"))
1095    if lead != "AUTO" and (agents[lead].get("workspace_trust") or {}).get("effective_state") == workspace_trust.TRUST_REQUIRED:
1096        raise ValueError(f"Selected orchestrator {AGENT_NAMES.get(lead, lead)} does not trust {snapshot['root']} yet "
1097                         f"(workspace trust policy {resolved_policy['policy']}); prepare it with `howlplane factory prepare` "
1098                         "or choose `--workspace-trust bypass`")
1099    return {
1100        "schema": SCHEMA, "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION, "id": uuid.uuid4().hex, "created_at": now(), "repository": snapshot["root"],
1101        "goal": redact(goal), "constraints": [redact(item) for item in args.constraint],
1102        "requested_orchestrator": lead, "selected_orchestrator": None if lead == "AUTO" else lead,
1103        "orchestrator": lead, "agents": agents, "strategy": strategy,
1104        "role_models": role_models, "fallbacks": fallbacks,
1105        "failover": failover, "policy": policy, "status": "PLANNED", "stage": "planning",
1106        "model_states": model_states, "known_models": {}, "attempts": [], "tests": [], "reroutes": [],
1107        "execution_budget": budget, "timed_out_assignments": [], "workspace_trust_policy": resolved_policy,
1108        "verify_command": args.verify,
1109        "repository_evidence": snapshot, "base_dirty": dirty_paths(Path(snapshot["root"])),
1110        "lease": {"token": token, "pid": os.getpid(), "renewed_at": time.time()},
1111    }
def audit_evidence_for_acceptance(doc: dict[str, typing.Any]) -> str: 
1114def audit_evidence_for_acceptance(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
1115    """Hand the acceptance worker the independent audit it is told to weigh.
1116
1117    Review verdicts exist only in the session manifest; without them an
1118    orchestrator that is told to inspect the audit can only reject for missing
1119    evidence (DOG-002). Superseded findings are included so a later CLEAN
1120    verdict never silently hides them.
1121    """
1122    reviews = [item for item in doc["attempts"] if item.get("stage") == "review" and item.get("verdict_excerpt") is not None]
1123    if not reviews:
1124        return ""
1125    lines = [" Independent audit evidence recorded by HowlPlane (verdicts from reviewers other than you):"]
1126    for item in reviews:
1127        no_verdict = item.get("failure") == "AUDIT_NO_VERDICT"
1128        earlier_round = item.get("rework_round", 0) < doc.get("rework_rounds", 0)
1129        outcome = ("NO VERDICT (provider returned no text; not a finding, do not treat as unresolved)" if no_verdict else
1130                   f"FINDINGS FROM REWORK ROUND {item.get('rework_round', 0)}; the implementer was sent back to address them and "
1131                   "the work was re-reviewed. Judge by the latest review, and check whether these were actually fixed" if earlier_round and item.get("state") != "SUCCEEDED" else
1132                   "ACCEPTED AS CLEAN" if item.get("state") == "SUCCEEDED" else f"NOT CLEAN ({item.get('failure')})")
1133        excerpt = item["verdict_excerpt"].strip()[-AUDIT_EVIDENCE_CHARS:] or "(reviewer returned no text)"
1134        lines.append(f"\n--- {AGENT_NAMES.get(item['agent'], item['agent'])} review, {outcome} ---\n{excerpt}")
1135    return "".join(lines) + "\n--- end of audit evidence ---"

Hand the acceptance worker the independent audit it is told to weigh.

Review verdicts exist only in the session manifest; without them an orchestrator that is told to inspect the audit can only reject for missing evidence (DOG-002). Superseded findings are included so a later CLEAN verdict never silently hides them.

REVIEW_VERDICT_CONTRACT = 'Classify every finding as BLOCKING or NON-BLOCKING. BLOCKING means: incorrect behavior, a goal requirement not met, required behavior without working tests, a failing test, or documentation or evidence that is false. Hardening ideas, style, unlikely edge cases, and residual risks are NON-BLOCKING. End with exactly AUDIT_STATUS: FINDINGS if any BLOCKING finding remains; otherwise end with exactly AUDIT_STATUS: CLEAN.'
def verification_evidence_for_review(doc: dict[str, typing.Any]) -> str: 
1148def verification_evidence_for_review(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
1149    """Give the reviewer the checks HowlPlane itself ran on the current tree.
1150
1151    Read-only reviewers often have no shell, so without this they report the
1152    test gate as unproven (DOG-014). `doc["tests"]` is cleared whenever the
1153    repository changes outside the session, and every review directly follows
1154    a verification, so the latest result per command describes this tree.
1155    """
1156    latest: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
1157    for item in doc.get("tests", []):
1158        command = item["command"] if isinstance(item["command"], str) else " ".join(item["command"])
1159        latest[command] = item
1160    if not latest:
1161        return ""
1162    lines = [" HowlPlane itself ran these checks on the current tree (harness evidence, not implementer claims):"]
1163    for command, item in latest.items():
1164        lines.append(f"\n--- `{command}` exit {item['exit_code']} ---\n{item.get('output', '').strip()[-600:]}")
1165    return "".join(lines) + "\n--- end of verification evidence ---"

PLAN_VERIFY_CONTRACT = " End the plan with one line VERIFY_COMMAND: <the single command, run from the repository root, that will run the project's automated tests once implemented>, with no pipes, redirections, or chained commands; or VERIFY_COMMAND: NONE if the goal needs no tests."
def planned_verify_command(plan: str) -> list[str] | None: 
1175def planned_verify_command(plan: str) -> list[str] | None:
1176    """The plan's test command, if it named one HowlPlane may grant (DOG-018).
1177
1178    The implementer of a new repository is granted this command, so it is held to
1179    the same deny floor as a discovered command: anything that floor refuses,
1180    or that carries shell operators, is ignored rather than granted.
1181    """
1182    matches = _VERIFY_LINE.findall(plan or "")
1183    if not matches:
1184        return None
1185    text = matches[-1].strip().strip("`").strip()
1186    if not text or text.upper() == "NONE":
1187        return None
1188    try:
1189        command = shlex.split(text)
1190    except ValueError:
1191        return None
1192    if not command or any(marker in text for marker in ("&", ";", "|", "$", "`", ">", "<")):
1193        return None
1194    return command if command_to_bash_specifier(command) else None

def execute_assignment( doc: dict[str, typing.Any], role: str, agent: str, model: str, repo: pathlib.Path) -> Any: 
1202def execute_assignment(doc: dict[str, Any], role: str, agent: str, model: str, repo: Path) -> Any:
1203    instructions = (
1204        f"Goal: {doc['goal']}\nRole: {role}. Work only in {repo}. "
1205        # Told nothing, workers re-ran `howlplane route` and copied this session's manifest, lease token
1206        # included, into the user's repository to show "the normal Howl workflow" (DOG-025, run-027).
1207        f"You are working inside HowlPlane orchestration session {doc['id'][:8]}, which is the Howl workflow for "
1208        "this goal: HowlPlane itself runs planning, routing, independent review, and acceptance. Do not run howl or "
1209        "howlplane commands, and do not read HowlPlane's state files or copy them into the repository. "
1210        "Report files changed, tests run, remaining risks, and completion status. "
1211        "Respect repository rules. Do not commit, push, publish, or change other worktrees. "
1212        f"Constraints: {'; '.join(doc['constraints']) or 'none'}. "
1213    )
1214    plan = doc.get("plan_excerpt")
1215    if plan and role in {"review", "acceptance"}:
1216        instructions += ("HowlPlane's planning stage made this approach decision; it is the workflow evidence, so judge the "
1217                         "work against it and do not require workflow artifacts in the repository:\n" + plan + "\n")
1218    if role == "review":
1219        instructions += ("Independently inspect the current diff and falsify correctness. Do not edit files. "
1220                         + REVIEW_VERDICT_CONTRACT + verification_evidence_for_review(doc) + session_diff_evidence(doc, repo))
1221    elif role == "acceptance":
1222        instructions += "As session orchestrator, inspect implementation, tests, and independent audit. Do not edit files. End with exactly ACCEPTANCE_STATUS: ACCEPTED only if evidence supports the goal; otherwise end with ACCEPTANCE_STATUS: REJECTED."
1223        instructions += audit_evidence_for_acceptance(doc) + session_diff_evidence(doc, repo)
1224        if (doc.get("rework") or {}).get("source") == "acceptance":
1225            instructions += (f" An earlier acceptance check rejected the work and the implementer was sent back to address it "
1226                             f"(rework round {doc['rework']['round']}). Judge the current repository, and check whether "
1227                             "these reasons were actually resolved:\n" + doc["rework"]["findings"])
1228    elif role == "implementation":
1229        if plan:
1230            instructions += ("HowlPlane's planning stage produced this plan; follow it unless the repository shows it is "
1231                             "wrong, and say where you departed from it:\n" + plan + "\n")
1232        instructions += ("Implement the goal and run relevant local tests. Inspect existing partial changes first. Before "
1233                         "finishing, check that every behavior your documentation promises holds for all inputs it "
1234                         "covers, error cases included, and that its examples run in the order shown.")
1235        verify = implementation_verify_command(doc)
1236        if verify:
1237            # Backticks delimit it: a bare `-t .` followed by the sentence's full stop was run as `-t ..` (DOG-020).
1238            instructions += (f" The plan's test command is `{shlex.join(verify)}`. Make it pass and run it exactly as "
1239                             "written, without pipes or redirections.")
1240        if doc.get("rework"):
1241            source = {"acceptance": "The acceptance check", "verification": "HowlPlane's verification run"}.get(
1242                doc["rework"].get("source"), "Independent review")
1243            # A finding is one reproduced instance; patching only that instance left the same false claim for the
1244            # next review to find, until rework ran out (DOG-021, runs 019 and 021).
1245            instructions += (f" {source} (rework round {doc['rework']['round']}) found issues with the current work. Treat "
1246                             "each valid finding as an example of a defect class: fix its root cause, check the other inputs "
1247                             "and error paths the same code or documented claim covers, and add regression tests for them. "
1248                             "Run the tests again, and state which findings you rejected and why. If no change is warranted, "
1249                             "report IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS: NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED with your reasons. Findings:\n"
1250                             + doc["rework"]["findings"])
1251        if is_existing_wip_context(doc["goal"], doc.get("constraints", [])):
1252            instructions += (" Treat current repository changes as intentional work in progress. "
1253                             "If existing changes completely satisfy the goal and no further edits are required, "
1254                             "verify them against local tests and report IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS: NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED.")
1255    else:
1256        instructions += "Produce a bounded implementation plan and acceptance criteria. Do not edit files."
1257        if doc["policy"] != "PLAN ONLY":
1258            instructions += PLAN_VERIFY_CONTRACT
1259    if agent == "claude_code" and not is_mutating_role(role):
1260        # Claude's read-only roles hold Read, Grep and Glob but no shell; a
1261        # shell attempt is denied and fails the assignment, which then marks
1262        # the agent interactive-only for the whole session (DOG-004).
1263        instructions += " Shell commands are unavailable in this role: use only the Read, Grep and Glob tools to inspect files."
1264    elif agent == "claude_code":
1265        # Claude's shell is bounded to granted test commands and read-only Git; a
1266        # refused shell write fails the attempt even if Claude recovers (DOG-018).
1267        instructions += (" Create and change files only with the Edit and Write tools, and inspect them with Read, Glob "
1268                         "and Grep: the shell is limited to the project's test commands and read-only git commands, one "
1269                         "command per call (chained commands are refused), and anything else is refused.")
1270    if any(item.get("stage") == role and item.get("state") == "TIMED_OUT" and item.get("partial_changes") for item in doc["attempts"]):
1271        instructions += (" An earlier attempt at this role reached its execution budget and left partial changes: "
1272                         "inspect and continue them rather than starting over.")
1273    if model != "UNKNOWN":
1274        instructions += f" Use model {model} if the CLI supports selecting it; report actual model identity."
1275    task = TaskSpec(task_id=doc["id"], repository=str(repo), objective=doc["goal"], constraints=doc["constraints"])
1276    if is_mutating_role(role) and implementation_verify_command(doc):
1277        # A bounded shell (Claude) is granted this command alongside any it discovers (DOG-018).
1278        task.metadata["verification_commands"] = [implementation_verify_command(doc)]
1279    backend = AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(agent)
1280    extra: dict[str, Any] = {}
1281    parameters = inspect.signature(backend.execute).parameters
1282    if "workspace_trust_policy" in parameters or any(
1283            item.kind == inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD for item in parameters.values()):
1284        # Built-in CLI backends apply the session's trust policy; a custom
1285        # backend with a fixed signature keeps its bounded contract.
1286        extra["workspace_trust_policy"] = session_trust_policy(doc)
1287    return backend.execute(task, repo, role=role, prompt_override=instructions,
1288                           timeout_seconds=execution_budget(doc, role), model_id=model, **extra)
def checkpoint( doc: dict[str, typing.Any], path: pathlib.Path, token: str, repo: pathlib.Path) -> None: 
1291def checkpoint(doc: dict[str, Any], path: Path, token: str, repo: Path) -> None:
1292    doc["repository_evidence"] = evidence(repo)
1293    doc["lease"]["renewed_at"] = time.time()
1294    with locked(path.parent):
1295        save(path, doc, token)
def derive_verify_command(repo: pathlib.Path) -> list[str] | None: 
1298def derive_verify_command(repo: Path) -> list[str] | None:
1299    """The repository's own test command, as HowlPlane's project discovery finds it (DOG-009)."""
1300    try:
1301        from howlplane.control_plane.project_adapter import ProjectAdapter
1302        commands = ProjectAdapter.discover(repo).test_commands
1303    except Exception:
1304        return None
1305    return list(commands[0]) if commands else None

The repository's own test command, as HowlPlane's project discovery finds it (DOG-009).

def test_output_excerpt(text: str, limit: int = 3000) -> str: 
1308def test_output_excerpt(text: str, limit: int = TEST_OUTPUT_CHARS) -> str:
1309    """Keep the lines that say what failed, plus the tail with the runner's summary."""
1310    text = redact(text)
1311    if len(text) <= limit:
1312        return text
1313    tail = text[-(limit // 2):]
1314    lines = text[:-(limit // 2)].splitlines()
1315    spans: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
1316    for number, line in enumerate(lines):
1317        if _FAILURE_LINE.search(line):
1318            start, end = max(number - 1, 0), min(number + 12, len(lines))
1319            if spans and start <= spans[-1][1]:
1320                spans[-1] = (spans[-1][0], end)
1321            else:
1322                spans.append((start, end))
1323    if not spans:
1324        return "[... earlier output trimmed by HowlPlane ...]\n" + text[-limit:]
1325    budget, parts = limit - len(tail), []
1326    for start, end in spans:
1327        block = "\n".join(lines[start:end])
1328        if len(block) > budget:
1329            if not parts:
1330                parts.append(block[:budget])
1331            break
1332        parts.append(block)
1333        budget -= len(block)
1334    return "\n[...]\n".join(parts) + "\n[... output trimmed by HowlPlane; tail follows ...]\n" + tail

Keep the lines that say what failed, plus the tail with the runner's summary.

def run_verification(doc: dict[str, typing.Any], repo: pathlib.Path) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
1337def run_verification(doc: dict[str, Any], repo: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
1338    """Run the session's verification command and return its test record.
1339
1340    A command that cannot start or overruns its deadline is a verification
1341    result, not a crash: the record says so in place of the runner's output.
1342    """
1343    command = doc["verify_command"]
1344    record: dict[str, Any] = {"command": command, "rework_round": doc.get("rework_rounds", 0)}
1345    try:
1346        verified = subprocess.run(command, cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=VERIFY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
1347    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
1348        partial = "".join(part.decode(errors="replace") if isinstance(part, bytes) else part
1349                          for part in (exc.stdout, exc.stderr) if part)
1350        record.update(exit_code=124, timed_out=True, output=test_output_excerpt(
1351            f"{partial}\nHowlPlane stopped the command after {VERIFY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s."))
1352    except OSError as exc:
1353        record.update(exit_code=127, not_runnable=True, output=redact(f"HowlPlane could not run the command: {exc}"))
1354    else:
1355        record.update(exit_code=verified.returncode, output=test_output_excerpt(verified.stdout + verified.stderr))
1356    return record

Run the session's verification command and return its test record.

A command that cannot start or overruns its deadline is a verification result, not a crash: the record says so in place of the runner's output.

def verification_findings(record: dict[str, typing.Any]) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
1359def verification_findings(record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
1360    """Shape a failed verification like a verdict, so it can drive the bounded rework loop."""
1361    command = record["command"] if isinstance(record["command"], str) else shlex.join(record["command"])
1362    return {"agent": "howlplane", "stage": "verification",
1363            "verdict_excerpt": f"HowlPlane ran `{command}` on the implemented tree and it exited {record['exit_code']}. "
1364                               f"Make it pass. Its output (failures first):\n{record.get('output', '')}"}

Shape a failed verification like a verdict, so it can drive the bounded rework loop.

def validation_failure_reason(doc: dict[str, typing.Any]) -> str: 
1367def validation_failure_reason(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
1368    failure = doc["validation_failure"]
1369    command = failure["command"] if isinstance(failure["command"], str) else shlex.join(failure["command"])
1370    if failure.get("not_runnable"):
1371        return f"Configured validation could not run: `{command}` (check the command and its tools are installed)"
1372    return (f"Configured validation failed: `{command}` exited {failure['exit_code']} after "
1373            f"{failure['rework_rounds']} of {MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS} rework round(s)")
def begin_rework(doc: dict[str, typing.Any], findings: dict[str, typing.Any]) -> None: 
1376def begin_rework(doc: dict[str, Any], findings: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1377    """Send review findings, an acceptance rejection, or a failed verification back to implementation
1378    (bounded by MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS)."""
1379    doc["rework_rounds"] = doc.get("rework_rounds", 0) + 1
1380    doc["rework"] = {"round": doc["rework_rounds"], "reviewer": findings["agent"], "source": findings["stage"],
1381                     "findings": findings["verdict_excerpt"], "at": now()}
1382    doc["previous_implementer"] = doc.pop("implementer", None)
1383    doc.pop("audit", None)

Send review findings, an acceptance rejection, or a failed verification back to implementation (bounded by MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS).

VERDICT_FAILURES = frozenset({'AUDIT_NO_VERDICT', 'AUDIT_FINDINGS_OR_UNCONFIRMED', 'ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED'})
def expire_verdict_exclusions(doc: dict[str, typing.Any]) -> None: 
1389def expire_verdict_exclusions(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1390    """Drop review/acceptance exclusions that were verdicts on a repository state that no longer exists.
1391
1392    A rejection judges one state of the work. Once the repository has changed (for
1393    example the user fixed what the verdict named), the same agent must be able to
1394    judge the new state, or `resume` finds no acceptance worker (DOG-007).
1395    """
1396    for agent in AGENTS:
1397        state = agent_record(doc, agent)
1398        for role in ("review", "acceptance"):
1399            if state["capacity"].get(role, {}).get("reason") in VERDICT_FAILURES:
1400                del state["capacity"][role]
1401        if (state["state"] == "DEGRADED" and not state["capacity"]
1402                and state["capabilities"]["unattended_execution"] is not False):
1403            state["state"] = "AVAILABLE"
1404    doc.pop("audit", None)
1405    doc.pop("acceptance", None)
1406    doc.pop("exclusions", None)

Drop review/acceptance exclusions that were verdicts on a repository state that no longer exists.

A rejection judges one state of the work. Once the repository has changed (for example the user fixed what the verdict named), the same agent must be able to judge the new state, or resume finds no acceptance worker (DOG-007).

def reconcile(doc: dict[str, typing.Any], repo: pathlib.Path) -> None: 
1409def reconcile(doc: dict[str, Any], repo: Path) -> None:
1410    if doc["attempts"] and doc["attempts"][-1].get("state") == "ASSIGNED":
1411        doc["attempts"][-1].update({"state": "REVOKED", "failure": "INTERRUPTED_OR_STALE_LEASE", "finished_at": now()})
1412    actual = evidence(repo)
1413    previous = doc["repository_evidence"]
1414    if fingerprint(actual) != fingerprint(previous):
1415        doc["reconciliation"] = {"recorded": fingerprint(previous), "actual": fingerprint(actual), "at": now(), "needs_validation": True}
1416        doc["tests"] = []
1417        doc["stage"] = "implementation" if doc["policy"] != "PLAN ONLY" else "planning"
1418        expire_verdict_exclusions(doc)
1419    doc["repository_evidence"] = actual
def run( doc: dict[str, typing.Any], path: pathlib.Path, repo: pathlib.Path, progress: SessionProgress | None = None) -> int: 
1422def run(doc: dict[str, Any], path: Path, repo: Path, progress: SessionProgress | None = None) -> int:
1423    token = doc["lease"]["token"]
1424    stages = ["planning"] if doc["policy"] == "PLAN ONLY" else ["planning", "implementation"]
1425    if doc["policy"] == "PLAN + EXECUTE + INDEPENDENT AUDIT":
1426        stages.append("review")
1427    if doc["policy"] != "PLAN ONLY":
1428        stages.append("acceptance")
1429    index = stages.index(doc["stage"]) if doc["stage"] in stages else 0
1430    while index < len(stages):
1431        stage = stages[index]
1432        index += 1
1433        doc["stage"] = stage
1434        doc["status"] = stage.upper()
1435        checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1436        if progress:
1437            progress.phase(stage, {"planning": "Building implementation plan", "implementation": "Dispatching implementation worker", "review": "Independent audit started", "acceptance": "Orchestrator validating final result"}[stage])
1438            notices = doc.setdefault("capability_notices", [])
1439            for candidate in AGENTS:
1440                reason = capability_skip_reason(doc, candidate, stage)
1441                # Session-wide reasons are announced once; capacity is per role.
1442                notice = f"{candidate}:{reason}" if reason in ("explicit override", "unattended execution unavailable") else f"{candidate}:{stage}:{reason}"
1443                if reason in (None, "reserved") or notice in notices:
1444                    continue
1445                if reason == "explicit override":
1446                    progress.explicit_override_warning(candidate)
1447                else:
1448                    progress.route_skip(candidate, reason)
1449                notices.append(notice)
1450
1451        def eligible() -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
1452            options = candidates(doc, stage)
1453            return [pair for pair in options if not (stage == "review" and pair[0] == doc.get("implementer"))]
1454
1455        succeeded = False
1456        findings_attempt: dict[str, Any] | None = None
1457        transient_retries: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}
1458        attempted: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
1459        retry: tuple[str, str] | None = None
1460        prev_reroute: tuple[str, str] | None = None
1461
1462        if stage == "implementation":
1463            if doc.get("implementer"):
1464                # Implementation already completed or previously succeeded
1465                succeeded = True
1466            elif doc.get("reconciliation", {}).get("needs_validation") and doc.get("verify_command"):
1467                check = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *guarded_git_args(["diff", "--check"])], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
1468                if check.returncode == 0:
1469                    verified = run_verification(doc, repo)
1470                    if verified["exit_code"] == 0:
1471                        doc["implementer"] = "external"
1472                        doc["tests"].append({"command": "git diff --check", "exit_code": check.returncode, "output": redact(check.stderr[:500])})
1473                        doc["tests"].append(verified)
1474                        doc["reconciliation"]["needs_validation"] = False
1475                        doc.pop("validation_failure", None)
1476                        succeeded = True
1477
1478        while not succeeded:
1479            # Candidates are recomputed from session evidence after every
1480            # failure, so the next assignment (and the REROUTE naming it) never
1481            # reflects a list selected before the failure was recorded.
1482            if retry:
1483                agent, model = retry
1484                retry = None
1485            else:
1486                pending = [pair for pair in eligible() if pair not in attempted]
1487                if not pending:
1488                    break
1489                # After a deadline stop, prefer a different worker; the timed-out
1490                # agent's other models stay eligible, just behind the rest.
1491                slow = {item["agent"] for item in doc["timed_out_assignments"] if item["stage"] == stage}
1492                pending.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[0] in slow)
1493                agent, model = pending[0]
1494            attempted.append((agent, model))
1495            if prev_reroute and progress:
1496                source_agent, reason = prev_reroute
1497                progress.reroute(doc["id"][:8], source_agent, agent, reason)
1498                prev_reroute = None
1499            before = evidence(repo)
1500            invocation_policy = session_trust_policy(doc)
1501            assignment = {"task_id": doc["id"][:8], "stage": stage, "agent": agent, "model": model, "started_at": now(), "fence": token, "state": "ASSIGNED",
1502                          "rework_round": doc.get("rework_rounds", 0),
1503                          "workspace_trust": {"policy": invocation_policy,
1504                                              "mechanism": workspace_trust.mechanism(agent, invocation_policy)},
1505                          "execution_budget_seconds": execution_budget(doc, stage), "selection_evidence": selection_evidence(doc, agent)}
1506            doc["attempts"].append(assignment)
1507            checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1508            if progress:
1509                progress.selection(agent, stage, assignment["selection_evidence"])
1510                progress.assignment(doc["id"][:8], agent, stage)
1511                progress._write("START", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} started {stage}")
1512                with progress.waiting():
1513                    result = execute_assignment(doc, stage, agent, model, repo)
1514            else:
1515                result = execute_assignment(doc, stage, agent, model, repo)
1516            failure = ProviderPoolManager.classify_result(agent, result)
1517            after = evidence(repo)
1518            assignment.update({"state": "SUCCEEDED" if result.success else "REVOKED", "exit_code": result.exit_code,
1519                               "failure": None if result.success else failure.value, "finished_at": now(),
1520                               "repo_before": fingerprint(before), "repo_after": fingerprint(after),
1521                               "output_sha256": fingerprint({"stdout": result.stdout}),
1522                               "error": redact((result.error_message or result.stderr)[:200])})
1523            no_change_detail = ""
1524            if result.success and stage == "implementation" and before == after:
1525                is_wip = is_existing_wip_context(doc["goal"], doc.get("constraints", [])) or bool(doc.get("rework"))
1526                has_repo_wip = bool(before.get("status", "").strip())
1527                stdout_text = result.stdout or ""
1528                reports_no_change = bool(
1529                    re.search(r"\b(?:IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS:\s*)?NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED\b", stdout_text, re.IGNORECASE)
1530                    or re.search(r"\bno (?:further |additional )?changes? (?:are )?(?:needed|required)\b", stdout_text, re.IGNORECASE)
1531                    or re.search(r"\bexisting (?:changes|work) (?:already )?(?:satisfies?|satisfy|completes?|complete)\b", stdout_text, re.IGNORECASE)
1532                )
1533                accepted_no_change = False
1534                if has_repo_wip and (is_wip or reports_no_change):
1535                    check = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *guarded_git_args(["diff", "--check"])], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
1536                    verified_ok = True
1537                    if doc.get("verify_command"):
1538                        verified_ok = run_verification(doc, repo)["exit_code"] == 0
1539                    if check.returncode == 0 and verified_ok:
1540                        accepted_no_change = True
1541                        assignment["state"] = "SUCCEEDED"
1542                        assignment["failure"] = None
1543                        assignment["outcome"] = "NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED"
1544                        if progress:
1545                            progress._write("WIP", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} verified existing WIP: NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED")
1546
1547                if not accepted_no_change:
1548                    assignment["state"] = "REVOKED"
1549                    assignment["failure"] = "NO_REPOSITORY_CHANGE"
1550                    no_change_detail = " (no repository delta detected)"
1551            if stage in {"review", "acceptance"} and before != after:
1552                assignment["state"] = "REVOKED"
1553                assignment["failure"] = "READ_ONLY_ROLE_MUTATED_REPOSITORY"
1554            if result.success and stage == "review" and not result.stdout.strip().endswith("AUDIT_STATUS: CLEAN"):
1555                assignment["state"] = "REVOKED"
1556                # An empty reply is a provider fault, not a finding (DOG-003).
1557                assignment["failure"] = "AUDIT_FINDINGS_OR_UNCONFIRMED" if result.stdout.strip() else "AUDIT_NO_VERDICT"
1558            if result.success and stage == "acceptance" and not result.stdout.strip().endswith("ACCEPTANCE_STATUS: ACCEPTED"):
1559                assignment["state"] = "REVOKED"
1560                assignment["failure"] = "ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED"
1561            grant_gap = (permission_grant_gap(result, stage, before != after)
1562                         if assignment["failure"] == "EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED" else [])
1563            if grant_gap:
1564                assignment["denied_commands"] = [redact(command) for command in grant_gap]
1565            if result.success and stage in {"review", "acceptance"}:
1566                # The verdict is the only record of why a reviewer or the
1567                # orchestrator stopped the session; the hash alone cannot be read.
1568                assignment["verdict_excerpt"] = redact((result.stdout or "").strip()[-VERDICT_EXCERPT_CHARS:])
1569            if assignment["failure"] in ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_FAILURES:
1570                metadata = getattr(result, "metadata", None) or {}
1571                budget = execution_budget(doc, stage)
1572                assignment.update({"state": "TIMED_OUT", "execution_budget_seconds": budget,
1573                                   "timeout_source": metadata.get("timeout_source"),
1574                                   "budget_derived": metadata.get("budget_derived") is True,
1575                                   "partial_changes": before != after})
1576                record_timeout(doc, stage, agent, model, budget, assignment["timeout_source"], assignment["finished_at"])
1577                if progress:
1578                    progress.attempt_timed_out(agent, stage, budget, before != after)
1579            if assignment["failure"] in WORKSPACE_TRUST_FAILURES:
1580                assignment["workspace"] = str(repo)
1581                agent_readiness.record_workspace_trust(agent, str(repo), stage, "orchestrate session",
1582                                                       policy=invocation_policy)
1583            elif assignment["failure"] is None or assignment["failure"] in UNAVAILABLE_FAILURES | MODEL_LIMIT_FAILURES | (
1584                    {"EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED"} if is_mutating_role(stage) and not grant_gap else set()):
1585                agent_readiness.record_session_outcome(agent, model, assignment["failure"],
1586                                                       detail=f"{result.error_message or ''}\n{result.stderr}")
1587            if assignment["state"] == "SUCCEEDED":
1588                record_capability_success(doc, agent)
1589                if stage == "planning":
1590                    doc["planned_verify_command"] = planned_verify_command(result.stdout)
1591                    doc["plan_excerpt"] = redact((result.stdout or "").strip()[-PLAN_EXCERPT_CHARS:])
1592                    doc["orchestrator"] = agent
1593                    doc["selected_orchestrator"] = agent
1594                    if progress and doc.get("requested_orchestrator") == "AUTO":
1595                        progress.selected_orchestrator(agent)
1596                if stage == "implementation":
1597                    doc["implementer"] = agent
1598                if stage == "review":
1599                    doc["audit"] = "CLEAN"
1600                if stage == "acceptance":
1601                    doc["acceptance"] = "ACCEPTED"
1602                    if agent != doc["orchestrator"]:
1603                        if progress:
1604                            progress._write("TAKEOVER", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(doc['orchestrator'], doc['orchestrator'])} could not accept; "
1605                                                        f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} is now orchestrator")

1608                    doc["known_models"].setdefault(agent, []).append(model)
1609                succeeded = True
1610                checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1611                if progress:
1612                    progress.worker_complete(doc["id"][:8], agent, stage)
1613                break
1614            if stage == "review" and assignment["failure"] == "AUDIT_FINDINGS_OR_UNCONFIRMED" and assignment.get("verdict_excerpt"):
1615                # Real findings are not a worker fault: asking another reviewer until one says CLEAN would hide
1616                # them. The reviewer stays eligible; the findings go back to the implementer or end the session.
1617                findings_attempt = assignment
1618                if progress:
1619                    progress._write("FINDINGS", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} review reported findings")
1620                checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1621                break
1622            if (stage == "acceptance" and assignment["failure"] == "ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED"
1623                    and assignment.get("verdict_excerpt") and "implementation" in stages
1624                    and doc.get("rework_rounds", 0) < MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS):
1625                # A reasoned rejection is actionable (DOG-016): rework it, then the same orchestrator judges
1626                # the changed repository. It is never shopped to another acceptor (DOG-010); once rework is
1627                # spent, the failure path below records it and hands off.
1628                findings_attempt = assignment
1629                if progress:
1630                    progress._write("FINDINGS", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} acceptance rejected; reasons go back to implementation")
1631                checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1632                break
1633            doc["reroutes"].append({"from": f"{agent}:{model}", "stage": stage, "reason": assignment["failure"]})
1634            if progress:
1635                progress._write("FAIL", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} {stage} failed: {assignment['failure']}{no_change_detail}")
1636            # Record the failure before choosing a replacement: the next
1637            # candidate list must already exclude what this attempt proved.
1638            exclusion = record_failure(doc, agent, stage, model, assignment["failure"], grant_gap=bool(grant_gap))
1639            if progress:
1640                if assignment["failure"] in WORKSPACE_TRUST_FAILURES:
1641                    progress._write("TRUST", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(agent, agent)} requires workspace trust for {repo}; "
1642                                             "rerouting (the agent stays eligible elsewhere)")
1643                elif grant_gap:
1644                    progress.permission_gap(agent, stage, assignment["denied_commands"])
1645                elif assignment["failure"] == "EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED" and is_mutating_role(stage):
1646                    progress.capability_downgrade(agent)
1647                elif exclusion:
1648                    progress.role_excluded(agent, stage, exclusion)

1650                    progress.limit(agent, model, assignment["failure"])

1653                doc["reconciliation"] = {"at": now(), "needs_validation": True, "from": agent, "stage": stage}

1655                transient_retries[(agent, model)] = transient_retries.get((agent, model), 0) + 1

1675                                              f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(findings_attempt['agent'], findings_attempt['agent'])}'s findings back to implementation")

1681            if stage == "review":

1690                                       "execution budget. Decompose the goal, or resume with "
1691                                       f"--execution-budget {stage}=<seconds> (max {MAX_EXECUTION_BUDGET_SECONDS}) "
1692                                       "or --retry-timeouts.")

1708            if progress:
1709                progress.validation(False, "Repository diff validation passed" if check.returncode == 0 else "Repository diff validation failed")

1720                    doc["verify_command"], doc["verify_source"] = derived, "derived from the project's discovered test command"

1729                        progress._write("VERIFY", f"No --verify given; using the plan's test command: {' '.join(planned)}")

1734                    with progress.waiting():

1736                else:
1737                    verified = run_verification(doc, repo)
1738                doc["tests"].append(verified)
1739                if progress:
1740                    progress.validation(False, "Configured validation passed" if verified["exit_code"] == 0 else

1743                    # A failing test is a finding about the implementation, as actionable as a reviewer's;
1744                    # handing off at once left the user to rediscover what HowlPlane had just seen (DOG-026).

1746                    if not verified.get("not_runnable") and doc.get("rework_rounds", 0) < MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS:

1748                        if progress:
1749                            progress._write("REWORK", f"Round {doc['rework_rounds']} of {MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS}: sending the "
1750                                                      "failed verification back to implementation")
1751                        checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1752                        index = stages.index("implementation")
1753                        continue
1754                    doc["status"] = "HANDOFF REQUIRED"
1755                    doc["validation_failure"] = {"command": command, "exit_code": verified["exit_code"],
1756                                                 "rework_rounds": doc.get("rework_rounds", 0),
1757                                                 "not_runnable": bool(verified.get("not_runnable"))}
1758                    checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1759                    if progress:
1760                        progress.blocked("HANDOFF REQUIRED", validation_failure_reason(doc),
1761                                         f"howlplane orchestrate resume --repo {repo}" if is_resumable(doc) else None)

1763                doc.pop("validation_failure", None)
1764                if doc.get("reconciliation"):
1765                    doc["reconciliation"]["needs_validation"] = False
1766            elif doc.get("reconciliation", {}).get("needs_validation"):
1767                doc["status"] = "HANDOFF REQUIRED"
1768                doc["validation_gap"] = "Partial or recovered changes require an explicit --verify command"
1769                checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1770                if progress:
1771                    progress.blocked("HANDOFF REQUIRED", doc["validation_gap"], f"howlplane orchestrate resume --repo {repo} --verify <command>" if is_resumable(doc) else None)
1772                return report(doc)
1773            checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1774    doc["status"] = "COMPLETE WITH WARNINGS" if doc.get("reconciliation") else "COMPLETE"
1775    checkpoint(doc, path, token, repo)
1776    if progress:
1777        progress.complete(doc["status"])
1778    result = report(doc)
1779    if doc["status"] in {"COMPLETE", "COMPLETE WITH WARNINGS"} and not doc.get("retain_report"):
1780        with locked(path.parent):
1781            path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
1782    return result
def report(doc: dict[str, typing.Any]) -> int: 
1785def report(doc: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
1786    print("HOWL ORCHESTRATION REPORT")
1787    print(f"Session: {doc['id']}\nGoal: {doc['goal']}\nStatus: {doc['status']}")
1788    print(f"Resumable: {'yes' if is_resumable(doc) else 'no'}")
1789    print(f"Orchestrator: {doc['orchestrator']}\nImplementer: {doc.get('implementer', 'none')}")
1790    print(f"Policy: {doc['policy']}\nConstraints: {', '.join(doc['constraints']) or 'none'}")
1791    print(f"Assignments: {len(doc['attempts'])}\nReroutes: {len(doc['reroutes'])}")
1792    print(f"Repository head: {doc['repository_evidence']['head']}")
1793    print(f"Repository status: {doc['repository_evidence']['status'] or 'clean'}")
1794    print(f"Tests: {json.dumps(doc['tests'])}")
1795    print(f"Independent audit: {doc.get('audit', 'completed' if doc['stage'] == 'review' and (is_final(doc) or doc['status'] == 'HANDOFF REQUIRED') else 'not requested or incomplete')}")
1796    print(f"Recovery: {json.dumps(doc.get('reconciliation', {}))}")
1797    if doc.get("verify_source"):
1798        print(f"Verification command: {' '.join(doc['verify_command'])} ({doc['verify_source']})")
1799    if doc.get("rework_rounds"):
1800        print(f"Rework rounds: {doc['rework_rounds']} of {MAX_REWORK_ROUNDS}")
1801    if doc.get("validation_gap"):
1802        print(f"Validation gap: {doc['validation_gap']}")
1803    if doc.get("validation_failure") and doc["status"] == "HANDOFF REQUIRED":
1804        print(f"Blocked by: {validation_failure_reason(doc)}")
1805        failed = [item for item in doc["tests"] if item.get("exit_code")]
1806        if failed:
1807            print("Failing output (failures first):")
1808            print("\n".join(f"  {line}" for line in failed[-1].get("output", "").splitlines()))
1809        print(f"Next: fix what the output shows (or have an agent do it), then run\n"
1810              f"  howlplane orchestrate resume --repo {doc['repository']}\n"
1811              "Resume re-runs the check on the changed repository and continues to review once it passes; the "
1812              "rework budget is spent, so resuming without a fix fails the same way.")
1813    if doc.get("timed_out_assignments"):
1814        print(f"Timed-out assignments: {json.dumps([{key: item.get(key) for key in ('stage', 'agent', 'model', 'execution_budget_seconds')} for item in doc['timed_out_assignments']])}")
1815    if doc.get("timeout_hint") and is_resumable(doc):
1816        print(f"Timeout guidance: {doc['timeout_hint']}")
1817    if doc.get("exclusions") and (is_final(doc) or doc["status"] == "HANDOFF REQUIRED"):
1818        print(f"Excluded {doc['exclusions']['stage']} workers: {json.dumps(doc['exclusions']['agents'])}")
1819    print(f"Failures: {json.dumps([{'stage': a['stage'], 'agent': a['agent'], 'model': a['model'], 'failure': a.get('failure')} for a in doc['attempts'] if a.get('failure')])}")
1820    if doc["status"] == "HANDOFF REQUIRED" and doc.get("stage") == "acceptance" and any(
1821            a.get("failure") == "ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED" for a in doc["attempts"]):
1822        print("Next: the orchestrator rejected acceptance (verdict below). Address what it names in the repository, then run\n"
1823              f"  howlplane orchestrate resume --repo {doc['repository']} --verify <your test command>\n"
1824              "Changing the repository lets the same session be judged again. If the verdict is not actionable, run\n"
1825              f"  howlplane orchestrate discard --repo {doc['repository']}\nand start a new session.")
1826    for attempt in doc["attempts"]:
1827        if attempt.get("failure") in {"AUDIT_FINDINGS_OR_UNCONFIRMED", "ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED"} and attempt.get("verdict_excerpt"):
1828            # A verdict from an earlier round was sent back for rework and the result judged again; unlabelled,
1829            # a COMPLETE report read as if its "blocking finding remains" were still open (DOG-022).
1830            round_number = attempt.get("rework_round", 0)
1831            superseded = (f", rework round {round_number}: sent back to implementation and re-judged"
1832                          if round_number < doc.get("rework_rounds", 0) else "")
1833            print(f"Verdict from {AGENT_NAMES.get(attempt['agent'], attempt['agent'])} ({attempt['stage']}, {attempt['failure']}{superseded}):")
1834            print("\n".join(f"  {line}" for line in attempt["verdict_excerpt"].splitlines()))
1835        elif attempt.get("stage") == "review" and attempt.get("state") == "SUCCEEDED" and attempt.get("verdict_excerpt"):
1836            # Non-blocking notes exist only here, and a finished session's manifest is removed (DOG-015).
1837            print(f"Review notes from {AGENT_NAMES.get(attempt['agent'], attempt['agent'])} (review, CLEAN):")
1838            print("\n".join(f"  {line}" for line in attempt["verdict_excerpt"].splitlines()))
1839    return 0 if doc["status"] in {"COMPLETE", "COMPLETE WITH WARNINGS"} else 2
def invalid_session_report(doc: Any, reason: str, repo: pathlib.Path) -> int: 
1842def invalid_session_report(doc: Any, reason: str, repo: Path) -> int:
1843    # The manifest is left untouched: rewriting state that cannot be trusted
1844    # would destroy the only evidence of what the session did.
1845    session = doc.get("id", "unknown") if isinstance(doc, dict) else "unknown"
1846    print("HOWL ORCHESTRATION REPORT")
1847    print(f"Session: {redact(str(session))}\nStatus: SESSION_STATE_INVALID\nReason: {redact(reason)}")
1848    print(f"Next: howlplane orchestrate inspect --json --repo {repo}, then discard or repair the session")
1849    return 2
def command(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
1852def command(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
1853    repo = Path(args.repo or os.getcwd()).resolve()
1854    root = state_root()
1855    with locked(root):
1856        active = active_sessions(root, repo)
1857        operation = args.input if args.input in {"resume", "inspect", "discard"} else None
1858        if active and operation is None and not args.separate and sys.stdin.isatty():
1859            choice = question("Unfinished session: Resume, Inspect, Discard, or Start separate", "Resume").lower()
1860            if choice == "start separate":
1861                args.separate = True
1862            elif choice in {"resume", "inspect", "discard"}:
1863                operation = choice
1864            else:
1865                raise ValueError("Unknown session action")
1866        if operation == "inspect":
1867            sessions = active_sessions(root, repo, include_terminal=True)
1868            for s in sessions:
1869                s["resumable"] = is_resumable(s)
1870            if args.json:
1871                print(json.dumps(sessions, indent=2))
1872            else:
1873                target = sessions[:1] if sessions else []
1874                if not target:
1875                    print("No orchestration sessions found")
1876                else:
1877                    for s in target:
1878                        print("HOWL ORCHESTRATION SESSION")
1879                        print(f"Session: {s['id']}")
1880                        print(f"Goal: {s.get('goal', '')}")
1881                        print(f"Status: {s.get('status', '')}")
1882                        print(f"Resumable: {'yes' if s.get('resumable') else 'no'}")
1883                        print(f"Stage: {s.get('stage', '')}")
1884                        if s.get("validation_failure") and s.get("status") == "HANDOFF REQUIRED":
1885                            print(f"Blocked by: {validation_failure_reason(s)}")
1886                        if s.get("implementer"):
1887                            print(f"Implementer: {s['implementer']}")
1888            return 0
1889        if operation == "discard":
1890            for doc in active:
1891                path_for(root, doc["id"]).unlink()
1892            print(f"Discarded {len(active)} active session(s)")
1893            return 0
1894        if operation == "resume":
1895            if not active:
1896                raise ValueError("No unfinished session")
1897            doc = active[0]
1898            try:
1899                migrations = normalize_session(doc)
1900            except SessionStateInvalid as error:
1901                return invalid_session_report(doc, str(error), repo)
1902            previous_orchestrator = doc["orchestrator"]
1903            if live_lease(doc):
1904                raise ValueError("Session has a live coordinator lease")
1905            doc["lease"] = {"token": uuid.uuid4().hex, "pid": os.getpid(), "renewed_at": time.time()}
1906            reconcile(doc, repo)
1907            budget_change = parse_execution_budget(getattr(args, "execution_budget", None))
1908            if budget_change:
1909                doc["execution_budget"].update(budget_change)
1910                doc.setdefault("budget_changes", []).append({"budget": budget_change, "at": now()})
1911            if getattr(args, "retry_timeouts", False) and doc["timed_out_assignments"]:
1912                # An explicit operator retry: clear the ledger once, keep the record.
1913                doc.setdefault("timeout_retries", []).append({"cleared": doc["timed_out_assignments"], "at": now()})
1914                doc["timed_out_assignments"] = []
1915            doc.pop("timeout_hint", None)
1916            doc.pop("exclusions", None)
1917            # Trust policy is re-resolved on resume (CLI, environment, config), so
1918            # an operator can switch between strict and bypass for the rest of the session.
1919            resolved_policy = workspace_trust.resolve_policy()
1920            if (doc.get("workspace_trust_policy") or {}).get("policy") != resolved_policy["policy"]:
1921                doc.setdefault("workspace_trust_policy_changes", []).append(
1922                    {"from": (doc.get("workspace_trust_policy") or {}).get("policy"), "to": resolved_policy["policy"],
1923                     "at": now()})
1924            doc["workspace_trust_policy"] = resolved_policy
1925            requested_orchestrator = getattr(args, "orchestrator", None)
1926            if requested_orchestrator and requested_orchestrator != "AUTO" and doc["agents"].get(requested_orchestrator, {}).get("state") in {"AVAILABLE", "DEGRADED"}:
1927                doc["requested_orchestrator"] = requested_orchestrator
1928                doc["selected_orchestrator"] = requested_orchestrator
1929                doc["orchestrator"] = requested_orchestrator
1930            for agent in AGENTS:
1931                opt = getattr(args, agent, None)
1932                if opt:
1933                    current_state = doc["agents"].get(agent, {}).get("state")
1934                    if opt == "RESERVED":
1935                        doc["agents"][agent]["state"] = "RESERVED"
1936                    elif opt in {"AVAILABLE", "AUTO"} and current_state == "RESERVED":
1937                        installed = shutil.which(BINARIES[agent]) is not None
1938                        doc["agents"][agent]["state"] = "AVAILABLE" if installed else "UNAVAILABLE"
1939            if getattr(args, "models", None):
1940                for role, agent, model in parse_role_model_triples(args.models):
1941                    doc["role_models"].setdefault(role, {})[agent] = model
1942            if getattr(args, "strategy", None):
1943                doc["strategy"] = args.strategy
1944            if getattr(args, "verify", None):
1945                doc["verify_command"] = args.verify
1946            path = path_for(root, doc["id"])
1947            secure_write(path, doc)
1948            if doc["policy"] == "PLAN ONLY" and doc.get("reconciliation", {}).get("needs_validation"):
1949                doc["status"] = "BLOCKED"
1950                save(path, doc, doc["lease"]["token"])
1951                return report(doc)
1952        else:
1953            if active:
1954                if args.separate:
1955                    raise ValueError("Separate sessions need a distinct Git worktree passed with --repo; overlapping worktree ownership is refused")
1956                raise ValueError("Unfinished session exists. Use orchestrate resume, inspect, discard, or a separate Git worktree")
1957            doc = setup(args, repo)
1958            doc["retain_report"] = args.retain_report
1959            path = path_for(root, doc["id"])
1960            save(path, doc, doc["lease"]["token"])
1961    progress = SessionProgress(
1962        doc,
1963        stream=sys.stderr,
1964        heartbeat_interval=getattr(args, "heartbeat", 30.0),
1965        enabled=not (getattr(args, "quiet", False) or getattr(args, "no_progress", False) or getattr(args, "json", False)),
1966    )
1967    if operation == "resume":
1968        progress._write("RESUME", f"Loading orchestration session {doc['id'][:8]}")
1969        for note in migrations:
1970            progress._write("MIGRATE", note)
1971        progress._write("RECONCILE", "Checking repository and worker state")
1972        if doc["orchestrator"] != previous_orchestrator:
1973            progress._write("TAKEOVER", f"{AGENT_NAMES.get(doc['orchestrator'], doc['orchestrator'])} is now orchestrator")
1974    else:
1975        progress.session_started()
1976    try:
1977        return run(doc, path, repo, progress)
1978    except KeyboardInterrupt:
1979        progress._write("INTERRUPT", "Stopping new dispatches and checkpointing session...")
1980        doc["status"] = "INTERRUPTED"
1981        checkpoint(doc, path, doc["lease"]["token"], repo)
1982        progress._write("CHECKPOINT", f"Session can be resumed with: howlplane orchestrate resume --repo {repo}")
1983        return 130
def add_parser(subparsers: Any, common_parser: Any) -> None: 
1986def add_parser(subparsers: Any, common_parser: Any) -> None:
1987    parser = subparsers.add_parser("orchestrate", parents=[common_parser], help="Run a session-scoped agent workflow")
1988    parser.add_argument("input", nargs="?", help="Goal, resume, inspect, or discard")
1989    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Machine-readable session inspection")
1990    parser.add_argument("--quiet", action="store_true", help="Only print the final report and errors")
1991    parser.add_argument("--no-progress", action="store_true", help="Disable task-level progress and local heartbeats")
1992    parser.add_argument("--heartbeat", type=float, default=30.0, metavar="SECONDS", help="Heartbeat interval during otherwise silent work (default: 30)")
1993    parser.add_argument("--separate", action="store_true", help="Start a separate session alongside an unfinished one")
1994    parser.add_argument("--retain-report", action="store_true")
